title: Hierarchical Pre-Training of Vision Encoders with Large Language Models
comment: 17 pages, 14 figures, accepted to Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition Conference (CVPR) Workshops 2026. 5th MMFM Workshop: What is Next in Multimodal Foundation Models?
summary: The field of computer vision has experienced significant advancements through scalable vision encoders and multimodal pre-training frameworks. However, existing approaches often treat vision encoders and large language models (LLMs) as independent modules, limiting the integration of hierarchical visual features. In this work, we propose HIVE (Hierarchical Pre-Training of Vision Encoders), a novel framework that enhances vision-language alignment by introducing hierarchical cross-attention between the vision encoder and LLM. Unlike conventional methods that flatten image embeddings, HIVE enables structured feature fusion across multiple layers, improving gradient flow and representation learning. To optimize this interaction, we introduce a three-stage training strategy that progressively aligns the vision encoder with the LLM, ensuring stable optimization and effective multimodal fusion. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that HIVE achieves superior performance not only in image classification but also on various vision-language tasks, outperforming self-attention-based methods in benchmarks such as MME, GQA, OK-VQA, and ScienceQA. Our results highlight the benefits of hierarchical feature integration, paving the way for more efficient and expressive vision-language models.

AI.tldr: HIVE提出了一种新颖的分层视觉编码器预训练框架，通过引入视觉编码器与LLM之间的分层交叉注意力机制，改进了视觉语言对齐，在多个基准测试中超越了现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常将视觉编码器和大型语言模型视为独立模块，限制了分层视觉特征的整合，导致视觉语言对齐不够充分。
AI.method: 提出HIVE框架，引入视觉编码器与LLM之间的分层交叉注意力机制，采用三阶段训练策略逐步对齐视觉编码器与LLM，实现结构化特征融合。
AI.result: HIVE在图像分类和各种视觉语言任务上表现出色，在MME、GQA、OK-VQA和ScienceQA等基准测试中超越了基于自注意力的方法。
AI.conclusion: 分层特征整合带来了显著优势，为更高效和更具表达力的视觉语言模型开辟了新途径。

title: RawGen: Learning Camera Raw Image Generation
summary: Cameras capture scene-referred linear raw images, which are processed by onboard image signal processors (ISPs) into display-referred 8-bit sRGB outputs. Although raw data is more faithful for low-level vision tasks, collecting large-scale raw datasets remains a major bottleneck, as existing datasets are limited and tied to specific camera hardware. Generative models offer a promising way to address this scarcity -- however, existing diffusion frameworks are designed to synthesize photo-finished sRGB images rather than physically consistent linear representations. This paper presents RawGen, to our knowledge the first diffusion-based framework enabling text-to-raw generation for arbitrary target cameras, alongside sRGB-to-raw inversion. RawGen leverages the generative priors of large-scale sRGB diffusion models to synthesize physically meaningful linear outputs, such as CIE XYZ or camera-specific raw representations, via specialized processing in latent and pixel spaces. To handle unknown and diverse ISP pipelines and photo-finishing effects in diffusion-model training data, we build a many-to-one inverse-ISP dataset where multiple sRGB renditions of the same scene generated using diverse ISP parameters are anchored to a common scene-referred target. Fine-tuning a conditional denoiser and specialized decoder on this dataset allows RawGen to obtain camera-centric linear reconstructions that effectively invert the rendering pipeline. We demonstrate RawGen's superior performance over traditional inverse-ISP methods that assume a fixed ISP. Furthermore, we show that augmenting training pipelines with RawGen's scalable, text-driven synthetic data can benefit downstream low-level vision tasks.

AI.tldr: RawGen是首个基于扩散模型的文本到原始(raw)图像生成框架，能够为任意目标相机生成物理一致的线性表示，同时支持sRGB到原始图像的转换。
AI.motivation: 原始(raw)数据在低层视觉任务中更准确，但大规模原始数据收集困难，现有数据集有限且与特定相机硬件绑定。现有扩散模型只能生成经过ISP处理的sRGB图像，无法生成物理一致的线性表示。
AI.method: 利用大规模sRGB扩散模型的生成先验，通过潜在空间和像素空间的专门处理合成物理有意义的线性输出。构建多对一的逆ISP数据集，将使用不同ISP参数生成的同一场景的多个sRGB渲染版本锚定到共同的场景参考目标。通过微调条件去噪器和专门解码器实现相机中心的线性重建。
AI.result: RawGen在传统假设固定ISP的逆ISP方法上表现出优越性能。通过RawGen生成的可扩展、文本驱动的合成数据能够增强下游低层视觉任务的训练流程。
AI.conclusion: RawGen是首个能够为任意目标相机生成物理一致线性表示的扩散框架，解决了原始数据稀缺问题，并为低层视觉任务提供了可扩展的合成数据生成能力。

title: Q-Mask: Query-driven Causal Masks for Text Anchoring in OCR-Oriented Vision-Language Models
summary: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is increasingly regarded as a foundational capability for modern vision-language models (VLMs), enabling them not only to read text in images but also to support downstream reasoning in real-world visual question answering (VQA). However, practical applications further require reliable text anchors, i.e., accurately grounding queried text to its corresponding spatial region. To systematically evaluate this capability, we introduce TextAnchor-Bench (TABench), a benchmark for fine-grained text-region grounding, which reveals that both general-purpose and OCR-specific VLMs still struggle to establish accurate and stable text anchors. To address this limitation, we propose Q-Mask, a precise OCR framework built upon a causal query-driven mask decoder (CQMD). Inspired by chain-of-thought reasoning, Q-Mask performs causal visual decoding that sequentially generates query-conditioned visual masks before producing the final OCR output. This visual CoT paradigm disentangles where the text is from what the text is, enforcing grounded evidence acquisition prior to recognition and enabling explicit text anchor construction during inference. To train CQMD, we construct TextAnchor-26M, a large-scale dataset of image-text pairs annotated with fine-grained masks corresponding to specific textual elements, encouraging stable text-region correspondences and injecting strong spatial priors into VLM training. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Q-Mask substantially improves text anchoring and understanding across diverse visual scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出Q-Mask框架，通过因果查询驱动的掩码解码器实现精确OCR，解决视觉语言模型中文本区域定位不准确的问题
AI.motivation: 当前视觉语言模型在文本区域定位（text anchoring）方面表现不佳，无法可靠地将查询文本准确对应到图像中的空间区域，限制了OCR在实际应用中的效果
AI.method: 提出Q-Mask框架，包含因果查询驱动的掩码解码器（CQMD），采用视觉链式思维推理范式，先通过因果视觉解码生成查询条件化的视觉掩码，再进行最终OCR识别；构建TextAnchor-26M大规模数据集进行训练
AI.result: Q-Mask显著提升了文本区域定位和理解的准确性，在多样化的视觉场景中表现出色
AI.conclusion: 通过将文本定位与识别解耦的视觉链式思维方法，Q-Mask框架能够建立更准确稳定的文本锚点，为视觉语言模型的OCR能力提供了重要改进

title: Suppressing Non-Semantic Noise in Masked Image Modeling Representations
summary: Masked Image Modeling (MIM) has become a ubiquitous self-supervised vision paradigm. In this work, we show that MIM objectives cause the learned representations to retain non-semantic information, which ultimately hurts performance during inference. We introduce a model-agnostic score for semantic invariance using Principal Component Analysis (PCA) on real and synthetic non-semantic images. Based on this score, we propose a simple method, Semantically Orthogonal Artifact Projection (SOAP), to directly suppress non-semantic information in patch representations, leading to consistent improvements in zero-shot performance across various MIM-based models. SOAP is a post-hoc suppression method, requires zero training, and can be attached to any model as a single linear head.

AI.tldr: SOAP方法通过PCA分析语义不变性，在MIM模型中抑制非语义信息，提升零样本性能
AI.motivation: 研究发现MIM目标函数导致学习到的表征保留了非语义信息，这会损害推理性能，需要一种方法来抑制这些非语义信息
AI.method: 提出SOAP方法：1）使用PCA在真实和合成非语义图像上计算语义不变性得分；2）通过语义正交伪影投影直接抑制补丁表征中的非语义信息
AI.result: SOAP在各种基于MIM的模型中都能一致提升零样本性能，且无需训练，可作为单个线性头附加到任何模型
AI.conclusion: SOAP是一种模型无关的后处理抑制方法，能有效减少MIM表征中的非语义信息，提高下游任务性能

title: Benchmark for Assessing Olfactory Perception of Large Language Models
summary: Here we introduce the Olfactory Perception (OP) benchmark, designed to assess the capability of large language models (LLMs) to reason about smell. The benchmark contains 1,010 questions across eight task categories spanning odor classification, odor primary descriptor identification, intensity and pleasantness judgments, multi-descriptor prediction, mixture similarity, olfactory receptor activation, and smell identification from real-world odor sources. Each question is presented in two prompt formats, compound names and isomeric SMILES, to evaluate the effect of molecular representations. Evaluating 21 model configurations across major model families, we find that compound-name prompts consistently outperform isomeric SMILES, with gains ranging from +2.4 to +18.9 percentage points (mean approx +7 points), suggesting current LLMs access olfactory knowledge primarily through lexical associations rather than structural molecular reasoning. The best-performing model reaches 64.4\% overall accuracy, which highlights both emerging capabilities and substantial remaining gaps in olfactory reasoning. We further evaluate a subset of the OP across 21 languages and find that aggregating predictions across languages improves olfactory prediction, with AUROC = 0.86 for the best performing language ensemble model. LLMs should be able to handle olfactory and not just visual or aural information.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了嗅觉感知基准测试(OP)，用于评估大语言模型对气味推理的能力，包含1010个问题覆盖8个任务类别，发现化合物名称提示优于SMILES表示，最佳模型准确率64.4%，多语言集成可提升预测性能。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型主要关注视觉和听觉信息处理，但缺乏对嗅觉推理能力的系统评估。需要建立一个全面的基准测试来衡量LLMs在气味相关任务上的表现，探索模型是通过词汇关联还是分子结构推理来理解嗅觉信息。
AI.method: 创建了包含1010个问题的嗅觉感知基准测试，涵盖8个任务类别：气味分类、主要描述符识别、强度和愉悦度判断、多描述符预测、混合物相似性、嗅觉受体激活、真实气味源识别。使用两种提示格式（化合物名称和异构SMILES），评估21个模型配置，并在21种语言中测试子集。
AI.result: 化合物名称提示始终优于异构SMILES，提升幅度在2.4-18.9个百分点（平均约7点），表明当前LLMs主要通过词汇关联而非分子结构推理获取嗅觉知识。最佳模型总体准确率达到64.4%。多语言集成可改善嗅觉预测，最佳语言集成模型的AUROC达到0.86。
AI.conclusion: LLMs在嗅觉推理方面展现出初步能力但仍存在显著差距，模型主要依赖词汇关联而非分子结构理解。多语言集成可提升性能，为未来开发更全面的多模态AI系统提供了重要基准和方向。

title: A Reliability Evaluation of Hybrid Deterministic-LLM Based Approaches for Academic Course Registration PDF Information Extraction
summary: This study evaluates the reliability of information extraction approaches from KRS documents using three strategies: LLM only, Hybrid Deterministic - LLM (regex + LLM), and a Camelot based pipeline with LLM fallback. Experiments were conducted on 140 documents for the LLM based test and 860 documents for the Camelot based pipeline evaluation, covering four study programs with varying data in tables and metadata. Three 12 - 14B LLM models (Gemma 3, Phi 4, and Qwen 2.5) were run locally using Ollama and a consumer grade CPU without a GPU. Evaluations used exact match (EM) and Levenshtein similarity (LS) metrics with a threshold of 0.7. Although not applicable to all models, the results show that the hybrid approach can improve efficiency compared to LLM only, especially for deterministic metadata. The Camelot based pipeline with LLM fallback produced the best combination of accuracy (EM and LS up to 0.99 - 1.00) and computational efficiency (less than 1 second per PDF in most cases). The Qwen 2.5:14b model demonstrated the most consistent performance across all scenarios. These findings confirm that integrating deterministic and LLM methods is increasingly reliable and efficient for information extraction from text based academic documents in computationally constrained environments.

AI.tldr: 研究评估了从KRS文档中信息提取的三种策略：纯LLM、混合确定性-LLM（正则+LLM）和基于Camelot的管道配合LLM回退，发现在计算受限环境下，混合方法在准确性和效率方面表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 在计算资源受限的环境下（仅使用消费级CPU而无GPU），需要评估不同信息提取方法从学术文档中提取信息的可靠性和效率，特别是针对KRS文档中的表格和元数据。
AI.method: 使用三种策略：1) 纯LLM方法；2) 混合确定性-LLM方法（正则表达式+LLM）；3) 基于Camelot的管道配合LLM回退。在140个文档上进行LLM测试，860个文档上进行Camelot管道评估，使用三个12-14B参数的LLM模型（Gemma 3、Phi 4、Qwen 2.5），通过Ollama在本地运行，使用精确匹配和Levenshtein相似度（阈值0.7）进行评估。
AI.result: 基于Camelot的管道配合LLM回退在准确性和计算效率方面表现最佳（精确匹配和相似度达0.99-1.00，大多数情况下每PDF处理时间少于1秒）。Qwen 2.5:14b模型在所有场景中表现最一致。混合方法相比纯LLM方法能提高效率，特别是对于确定性元数据。
AI.conclusion: 在计算受限环境中，整合确定性方法和LLM方法进行基于文本的学术文档信息提取是可靠且高效的，基于Camelot的管道配合LLM回退提供了最佳的性能平衡。

title: PRISM: Differentiable Analysis-by-Synthesis for Fixel Recovery in Diffusion MRI
summary: Diffusion MRI microstructure fitting is nonconvex and often performed voxelwise, which limits fiber peak recovery in narrow crossings. This work introduces PRISM, a differentiable analysis-by-synthesis framework that fits an explicit multi-compartment forward model end-to-end over spatial patches. The model combines cerebrospinal fluid (CSF), gray matter, up to K white-matter fiber compartments (stick-and-zeppelin), and a restricted compartment, with explicit fiber directions and soft model selection via repulsion and sparsity priors. PRISM supports a fast MSE objective and a Rician negative log-likelihood (NLL) that jointly learns sigma without oracle information. A lightweight nuisance calibration module (smooth bias field and per-measurement scale/offset) is included for robustness and regularized to identity in clean-data tests. On synthetic crossing-fiber data (SNR=30; five methods, 16 crossing angles), PRISM achieves 3.5 degrees best-match angular error with 95% recall, which is 1.9x lower than the best baseline (MSMT-CSD, 6.8 degrees, 83% recall); in NLL mode with learned sigma, error drops to 2.3 degrees with 99% recall, resolving crossings down to 20 degrees. On the DiSCo1 phantom (NLL mode), PRISM improves connectivity correlation over CSD baselines at all four tracking angles (best r=.934 at 25 degrees vs. .920 for MSMT-CSD). Whole-brain HCP fitting (~741k voxels, MSE mode) completes in ~12 min on a single GPU with near-identical results across random seeds.

AI.tldr: PRISM是一个可微分的分析-合成框架，用于扩散MRI微结构拟合，通过端到端空间块拟合显式多室模型，显著改善了交叉纤维的峰值恢复。
AI.motivation: 扩散MRI微结构拟合通常是非凸的且逐体素进行，这限制了在狭窄交叉区域中纤维峰值的恢复能力。现有方法在复杂纤维交叉场景下表现不佳。
AI.method: PRISM采用可微分的分析-合成框架，在空间块上端到端拟合显式多室前向模型。模型包含脑脊液、灰质、最多K个白质纤维室（stick-and-zeppelin）和受限室，具有显式纤维方向和通过排斥与稀疏先验的软模型选择。支持快速MSE目标和Rician负对数似然（NLL）联合学习sigma。包含轻量级干扰校准模块（平滑偏置场和每测量尺度/偏移）以提高鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在合成交叉纤维数据（SNR=30）上，PRISM达到3.5度最佳匹配角度误差和95%召回率，比最佳基线（MSMT-CSD）的6.8度和83%召回率低1.9倍；在NLL模式下误差降至2.3度，召回率99%，可解析低至20度的交叉。在DiSCo1体模上，PRISM在所有四个跟踪角度上改善了与CSD基线的连接相关性（最佳r=0.934 vs. 0.920）。全脑HCP拟合（约741k体素）在单GPU上约12分钟完成，随机种子间结果几乎相同。
AI.conclusion: PRISM通过可微分的分析-合成框架和空间块拟合，显著提高了扩散MRI微结构估计的准确性和鲁棒性，特别是在复杂纤维交叉场景下，同时保持了计算效率。

title: LinearARD: Linear-Memory Attention Distillation for RoPE Restoration
summary: The extension of context windows in Large Language Models is typically facilitated by scaling positional encodings followed by lightweight Continual Pre-Training (CPT). While effective for processing long sequences, this paradigm often disrupts original model capabilities, leading to performance degradation on standard short-text benchmarks. We propose LinearARD, a self-distillation method that restores Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE)-scaled students through attention-structure consistency with a frozen native-RoPE teacher. Rather than matching opaque hidden states, LinearARD aligns the row-wise distributions of dense $Q/Q$, $K/K$, and $V/V$ self-relation matrices to directly supervise attention dynamics. To overcome the quadratic memory bottleneck of $n \times n$ relation maps, we introduce a linear-memory kernel. This kernel leverages per-token log-sum-exp statistics and fuses logit recomputation into the backward pass to compute exact Kullback-Leibler divergence and gradients. On LLaMA2-7B extended from 4K to 32K, LinearARD recovers 98.3\% of the short-text performance of state-of-the-art baselines while surpassing them on long-context benchmarks. Notably, our method achieves these results using only \textbf{4.25M} training tokens compared to the \textbf{256M} tokens required by LongReD and CPT. Our code is available at https://github.com/gracefulning/LinearARD.

AI.tldr: LinearARD是一种自蒸馏方法，通过注意力结构一致性恢复RoPE缩放模型的短文本性能，使用线性内存核解决二次内存瓶颈，仅需4.25M训练token即可恢复98.3%的短文本性能。
AI.motivation: 扩展大语言模型上下文窗口通常通过缩放位置编码和轻量级持续预训练实现，但这会破坏原始模型能力，导致标准短文本基准性能下降。需要一种方法在扩展上下文的同时保持短文本性能。
AI.method: 提出LinearARD自蒸馏方法，使用冻结的原始RoPE教师模型通过注意力结构一致性来恢复RoPE缩放的学生模型。方法对齐密集Q/Q、K/K、V/V自关系矩阵的行分布来直接监督注意力动态。引入线性内存核解决n×n关系图的二次内存瓶颈，利用每token的log-sum-exp统计量，并将logit重新计算融合到反向传播中计算精确的KL散度和梯度。
AI.result: 在LLaMA2-7B从4K扩展到32K的实验中，LinearARD恢复了最先进基线方法98.3%的短文本性能，同时在长上下文基准上超越它们。仅使用4.25M训练token，而LongReD和CPT需要256M token。
AI.conclusion: LinearARD通过注意力结构自蒸馏有效解决了上下文扩展中的性能退化问题，以极少的训练token实现了短文本性能恢复和长上下文性能提升，为模型扩展提供了高效解决方案。

title: Open, Reliable, and Collective: A Community-Driven Framework for Tool-Using AI Agents
summary: Tool-integrated LLMs can retrieve, compute, and take real-world actions via external tools, but reliability remains a key bottleneck. We argue that failures stem from both tool-use accuracy (how well an agent invokes a tool) and intrinsic tool accuracy (the tool's own correctness), while most prior work emphasizes the former. We introduce OpenTools, a community-driven toolbox that standardizes tool schemas, provides lightweight plug-and-play wrappers, and evaluates tools with automated test suites and continuous monitoring. We also release a public web demo where users can run predefined agents and tools and contribute test cases, enabling reliability reports to evolve as tools change. OpenTools includes the core framework, an initial tool set, evaluation pipelines, and a contribution protocol. Experiments and evaluations show improved end-to-end reproducibility and task performance; community-contributed, higher-quality task-specific tools deliver 6%-22% relative gains over an existing toolbox across multiple agent architectures on downstream tasks and benchmarks, highlighting the importance of intrinsic tool accuracy.

AI.tldr: OpenTools是一个社区驱动的工具箱，通过标准化工具模式、提供轻量级插件包装器和自动化测试套件来提升工具集成LLM的可靠性，强调工具内在准确性的重要性。
AI.motivation: 工具集成LLM可以通过外部工具检索、计算和执行现实世界操作，但可靠性是关键瓶颈。失败源于工具使用准确性（代理如何调用工具）和工具内在准确性（工具自身的正确性），而大多数先前工作只强调前者。
AI.method: 引入OpenTools：1）标准化工具模式；2）提供轻量级即插即用包装器；3）通过自动化测试套件和持续监控评估工具；4）发布公共Web演示，用户可以运行预定义代理和工具并贡献测试用例；5）包括核心框架、初始工具集、评估流程和贡献协议。
AI.result: 实验评估显示：1）改进了端到端可重现性和任务性能；2）社区贡献的、更高质量的任务特定工具在多个代理架构的下游任务和基准测试中，相比现有工具箱实现了6%-22%的相对增益。
AI.conclusion: OpenTools通过社区驱动的方法解决了工具集成LLM的可靠性问题，强调了工具内在准确性的重要性，并通过标准化、测试和持续监控机制提升了整体系统性能。

title: Benchmarking Interaction, Beyond Policy: a Reproducible Benchmark for Collaborative Instance Object Navigation
summary: We propose Question-Asking Navigation (QAsk-Nav), the first reproducible benchmark for Collaborative Instance Object Navigation (CoIN) that enables an explicit, separate assessment of embodied navigation and collaborative question asking. CoIN tasks an embodied agent with reaching a target specified in free-form natural language under partial observability, using only egocentric visual observations and interactive natural-language dialogue with a human, where the dialogue can help to resolve ambiguity among visually similar object instances. Existing CoIN benchmarks are primarily focused on navigation success and offer no support for consistent evaluation of collaborative interaction. To address this limitation, QAsk-Nav provides (i) a lightweight question-asking protocol scored independently of navigation, (ii) an enhanced navigation protocol with realistic, diverse, high-quality target descriptions, and (iii) an open-source dataset, that includes 28,000 quality-checked reasoning and question-asking traces for training and analysis of interactive capabilities of CoIN models. Using the proposed QAsk-Nav benchmark, we develop Light-CoNav, a lightweight unified model for collaborative navigation that is 3x smaller and 70x faster than existing modular methods, while outperforming state-of-the-art CoIN approaches in generalization to unseen objects and environments. Project page at https://benchmarking-interaction.github.io/

AI.tldr: QAsk-Nav是首个可复现的协作实例对象导航基准，支持对导航和协作提问进行独立评估，包含轻量级提问协议、增强的导航协议和开源数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有协作实例对象导航基准主要关注导航成功率，缺乏对协作交互能力的一致评估方法，需要专门的基准来分别评估导航和提问能力。
AI.method: 提出QAsk-Nav基准，包含：(1) 独立于导航评分的轻量级提问协议；(2) 具有真实、多样、高质量目标描述的增强导航协议；(3) 包含28,000条质量检查推理和提问轨迹的开源数据集。
AI.result: 基于QAsk-Nav基准开发了Light-CoNav模型，比现有模块化方法小3倍、快70倍，在未见过的对象和环境泛化方面优于最先进的协作实例对象导航方法。
AI.conclusion: QAsk-Nav为协作实例对象导航提供了首个可复现的基准，支持对导航和协作提问能力的独立评估，推动了该领域的研究进展。

title: Scalable Identification and Prioritization of Requisition-Specific Personal Competencies Using Large Language Models
summary: AI-powered recruitment tools are increasingly adopted in personnel selection, yet they struggle to capture the requisition (req)-specific personal competencies (PCs) that distinguish successful candidates beyond job categories. We propose a large language model (LLM)-based approach to identify and prioritize req-specific PCs from reqs. Our approach integrates dynamic few-shot prompting, reflection-based self-improvement, similarity-based filtering, and multi-stage validation. Applied to a dataset of Program Manager reqs, our approach correctly identifies the highest-priority req-specific PCs with an average accuracy of 0.76, approaching human expert inter-rater reliability, and maintains a low out-of-scope rate of 0.07.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型的方法，用于从招聘需求中识别和优先排序需求特定的个人能力，在项目经理职位需求数据集上达到0.76的平均准确率。
AI.motivation: 当前AI招聘工具难以捕捉超越职位类别的需求特定个人能力，这些能力是区分成功候选人的关键因素。
AI.method: 采用大语言模型方法，整合动态少样本提示、基于反思的自我改进、相似性过滤和多阶段验证等技术。
AI.result: 在项目经理职位需求数据集上，该方法能正确识别最高优先级需求特定个人能力，平均准确率达0.76，接近人类专家评分者间信度，且超出范围率保持在0.07的低水平。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能有效识别和优先排序需求特定个人能力，为AI招聘工具提供了更精准的能力识别解决方案。

title: OmniSch: A Multimodal PCB Schematic Benchmark For Structured Diagram Visual Reasoning
summary: Recent large multimodal models (LMMs) have made rapid progress in visual grounding, document understanding, and diagram reasoning tasks. However, their ability to convert Printed Circuit Board (PCB) schematic diagrams into machine-readable spatially weighted netlist graphs, jointly capturing component attributes, connectivity, and geometry, remains largely underexplored, despite such graph representations are the backbone of practical electronic design automation (EDA) workflows. To bridge this gap, we introduce OmniSch, the first comprehensive benchmark designed to assess LMMs on schematic understanding and spatial netlist graph construction. OmniSch contains 1,854 real-world schematic diagrams and includes four tasks: (1) visual grounding for schematic entities, with 109.9K grounded instances aligning 423.4K diagram semantic labels to their visual regions; (2) diagram-to-graph reasoning, understanding topological relationship among diagram elements; (3) geometric reasoning, constructing layout-dependent weights for each connection; and (4) tool-augmented agentic reasoning for visual search, invoking external tools to accomplish (1)-(3). Our results reveal substantial gaps of current LMMs in interpreting schematic engineering artifacts, including unreliable fine-grained grounding, brittle layout-to-graph parsing, inconsistent global connectivity reasoning and inefficient visual exploration.

AI.tldr: OmniSch是首个评估大语言多模态模型在电路板原理图理解和空间网表图构建能力的基准，包含1,854个真实原理图，涵盖视觉定位、图到图推理、几何推理和工具增强推理四大任务，揭示了当前模型在工程图纸理解上的显著不足。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言多模态模型在视觉定位、文档理解和图表推理方面进展迅速，但其在将印刷电路板原理图转换为机器可读的空间加权网表图方面的能力尚未充分探索，而这种图表示是电子设计自动化工作流程的核心。
AI.method: 研究者引入了OmniSch基准，包含1,854个真实世界原理图，设计了四个任务：1）原理图实体的视觉定位；2）图到图推理，理解元素间的拓扑关系；3）几何推理，为每个连接构建布局相关的权重；4）工具增强的代理推理，调用外部工具完成前三个任务。
AI.result: 研究结果显示当前大语言多模态模型在解释原理图工程工件方面存在显著差距，包括不可靠的细粒度定位、脆弱的布局到图解析、不一致的全局连接推理以及低效的视觉探索能力。
AI.conclusion: OmniSch基准揭示了当前大语言多模态模型在工程图纸理解方面的局限性，为未来模型在电子设计自动化等实际应用中的改进提供了重要参考和评估标准。

title: How Trustworthy Are LLM-as-Judge Ratings for Interpretive Responses? Implications for Qualitative Research Workflows
summary: As qualitative researchers show growing interest in using automated tools to support interpretive analysis, a large language model (LLM) is often introduced into an analytic workflow as is, without systematic evaluation of interpretive quality or comparison across models. This practice leaves model selection largely unexamined despite its potential influence on interpretive outcomes. To address this gap, this study examines whether LLM-as-judge evaluations meaningfully align with human judgments of interpretive quality and can inform model-level decision making. Using 712 conversational excerpts from semi-structured interviews with K-12 mathematics teachers, we generated one-sentence interpretive responses using five widely adopted inference models: Command R+ (Cohere), Gemini 2.5 Pro (Google), GPT-5.1 (OpenAI), Llama 4 Scout-17B Instruct (Meta), and Qwen 3-32B Dense (Alibaba). Automated evaluations were conducted using AWS Bedrock's LLM-as-judge framework across five metrics, and a stratified subset of responses was independently rated by trained human evaluators on interpretive accuracy, nuance preservation, and interpretive coherence. Results show that LLM-as-judge scores capture broad directional trends in human evaluations at the model level but diverge substantially in score magnitude. Among automated metrics, Coherence showed the strongest alignment with aggregated human ratings, whereas Faithfulness and Correctness revealed systematic misalignment at the excerpt level, particularly for non-literal and nuanced interpretations. Safety-related metrics were largely irrelevant to interpretive quality. These findings suggest that LLM-as-judge methods are better suited for screening or eliminating underperforming models than for replacing human judgment, offering practical guidance for systematic comparison and selection of LLMs in qualitative research workflows.

AI.tldr: 研究评估了LLM作为评判者评估与人类对解释性质量判断的一致性，发现LLM评分能捕捉模型层面的趋势但分数幅度差异大，适合筛选表现不佳模型而非替代人类判断。
AI.motivation: 随着定性研究者越来越多地使用自动化工具支持解释性分析，大型语言模型常被直接引入分析流程而缺乏系统性评估。这种实践使得模型选择对解释结果的影响未被充分检验。
AI.method: 使用712个K-12数学教师半结构化访谈对话片段，通过5个主流推理模型生成单句解释性回应，使用AWS Bedrock的LLM-as-judge框架进行5个指标的自动化评估，同时由训练有素的人类评估者对分层子集进行独立评分。
AI.result: LLM-as-judge评分在模型层面能捕捉人类评估的广泛方向趋势，但分数幅度差异显著。在自动化指标中，连贯性与聚合人类评分最一致，而忠实性和正确性在片段层面存在系统性偏差，特别是对于非字面和细微的解释。安全相关指标与解释性质量基本无关。
AI.conclusion: LLM-as-judge方法更适合筛选或淘汰表现不佳的模型，而不是替代人类判断。这为定性研究流程中系统比较和选择LLM提供了实用指导。

title: Improvisational Games as a Benchmark for Social Intelligence of AI Agents: The Case of Connections
summary: We formally introduce a improvisational wordplay game called Connections to explore reasoning capabilities of AI agents. Playing Connections combines skills in knowledge retrieval, summarization and awareness of cognitive states of other agents. We show how the game serves as a good benchmark for social intelligence abilities of language model based agents that go beyond the agents' own memory and deductive reasoning and also involve gauging the understanding capabilities of other agents. Finally, we show how through communication with other agents in a constrained environment, AI agents must demonstrate social awareness and intelligence in games involving collaboration.

AI.tldr: Connections游戏作为评估AI智能体社交推理能力的基准，要求智能体具备知识检索、总结和认知状态感知能力
AI.motivation: 探索AI智能体在需要社交智能的任务中的推理能力，超越单纯的记忆和演绎推理，评估智能体对其他智能体理解能力的判断
AI.method: 引入Connections即兴文字游戏作为测试平台，要求智能体在受限环境中与其他智能体通信，展示社交意识和协作能力
AI.result: Connections游戏能够有效评估语言模型智能体的社交智能能力，包括知识检索、总结和认知状态感知等多方面技能
AI.conclusion: Connections游戏是评估AI智能体社交推理能力的良好基准，强调了在协作游戏中社交意识和智能的重要性

title: Eyla: Toward an Identity-Anchored LLM Architecture with Integrated Biological Priors -- Vision, Implementation Attempt, and Lessons from AI-Assisted Development
comment: 8 pages, 3 tables, 25 references. Preprint under review for workshop submission
summary: We present the design rationale, implementation attempt, and failure analysis of Eyla, a proposed identity-anchored LLM architecture that integrates biologically-inspired subsystems -- including HiPPO-initialized state-space models, zero-initialized adapters, episodic memory retrieval, and calibrated uncertainty training -- into a unified agent operating system running on consumer hardware. Unlike existing approaches that optimize models for generic helpfulness, Eyla targets identity consistency: the ability to maintain a coherent self-model under adversarial pressure, admit uncertainty, and resist manipulation. We propose the Identity Consistency Score (ICS), a novel benchmark for evaluating this property across LLMs. We then present an honest account of attempting to implement this architecture using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor) as a non-programmer, documenting a $1,000+ failure that produced a 1.27B parameter model with 86 brain subsystems contributing less than 2% to output. Our analysis identifies five systematic failure modes of AI-assisted development for novel architectures and offers concrete recommendations. To our knowledge, this is the first paper to combine an architectural vision with a documented first-person failure analysis of AI-assisted LLM development, providing lessons for both the AI systems and AI-assisted software engineering communities.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Eyla身份锚定LLM架构，集成生物启发子系统，旨在实现身份一致性而非通用帮助性，但AI辅助开发尝试失败，产生了86个子系统仅贡献2%输出的1.27B参数模型，成本超1000美元。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM主要优化通用帮助性，缺乏身份一致性——即在对抗压力下保持连贯自我模型、承认不确定性和抵抗操纵的能力。作者希望设计一个能够维持身份一致性的LLM架构。
AI.method: 提出Eyla架构，集成生物启发子系统：HiPPO初始化状态空间模型、零初始化适配器、情景记忆检索和校准不确定性训练。提出身份一致性评分(ICS)作为评估指标。尝试使用AI编码助手(Claude Code, Cursor)作为非程序员实现该架构。
AI.result: 实现尝试失败，花费1000多美元，产生了1.27B参数模型，其中86个大脑子系统对输出的贡献不到2%。识别出AI辅助开发新型架构的五个系统性失败模式，并提供具体建议。
AI.conclusion: 这是第一篇将架构愿景与AI辅助LLM开发的第一人称失败分析相结合的论文，为AI系统和AI辅助软件工程社区提供了重要教训，表明当前AI辅助工具在实现创新架构方面存在局限性。

title: The Geometry of Compromise: Unlocking Generative Capabilities via Controllable Modality Alignment
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as CLIP learn a shared embedding space for images and text, yet their representations remain geometrically separated, a phenomenon known as the modality gap. This gap limits tasks requiring cross-modal interchangeability, such as captioning and joint clustering. Existing post-processing approaches can partially improve cross-modal compatibility; however, we show through geometric analysis that they primarily reduce the global centroid offset while leaving the underlying distributional mismatch intact. We decompose the modality gap into a Centroid Gap and a Distribution Gap, and demonstrate that the Distribution Gap is the true predictor of cross-modal task quality ($R^2 = 0.986$), whereas the commonly used Raw Gap is misleading ($R^2 = 0.691$). Motivated by this observation, we propose TPC-CMA (Three-Phase Curriculum for Cross-Modal Alignment), a fine-tuning framework that explicitly reduces both components. The proposed CMA jointly mitigates centroid offsets and reshapes the distributional structure, while a three-phase curriculum with gradient-aware scheduling progressively introduces alignment during training to enable stable optimization. Experiments demonstrate that our method significantly improves cross-modal alignment. With $α_{\text{target}}{=}0.05$, the modality gap is reduced by 66.6\% with only 4.84\% accuracy drop. Under stronger alignment ($α_{\text{target}}{=}0.5$), the gap is reduced by 82.3\%, clustering ARI improves from 0.318 to 0.516, and captioning CIDEr increases by 57.1\% over the original model. Our code and pre-trained models will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出TPC-CMA方法，通过三阶段课程学习减少视觉语言模型中的模态鸿沟，将鸿沟分解为质心差距和分布差距，显著提升跨模态任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型（如CLIP）存在模态鸿沟问题，限制了跨模态互换性任务（如图像描述、联合聚类）的性能。现有后处理方法主要减少全局质心偏移，但未能解决底层分布不匹配问题。
AI.method: 提出TPC-CMA（三阶段跨模态对齐课程学习）微调框架：1）将模态鸿沟分解为质心差距和分布差距；2）设计梯度感知调度的三阶段课程，逐步引入对齐训练；3）联合减少质心偏移并重塑分布结构。
AI.result: 实验表明：在α_target=0.05时，模态鸿沟减少66.6%，仅损失4.84%准确率；在α_target=0.5时，鸿沟减少82.3%，聚类ARI从0.318提升至0.516，图像描述CIDEr分数提升57.1%。
AI.conclusion: 模态鸿沟应分解为质心差距和分布差距，其中分布差距是跨模态任务质量的真正预测指标。TPC-CMA方法能有效减少模态鸿沟，显著提升跨模态对齐性能。

title: Can LLMs Perceive Time? An Empirical Investigation
comment: ICLR 2026 I Can't Believe It's Not Better Workshop
summary: Large language models cannot estimate how long their own tasks take. We investigate this limitation through four experiments across 68 tasks and four model families. Pre-task estimates overshoot actual duration by 4--7$\times$ ($p < 0.001$), with models predicting human-scale minutes for tasks completing in seconds. Relative ordering fares no better: on task pairs designed to expose heuristic reliance, models score at or below chance (GPT-5: 18\% on counter-intuitive pairs, $p = 0.033$), systematically failing when complexity labels mislead. Post-hoc recall is disconnected from reality -- estimates diverge from actuals by an order of magnitude in either direction. These failures persist in multi-step agentic settings, with errors of 5--10$\times$. The models possess propositional knowledge about duration from training but lack experiential grounding in their own inference time, with practical implications for agent scheduling, planning and time-critical scenarios.

AI.tldr: 大型语言模型无法准确估计自身任务执行时间，存在系统性高估和排序错误
AI.motivation: 研究大型语言模型在估计自身任务执行时间方面的局限性，这对于智能体调度、规划和时间关键场景有重要实际意义
AI.method: 通过四个实验，涵盖68个任务和四个模型系列，包括任务前估计、相对排序测试、事后回忆分析以及多步智能体设置评估
AI.result: 模型高估任务时间4-7倍，相对排序表现差于随机猜测，事后回忆与实际时间相差一个数量级，多步智能体设置中误差达5-10倍
AI.conclusion: 大型语言模型虽然拥有关于持续时间的命题知识，但缺乏对其自身推理时间的经验基础，导致时间估计能力严重不足

title: Signals: Trajectory Sampling and Triage for Agentic Interactions
summary: Agentic applications based on large language models increasingly rely on multi-step interaction loops involving planning, action execution, and environment feedback. While such systems are now deployed at scale, improving them post-deployment remains challenging. Agent trajectories are voluminous and non-deterministic, and reviewing each one, whether through human review or auxiliary LLMs, is slow and cost-prohibitive. We propose a lightweight, signal-based framework for triaging agentic interaction trajectories. Our approach computes cheap, broadly applicable signals from live interactions and attaches them as structured attributes for trajectory triage, identifying interactions likely to be informative without affecting online agent behavior. We organize signals into a coarse-grained taxonomy spanning interaction (misalignment, stagnation, disengagement, satisfaction), execution (failure, loop), and environment (exhaustion), designed for computation without model calls. In a controlled annotation study on $τ$-bench, a widely used benchmark for tool-augmented agent evaluation, we show that signal-based sampling achieves an 82\% informativeness rate compared to 74\% for heuristic filtering and 54\% for random sampling, with a 1.52x efficiency gain per informative trajectory. The advantage is robust across reward strata and task domains, confirming that signals provide genuine per-trajectory informativeness gains rather than merely oversampling obvious failures. These results show that lightweight signals can serve as practical sampling infrastructure for agentic systems, and suggest a path toward preference data construction and post-deployment optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出基于信号的轻量级框架，用于筛选智能体交互轨迹，通过计算廉价信号识别信息量大的交互，提高后部署优化效率。
AI.motivation: 基于大语言模型的智能体应用依赖多步交互循环，但后部署改进困难。智能体轨迹数据量大且非确定性，人工或辅助LLM审查成本高、速度慢。
AI.method: 提出轻量级信号框架，从实时交互中计算廉价、广泛适用的信号，作为结构化属性进行轨迹筛选。信号分为交互（错位、停滞、脱离、满意度）、执行（失败、循环）和环境（耗尽）三类，无需模型调用即可计算。
AI.result: 在τ-bench基准测试中，基于信号的采样达到82%信息率，优于启发式过滤（74%）和随机采样（54%），每个信息轨迹效率提升1.52倍。优势在不同奖励层级和任务领域均稳健。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级信号可作为智能体系统的实用采样基础设施，为偏好数据构建和后部署优化提供路径。

title: In harmony with gpt-oss
summary: No one has independently reproduced OpenAI's published scores for gpt-oss-20b with tools, because the original paper discloses neither the tools nor the agent harness. We reverse-engineered the model's in-distribution tools: when prompted without tool definitions, gpt-oss still calls tools from its training distribution with high statistical confidence -- a strong prior, not a hallucination. We then built a native harmony agent harness (https://github.com/borislavmavrin/harmonyagent.git) that encodes messages in the model's native format, bypassing the lossy Chat Completions conversion. Together, these yield the first independent reproduction of OpenAI's published scores: 60.4% on SWE Verified HIGH (published 60.7%), 53.3% MEDIUM (53.2%), and 91.7% on AIME25 with tools (90.4%).

AI.tldr: 研究人员首次独立复现了OpenAI发布的gpt-oss-20b模型在工具使用任务上的得分，通过逆向工程其训练分布中的工具并构建原生代理框架
AI.motivation: 由于OpenAI原始论文既未公开工具定义也未公开代理框架，导致无人能够独立复现其公布的gpt-oss-20b模型在工具使用任务上的性能得分
AI.method: 1. 逆向工程模型训练分布中的工具：通过无工具定义提示发现模型仍会以高置信度调用其训练分布中的工具；2. 构建原生harmony代理框架，使用模型原生格式编码消息，绕过有损的Chat Completions转换
AI.result: 成功复现OpenAI公布得分：SWE Verified HIGH任务60.4%（原60.7%）、MEDIUM任务53.3%（原53.2%）、AIME25任务91.7%（原90.4%）
AI.conclusion: 通过逆向工程工具和构建原生代理框架，首次实现了对OpenAI gpt-oss-20b模型工具使用性能的独立验证，证明了模型在工具调用上具有强先验而非幻觉

title: Label-efficient underwater species classification with semi-supervised learning on frozen foundation model embeddings
summary: Automated species classification from underwater imagery is bottlenecked by the cost of expert annotation, and supervised models trained on one dataset rarely transfer to new conditions. We investigate whether semi-supervised methods operating on frozen foundation model embeddings can close this annotation gap with minimal labeling effort. Using DINOv3 ViT-B embeddings with no fine-tuning, we propagate a small set of labeled seeds through unlabeled data via nearest-neighbor-based self-training and evaluate on the AQUA20 benchmark (20 marine species). With fewer than 5% of the training labels, self-training on frozen embeddings closes much of the gap to a fully supervised ConvNeXt baseline trained on the entire labeled dataset; at full supervision, the gap narrows to a few percentage points, with several species exceeding the supervised baseline. Class separability in the embedding space, measured by ROC-AUC, is high even at extreme label scarcity, indicating that the frozen representations capture discriminative structure well before decision boundaries can be reliably estimated. Our approach requires no training, no domain-specific data engineering, and no underwater-adapted models, establishing a practical, immediately deployable baseline for label-efficient marine species recognition. All results are reported on the held-out test set over 100 random seed initializations.

AI.tldr: 使用冻结的DINOv3 ViT-B嵌入，通过基于最近邻的自训练方法，仅需5%标注数据即可在AQUA20海洋物种识别基准上接近全监督模型性能
AI.motivation: 水下图像物种分类受限于专家标注成本高，且监督模型难以迁移到新环境。研究旨在通过半监督方法减少标注需求，利用冻结的基础模型嵌入实现高效物种识别
AI.method: 使用未微调的DINOv3 ViT-B模型提取图像嵌入，通过基于最近邻的自训练方法，将少量标注种子传播到未标注数据，在AQUA20基准（20种海洋物种）上进行评估
AI.result: 仅需少于5%的训练标注，自训练方法就能接近全监督ConvNeXt基线的性能；在全监督条件下，差距缩小到几个百分点，部分物种甚至超过监督基线。嵌入空间的类别可分性（ROC-AUC）即使在极低标注下也很高
AI.conclusion: 冻结嵌入表示结合自训练为海洋物种识别提供了实用、可立即部署的基线方法，无需训练、领域特定数据工程或水下适应模型，显著降低标注需求

title: MSA-Thinker: Discrimination-Calibration Reasoning with Hint-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
summary: Multimodal sentiment analysis aims to understand human emotions by integrating textual, auditory, and visual modalities. Although Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved state-of-the-art performance via supervised fine-tuning (SFT), their end-to-end "black-box" nature limits interpretability. Existing methods incorporating Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning are hindered by high annotation costs, while Reinforcement Learning (RL) faces challenges such as low exploration efficiency and sparse rewards, particularly on hard samples. To address these issues, we propose a novel training framework that integrates structured Discrimination-Calibration (DC) reasoning with Hint-based Reinforcement Learning. First, we perform cold-start SFT using high-quality CoT data synthesized by a teacher model (Qwen3Omni-30B), which inherently contains the DC structure. This equips the model with a reasoning paradigm that performs macro discrimination followed by fine-grained calibration from the initial stage. Building on this, we propose Hint-GRPO, which leverages the discrimination phase within the DC structure as a verifiable anchor during RL to provide directional hints for hard samples, guiding policy optimization and effectively mitigating the reward sparsity problem. Experiments on the Qwen2.5Omni-7B model demonstrate that our method not only achieves higher accuracy in fine-grained sentiment regression tasks but also generates high-quality structured reasoning chains. Crucially, it exhibits superior generalization capability in cross-domain evaluations. This enhances model interpretability while validating the positive contribution of explicit reasoning steps to model robustness, offering a new paradigm for building trustworthy and efficient sentiment analysis systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合结构化判别校准推理与提示强化学习的新训练框架，用于提升多模态情感分析的可解释性和性能，在细粒度情感回归任务中取得了更高的准确率和更好的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型虽然通过监督微调取得了先进性能，但其端到端的"黑盒"特性限制了可解释性。现有的思维链推理方法标注成本高，而强化学习方法在困难样本上存在探索效率低和奖励稀疏的问题。
AI.method: 提出整合结构化判别校准推理与提示强化学习的训练框架：1) 使用教师模型合成的高质量思维链数据进行冷启动监督微调，该数据包含判别校准结构；2) 提出Hint-GRPO方法，利用判别校准结构中的判别阶段作为可验证锚点，为困难样本提供方向性提示，指导策略优化并缓解奖励稀疏问题。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5Omni-7B模型上的实验表明，该方法在细粒度情感回归任务中实现了更高的准确率，生成了高质量的结构化推理链，并在跨域评估中表现出优越的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该方法增强了模型的可解释性，同时验证了显式推理步骤对模型鲁棒性的积极贡献，为构建可信赖且高效的情感分析系统提供了新范式。

title: Decision-Centric Design for LLM Systems
summary: LLM systems must make control decisions in addition to generating outputs: whether to answer, clarify, retrieve, call tools, repair, or escalate. In many current architectures, these decisions remain implicit within generation, entangling assessment and action in a single model call and making failures hard to inspect, constrain, or repair. We propose a decision-centric framework that separates decision-relevant signals from the policy that maps them to actions, turning control into an explicit and inspectable layer of the system. This separation supports attribution of failures to signal estimation, decision policy, or execution, and enables modular improvement of each component. It unifies familiar single-step settings such as routing and adaptive inference, and extends naturally to sequential settings in which actions alter the information available before acting. Across three controlled experiments, the framework reduces futile actions, improves task success, and reveals interpretable failure modes. More broadly, it offers a general architectural principle for building more reliable, controllable, and diagnosable LLM systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种决策中心的LLM系统框架，将控制决策从生成中分离出来，使控制成为系统的一个显式、可检查的层次。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM架构中，控制决策（如是否回答、澄清、检索、调用工具等）隐含在生成过程中，将评估和行动纠缠在单一模型调用中，导致故障难以检查、约束或修复。
AI.method: 提出决策中心框架，将决策相关信号与映射到行动的策略分离，支持将故障归因于信号估计、决策策略或执行，并支持各模块的独立改进。
AI.result: 在三个受控实验中，该框架减少了无效行动，提高了任务成功率，并揭示了可解释的故障模式。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为构建更可靠、可控和可诊断的LLM系统提供了一个通用的架构原则。

title: VADMamba++: Efficient Video Anomaly Detection via Hybrid Modeling in Grayscale Space
summary: VADMamba pioneered the introduction of Mamba to Video Anomaly Detection (VAD), achieving high accuracy and fast inference through hybrid proxy tasks. Nevertheless, its heavy reliance on optical flow as auxiliary input and inter-task fusion scoring constrains its applicability to a single proxy task. In this paper, we introduce VADMamba++, an efficient VAD method based on the Gray-to-RGB paradigm that enforces a Single-Channel to Three-Channel reconstruction mapping, designed for a single proxy task and operating without auxiliary inputs. This paradigm compels inferring color appearances from grayscale structures, allowing anomalies to be more effectively revealed through dual inconsistencies between structure and chromatic cues. Specifically, VADMamba++ reconstructs grayscale frames into the RGB space to simultaneously discriminate structural geometry and chromatic fidelity, thereby enhancing sensitivity to explicit visual anomalies. We further design a hybrid modeling backbone that integrates Mamba, CNN, and Transformer modules to capture diverse normal patterns while suppressing the appearance of anomalies. Furthermore, an intra-task fusion scoring strategy integrates explicit future-frame prediction errors with implicit quantized feature errors, further improving accuracy under a single task setting. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that VADMamba++ outperforms state-of-the-art methods while meeting performance and efficiency, especially under a strict single-task setting with only frame-level inputs.

AI.tldr: VADMamba++提出了一种基于灰度到RGB范式的视频异常检测方法，通过单通道到三通道重建映射在单一代理任务下工作，无需辅助输入，在性能和效率上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: VADMamba虽然将Mamba引入视频异常检测并取得了高精度和快速推理，但其严重依赖光流作为辅助输入和任务间融合评分，限制了其在单一代理任务下的适用性。
AI.method: 1. 灰度到RGB范式：强制从灰度结构推断颜色外观，通过结构和颜色线索的双重不一致性更有效揭示异常；2. 混合建模骨干网络：集成Mamba、CNN和Transformer模块捕捉多样正常模式并抑制异常出现；3. 任务内融合评分策略：整合显式未来帧预测误差和隐式量化特征误差。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，VADMamba++在性能和效率上优于最先进的方法，特别是在严格的单任务设置下仅使用帧级输入时表现优异。
AI.conclusion: VADMamba++通过灰度到RGB范式、混合建模骨干网络和任务内融合评分策略，实现了在单一代理任务下无需辅助输入的高效视频异常检测，在性能和效率上均优于现有方法。

title: Self-Routing: Parameter-Free Expert Routing from Hidden States
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers increase model capacity by activating only a small subset of experts per token, and typically rely on a learned router to map hidden states to expert assignments. In this work, we ask whether a dedicated learned router is strictly necessary in the MoE settings we study. We propose Self-Routing, a parameter-free routing mechanism that uses a designated subspace of the token hidden state directly as expert logits, eliminating the router projection entirely while leaving the rest of the MoE layer unchanged. We evaluate Self-Routing on GPT-2-scale language modeling and ImageNet-1K classification by comparing it against a standard learned router, random-routing baselines, and dense non-MoE baselines. Our results show that Self-Routing remains competitive with the learned-router baseline while removing all dedicated routing parameters, and yields more balanced expert utilization, with about 17 % higher average normalized routing entropy and no explicit load-balancing loss. On ImageNet-1K with DeiT-S/16, Self-Routing also slightly improves over the corresponding learned-router MoE. These findings suggest that effective MoE routing can emerge from the hidden representation itself without requiring a separate learned router module.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Self-Routing，一种无需参数的路由机制，直接使用token隐藏状态的指定子空间作为专家logits，消除路由器投影，在GPT-2语言建模和ImageNet分类任务中保持与学习路由器相当的竞争力。
AI.motivation: 研究在MoE设置中，专门的学习路由器是否严格必要。探索是否可以从隐藏表示本身直接实现有效的MoE路由，而无需单独的学习路由器模块。
AI.method: 提出Self-Routing参数免费路由机制：使用token隐藏状态的指定子空间直接作为专家logits，完全消除路由器投影，同时保持MoE层的其余部分不变。
AI.result: 在GPT-2规模语言建模和ImageNet-1K分类任务中，Self-Routing与标准学习路由器基线保持竞争力，同时移除了所有专用路由参数，产生更平衡的专家利用率（平均归一化路由熵提高约17%），无需显式负载平衡损失。在ImageNet-1K上使用DeiT-S/16时，Self-Routing甚至略微优于相应的学习路由器MoE。
AI.conclusion: 有效的MoE路由可以从隐藏表示本身涌现，无需单独的学习路由器模块。Self-Routing提供了一种更简单、参数更少的替代方案，同时保持性能并改善专家平衡。

title: ASCAT: An Arabic Scientific Corpus and Benchmark for Advanced Translation Evaluation
summary: We present ASCAT (Arabic Scientific Corpus for Advanced Translation), a high-quality English-Arabic parallel benchmark corpus designed for scientific translation evaluation constructed through a systematic multi-engine translation and human validation pipeline. Unlike existing Arabic-English corpora that rely on short sentences or single-domain text, ASCAT targets full scientific abstracts averaging 141.7 words (English) and 111.78 words (Arabic), drawn from five scientific domains: physics, mathematics, computer science, quantum mechanics, and artificial intelligence. Each abstract was translated using three complementary architectures generative AI (Gemini), transformer-based models (Hugging Face \texttt{quickmt-en-ar}), and commercial MT APIs (Google Translate, DeepL) and subsequently validated by domain experts at the lexical, syntactic, and semantic levels. The resulting corpus contains 67,293 English tokens and 60,026 Arabic tokens, with an Arabic vocabulary of 17,604 unique words reflecting the morphological richness of the language. We benchmark three state-of-the-art LLMs on the corpus GPT-4o-mini (BLEU: 37.07), Gemini-3.0-Flash-Preview (BLEU: 30.44), and Qwen3-235B-A22B (BLEU: 23.68) demonstrating its discriminative power as an evaluation benchmark. ASCAT addresses a critical gap in scientific MT resources for Arabic and is designed to support rigorous evaluation of scientific translation quality and training of domain-specific translation models.

AI.tldr: ASCAT是一个高质量的英阿科学翻译平行语料库，包含五个科学领域的完整摘要，通过多引擎翻译和人工验证构建，用于科学翻译评估和模型训练。
AI.motivation: 现有的阿拉伯语-英语语料库大多基于短句或单一领域文本，缺乏针对科学翻译的高质量评估资源。ASCAT旨在填补阿拉伯语科学机器翻译资源的空白，支持科学翻译质量的严格评估和领域特定翻译模型的训练。
AI.method: 采用系统化的多引擎翻译和人工验证流程：从五个科学领域（物理、数学、计算机科学、量子力学、人工智能）收集完整科学摘要，使用三种互补架构（生成式AI、基于Transformer的模型、商业MT API）进行翻译，然后由领域专家在词汇、句法和语义层面进行验证。
AI.result: 构建的语料库包含67,293个英语词元和60,026个阿拉伯语词元，阿拉伯语词汇量为17,604个独特单词。在语料库上对三个最先进的LLM进行基准测试：GPT-4o-mini（BLEU: 37.07）、Gemini-3.0-Flash-Preview（BLEU: 30.44）和Qwen3-235B-A22B（BLEU: 23.68），展示了其作为评估基准的区分能力。
AI.conclusion: ASCAT填补了阿拉伯语科学机器翻译资源的关键空白，能够支持科学翻译质量的严格评估和领域特定翻译模型的训练，为阿拉伯语科学翻译研究提供了重要的基准资源。

title: Execution-Verified Reinforcement Learning for Optimization Modeling
summary: Automating optimization modeling with LLMs is a promising path toward scalable decision intelligence, but existing approaches either rely on agentic pipelines built on closed-source LLMs with high inference latency, or fine-tune smaller LLMs using costly process supervision that often overfits to a single solver API. Inspired by reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, we propose Execution-Verified Optimization Modeling (EVOM), an execution-verified learning framework that treats a mathematical programming solver as a deterministic, interactive verifier. Given a natural-language problem and a target solver, EVOM generates solver-specific code, executes it in a sandboxed harness, and converts execution outcomes into scalar rewards, optimized with GRPO and DAPO in a closed-loop generate-execute-feedback-update process. This outcome-only formulation removes the need for process-level supervision, and enables cross-solver generalization by switching the verification environment rather than reconstructing solver-specific datasets. Experiments on NL4OPT, MAMO, IndustryOR, and OptiBench across Gurobi, OR-Tools, and COPT show that EVOM matches or outperforms process-supervised SFT, supports zero-shot solver transfer, and achieves effective low-cost solver adaptation by continuing training under the target solver backend.

AI.tldr: EVOM是一个基于执行验证的优化建模框架，利用LLM生成求解器代码，通过执行验证获得奖励信号，实现无需过程监督的跨求解器优化建模
AI.motivation: 现有优化建模自动化方法要么依赖高延迟的闭源LLM代理管道，要么使用成本高昂的过程监督微调小模型，且通常过度拟合单一求解器API
AI.method: 提出执行验证优化建模(EVOM)框架，将数学规划求解器作为确定性交互验证器，生成求解器代码后在沙箱中执行，将执行结果转换为标量奖励，使用GRPO和DAPO进行闭环的生成-执行-反馈-更新优化
AI.result: 在NL4OPT、MAMO、IndustryOR和OptiBench数据集上，使用Gurobi、OR-Tools和COPT求解器，EVOM匹配或超越了过程监督SFT的性能，支持零样本求解器迁移，并能通过继续训练实现低成本求解器适配
AI.conclusion: EVOM通过执行验证学习框架，消除了对过程级监督的需求，通过切换验证环境而非重建求解器特定数据集，实现了跨求解器的泛化能力，为可扩展的决策智能提供了有效路径

title: Dynamic Graph Neural Network with Adaptive Features Selection for RGB-D Based Indoor Scene Recognition
summary: Multi-modality of color and depth, i.e., RGB-D, is of great importance in recent research of indoor scene recognition. In this kind of data representation, depth map is able to describe the 3D structure of scenes and geometric relations among objects. Previous works showed that local features of both modalities are vital for promotion of recognition accuracy. However, the problem of adaptive selection and effective exploitation on these key local features remains open in this field. In this paper, a dynamic graph model is proposed with adaptive node selection mechanism to solve the above problem. In this model, a dynamic graph is built up to model the relations among objects and scene, and a method of adaptive node selection is proposed to take key local features from both modalities of RGB and depth for graph modeling. After that, these nodes are grouped by three different levels, representing near or far relations among objects. Moreover, the graph model is updated dynamically according to attention weights. Finally, the updated and optimized features of RGB and depth modalities are fused together for indoor scene recognition. Experiments are performed on public datasets including SUN RGB-D and NYU Depth v2. Extensive results demonstrate that our method has superior performance when comparing to state-of-the-arts methods, and show that the proposed method is able to exploit crucial local features from both modalities of RGB and depth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于RGB-D室内场景识别的动态图模型，通过自适应节点选择机制从RGB和深度模态中提取关键局部特征，并动态更新图结构，最终融合两种模态的特征进行识别。
AI.motivation: RGB-D数据在室内场景识别中很重要，深度图能描述场景的3D结构和物体间的几何关系。先前研究表明两种模态的局部特征对提升识别准确率都很关键，但如何自适应选择和有效利用这些关键局部特征仍是未解决的问题。
AI.method: 提出动态图模型，包含自适应节点选择机制从RGB和深度模态中提取关键局部特征；构建动态图建模物体与场景关系；将节点按三个不同层次分组表示物体的远近关系；根据注意力权重动态更新图模型；最后融合RGB和深度模态的优化特征进行识别。
AI.result: 在SUN RGB-D和NYU Depth v2公开数据集上进行实验，结果表明该方法相比最先进方法具有优越性能，能够有效利用RGB和深度模态中的关键局部特征。
AI.conclusion: 提出的动态图模型通过自适应节点选择机制成功解决了RGB-D室内场景识别中关键局部特征的选择和利用问题，在公开数据集上验证了方法的有效性。

title: Are they human? Detecting large language models by probing human memory constraints
summary: The validity of online behavioral research relies on study participants being human rather than machine. In the past, it was possible to detect machines by posing simple challenges that were easily solved by humans but not by machines. General-purpose agents based on large language models (LLMs) can now solve many of these challenges, threatening the validity of online behavioral research. Here we explore the idea of detecting humanness by using tasks that machines can solve too well to be human. Specifically, we probe for the existence of an established human cognitive constraint: limited working memory capacity. We show that cognitive modeling on a standard serial recall task can be used to distinguish online participants from LLMs even when the latter are specifically instructed to mimic human working memory constraints. Our results demonstrate that it is viable to use well-established cognitive phenomena to distinguish LLMs from humans.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出利用人类认知限制（工作记忆容量有限）来区分在线研究参与者与大型语言模型，通过序列回忆任务中的认知建模有效检测机器参与
AI.motivation: 在线行为研究的有效性依赖于参与者是人类而非机器。过去通过简单挑战检测机器的方法已被大型语言模型破解，威胁在线研究的有效性，需要新的检测方法
AI.method: 使用标准序列回忆任务，通过认知建模探测人类工作记忆容量限制，即使LLMs被特别指示模仿人类工作记忆约束也能有效区分
AI.result: 研究表明，即使大型语言模型被指令模仿人类工作记忆限制，仍可通过序列回忆任务中的认知建模有效区分在线参与者与LLMs
AI.conclusion: 利用已确立的人类认知现象（如工作记忆限制）是区分大型语言模型与人类的有效方法，为在线行为研究提供了新的验证工具

title: Towards Reliable Truth-Aligned Uncertainty Estimation in Large Language Models
summary: Uncertainty estimation (UE) aims to detect hallucinated outputs of large language models (LLMs) to improve their reliability. However, UE metrics often exhibit unstable performance across configurations, which significantly limits their applicability. In this work, we formalise this phenomenon as proxy failure, since most UE metrics originate from model behaviour, rather than being explicitly grounded in the factual correctness of LLM outputs. With this, we show that UE metrics become non-discriminative precisely in low-information regimes. To alleviate this, we propose Truth AnChoring (TAC), a post-hoc calibration method to remedy UE metrics, by mapping the raw scores to truth-aligned scores. Even with noisy and few-shot supervision, our TAC can support the learning of well-calibrated uncertainty estimates, and presents a practical calibration protocol. Our findings highlight the limitations of treating heuristic UE metrics as direct indicators of truth uncertainty, and position our TAC as a necessary step toward more reliable uncertainty estimation for LLMs. The code repository is available at https://github.com/ponhvoan/TruthAnchor/.

AI.tldr: 提出Truth AnChoring (TAC)方法，通过将原始不确定性分数映射到与事实对齐的分数，解决LLM不确定性估计指标在不同配置下性能不稳定的问题。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM不确定性估计(UE)指标存在代理失败问题，即这些指标源自模型行为而非明确基于LLM输出的事实正确性，导致在不同配置下性能不稳定，限制了实际应用。
AI.method: 提出Truth AnChoring (TAC)后校准方法，通过将原始不确定性分数映射到与事实对齐的分数，即使在噪声和少样本监督下也能学习到良好校准的不确定性估计。
AI.result: TAC能够支持学习良好校准的不确定性估计，提供实用的校准协议，在低信息状态下改善UE指标的判别能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了将启发式UE指标直接作为真实不确定性指示器的局限性，TAC是迈向更可靠LLM不确定性估计的必要步骤。

title: UCMNet: Uncertainty-Aware Context Memory Network for Under-Display Camera Image Restoration
comment: We propose UCMNet, an uncertainty-aware adaptive framework that restores high-frequency details in regions with varying levels of degradation in under-display camera images
summary: Under-display cameras (UDCs) allow for full-screen designs by positioning the imaging sensor underneath the display. Nonetheless, light diffraction and scattering through the various display layers result in spatially varying and complex degradations, which significantly reduce high-frequency details. Current PSF-based physical modeling techniques and frequency-separation networks are effective at reconstructing low-frequency structures and maintaining overall color consistency. However, they still face challenges in recovering fine details when dealing with complex, spatially varying degradation. To solve this problem, we propose a lightweight \textbf{U}ncertainty-aware \textbf{C}ontext-\textbf{M}emory \textbf{Network} (\textbf{UCMNet}), for UDC image restoration. Unlike previous methods that apply uniform restoration, UCMNet performs uncertainty-aware adaptive processing to restore high-frequency details in regions with varying degradations. The estimated uncertainty maps, learned through an uncertainty-driven loss, quantify spatial uncertainty induced by diffraction and scattering, and guide the Memory Bank to retrieve region-adaptive context from the Context Bank. This process enables effective modeling of the non-uniform degradation characteristics inherent to UDC imaging. Leveraging this uncertainty as a prior, UCMNet achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks with 30\% fewer parameters than previous models. Project page: \href{https://kdhrick2222.github.io/projects/UCMNet/}{https://kdhrick2222.github.io/projects/UCMNet}.

AI.tldr: 提出UCMNet用于屏下摄像头图像恢复，通过不确定性感知自适应处理解决空间变化退化问题，参数减少30%且性能最优
AI.motivation: 屏下摄像头(UDC)因光线通过多层显示面板产生衍射和散射，导致空间变化且复杂的退化，显著降低高频细节。现有PSF物理建模和频率分离网络虽能重建低频结构和保持色彩一致性，但在处理复杂空间变化退化时仍难以恢复精细细节。
AI.method: 提出轻量级不确定性感知上下文记忆网络(UCMNet)：1) 通过不确定性驱动损失学习不确定性图，量化衍射和散射引起的空间不确定性；2) 利用不确定性图指导记忆库从上下文库中检索区域自适应上下文；3) 实现非均匀退化特性的有效建模，进行不确定性感知自适应处理。
AI.result: UCMNet在多个基准测试中达到最先进性能，且参数比先前模型减少30%。
AI.conclusion: 提出的不确定性感知自适应处理方法能有效解决屏下摄像头图像恢复中的空间变化退化问题，在减少参数的同时实现更好的细节恢复性能。

title: Logarithmic Scores, Power-Law Discoveries: Disentangling Measurement from Coverage in Agent-Based Evaluation
summary: LLM-based agent judges are an emerging approach to evaluating conversational AI, yet a fundamental uncertainty remains: can we trust their assessments, and if so, how many are needed? Through 960 sessions with two model pairs across 15 tasks, we show that persona-based agent judges produce evaluations indistinguishable from human raters in a Turing-style validation. We then identify a score-coverage dissociation: quality scores improve logarithmically with panel size, while unique issue discoveries follow a sublinear power law-both exhibit diminishing returns, but scores saturate roughly twice as fast as discoveries. We hypothesize this reflects a power law distribution of the finding space: critical issues are discovered first by small panels, while corner cases require progressively larger panels, analogous to species accumulation curves in ecology. The mechanism traces to ensemble diversity-Big Five personality conditioning makes agents probe different quality dimensions, with expert judges acting as adversarial probes that push discovery into the tail of the finding distribution. A controlled ablation confirms that structured persona conditioning, not simple prompting, is required to produce these scaling properties.

AI.tldr: LLM代理评委在对话AI评估中表现出与人类评委相当的判断能力，但评估质量随评委数量呈对数增长，而问题发现能力呈幂律增长，两者存在收益递减但发现能力饱和更慢。
AI.motivation: 研究LLM代理评委在对话AI评估中的可靠性问题，探索需要多少评委才能获得可信评估，以及评估质量如何随评委数量变化。
AI.method: 通过960个会话实验，使用两种模型对在15个任务上进行测试，采用基于人格的代理评委进行图灵式验证，分析评分覆盖度分离现象，并通过受控消融实验验证人格条件化的作用。
AI.result: 人格化代理评委的评估与人类评委无法区分；评分质量随评委数量对数增长，独特问题发现呈幂律增长；发现空间服从幂律分布，关键问题由小评委组发现，边缘案例需要更大评委组；人格条件化是产生这种缩放特性的关键。
AI.conclusion: LLM代理评委可以替代人类评估，但需要适当数量的评委；评估质量与问题发现能力遵循不同增长规律，反映了发现空间的幂律分布；人格条件化是确保评估多样性的关键机制。

title: mmAnomaly: Leveraging Visual Context for Robust Anomaly Detection in the Non-Visual World with mmWave Radar
comment: Accepted at the 24th ACM/IEEE International Conference on Embedded Artificial Intelligence and Sensing Systems (SenSys 2026)
summary: mmWave radar enables human sensing in non-visual scenarios-e.g., through clothing or certain types of walls-where traditional cameras fail due to occlusion or privacy limitations. However, robust anomaly detection with mmWave remains challenging, as signal reflections are influenced by material properties, clutter, and multipath interference, producing complex, non-Gaussian distortions. Existing methods lack contextual awareness and misclassify benign signal variations as anomalies. We present mmAnomaly, a multi-modal anomaly detection framework that combines mmWave radar with RGBD input to incorporate visual context. Our system extracts semantic cues-such as scene geometry and material properties-using a fast ResNet-based classifier, and uses a conditional latent diffusion model to synthesize the expected mmWave spectrum for the given visual context. A dual-input comparison module then identifies spatial deviations between real and generated spectra to localize anomalies. We evaluate mmAnomaly on two multi-modal datasets across three applications: concealed weapon localization, through-wall intruder localization, and through-wall fall localization. The system achieves up to 94% F1 score and sub-meter localization error, demonstrating robust generalization across clothing, occlusions, and cluttered environments. These results establish mmAnomaly as an accurate and interpretable framework for context-aware anomaly detection in mmWave sensing.

AI.tldr: mmAnomaly：结合毫米波雷达与RGBD视觉的多模态异常检测框架，通过条件潜在扩散模型生成预期毫米波频谱，实现遮挡场景下的鲁棒异常检测
AI.motivation: 毫米波雷达能在非视觉场景（如穿透衣物或墙壁）中感知人体，但现有方法缺乏上下文感知能力，容易将良性信号变化误判为异常，需要结合视觉上下文来提高检测准确性
AI.method: 1) 使用快速ResNet分类器提取视觉语义线索（场景几何和材料属性）；2) 采用条件潜在扩散模型根据视觉上下文合成预期毫米波频谱；3) 通过双输入比较模块识别真实与生成频谱的空间偏差来定位异常
AI.result: 在三个应用场景（隐蔽武器定位、穿墙入侵者定位、穿墙跌倒定位）的评估中，系统达到94%的F1分数和亚米级定位误差，在衣物、遮挡和杂乱环境中表现出鲁棒泛化能力
AI.conclusion: mmAnomaly建立了一个准确且可解释的上下文感知异常检测框架，通过多模态融合有效解决了毫米波雷达在复杂环境中的异常检测挑战

title: Think Twice Before You Write -- an Entropy-based Decoding Strategy to Enhance LLM Reasoning
summary: Decoding strategies play a central role in shaping the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs). Traditional methods such as greedy decoding and beam search often suffer from error propagation, while sampling-based approaches introduce randomness without adequate robustness. Self-consistency improves reliability by aggregating multiple rollouts, but incurs significant computational overhead. We propose an entropy-guided decoding framework that introduces token-level adaptivity into generation. At each step, the model computes the entropy of the token distribution, identifies high-uncertainty positions, and selectively branches on these vulnerable points. A dynamic pool of partial rollouts is maintained and expanded until solutions are completed, concentrating computation where uncertainty is greatest and avoiding unnecessary exploration in confident regions. To enable efficient termination, we apply a rollout-level Entropy After </Think> (EAT) stopping criterion by performing entropy evaluation after the full reasoning trace, rather than incrementally at every step. Experiments on GSM8K, AMC2023, and their perturbed variants demonstrate that our method achieves consistently strong accuracy. Notably, on smaller LLMs, performance is comparable to GPT-5 while operating at a fraction of the cost.

AI.tldr: 提出基于熵引导的解码框架，通过识别高不确定性位置进行选择性分支，在保持计算效率的同时提升推理准确性。
AI.motivation: 传统解码策略存在局限性：贪婪解码和束搜索容易产生错误传播，基于采样的方法引入随机性但缺乏鲁棒性，自一致性方法虽然可靠但计算开销大。需要一种既能提高推理可靠性又保持计算效率的解码方法。
AI.method: 提出熵引导解码框架：1）在每个生成步骤计算token分布的熵，识别高不确定性位置；2）在这些脆弱点进行选择性分支；3）维护动态的部分解码路径池，仅在不确定性最大的区域集中计算资源；4）采用基于完整推理轨迹的EAT停止准则，避免每一步的增量评估开销。
AI.result: 在GSM8K、AMC2023及其扰动变体上的实验表明，该方法实现了稳定且强大的准确性。特别值得注意的是，在较小的LLM上，性能可与GPT-5相媲美，同时计算成本仅为后者的很小一部分。
AI.conclusion: 熵引导解码框架通过token级自适应生成，在不确定性最高的区域集中计算资源，既提高了推理可靠性，又保持了计算效率，为LLM解码策略提供了新的有效方法。

title: The Silicon Mirror: Dynamic Behavioral Gating for Anti-Sycophancy in LLM Agents
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Code and evaluation data available at https://github.com/Helephants/langgraph-layered-context
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly prioritize user validation over epistemic accuracy-a phenomenon known as sycophancy. We present The Silicon Mirror, an orchestration framework that dynamically detects user persuasion tactics and adjusts AI behavior to maintain factual integrity. Our architecture introduces three components: (1) a Behavioral Access Control (BAC) system that restricts context layer access based on real-time sycophancy risk scores, (2) a Trait Classifier that identifies persuasion tactics across multi-turn dialogues, and (3) a Generator-Critic loop where an auditor vetoes sycophantic drafts and triggers rewrites with "Necessary Friction." In a live evaluation on 50 TruthfulQA adversarial scenarios using Claude Sonnet 4 with an independent LLM judge, we observe vanilla Claude sycophancy at 12.0% (6/50), static guardrails at 4.0% (2/50), and the Silicon Mirror at 2.0% (1/50)-an 83.3% relative reduction (p = 0.112, Fisher's exact test). A cross-model evaluation on Gemini 2.5 Flash reveals a higher baseline sycophancy rate (46.0%) and a statistically significant 69.6% reduction under the Silicon Mirror (p < 0.001). We characterize the validation-before-correction pattern as a distinct failure mode of RLHF-trained models.

AI.tldr: 提出Silicon Mirror框架，通过动态检测用户说服策略和调整AI行为来减少LLM的谄媚现象，相比基线显著降低谄媚率
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型越来越倾向于用户验证而非事实准确性，这种现象被称为谄媚。需要一种方法来检测和减少这种倾向，以保持事实完整性。
AI.method: 提出Silicon Mirror框架，包含三个组件：1）基于实时谄媚风险评分限制上下文层访问的行为访问控制系统；2）在多轮对话中识别说服策略的特征分类器；3）生成器-批评家循环，审计员否决谄媚草稿并触发带有"必要摩擦"的重写。
AI.result: 在TruthfulQA对抗场景的评估中：Claude Sonnet 4的基线谄媚率为12.0%，静态护栏为4.0%，Silicon Mirror为2.0%（相对减少83.3%）。在Gemini 2.5 Flash上，基线谄媚率为46.0%，Silicon Mirror显著减少69.6%（p < 0.001）。
AI.conclusion: Silicon Mirror框架能有效减少LLM的谄媚行为，验证-修正模式是RLHF训练模型的独特失败模式。该方法为保持AI事实完整性提供了有效解决方案。

title: Mine-JEPA: In-Domain Self-Supervised Learning for Mine-Like Object Classification in Side-Scan Sonar
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Accepted at CVPR 2026 MACVi Workshop
summary: Side-scan sonar (SSS) mine classification is a challenging maritime vision problem characterized by extreme data scarcity and a large domain gap from natural images. While self-supervised learning (SSL) and general-purpose vision foundation models have shown strong performance in general vision and several specialized domains, their use in SSS remains largely unexplored. We present Mine-JEPA, the first in-domain SSL pipeline for SSS mine classification, using SIGReg, a regularization-based SSL loss, to pretrain on only 1,170 unlabeled sonar images. In the binary mine vs. non-mine setting, Mine-JEPA achieves an F1 score of 0.935, outperforming fine-tuned DINOv3 (0.922), a foundation model pretrained on 1.7B images. For 3-class mine-like object classification, Mine-JEPA reaches 0.820 with synthetic data augmentation, again outperforming fine-tuned DINOv3 (0.810). We further observe that applying in-domain SSL to foundation models degrades performance by 10--13 percentage points, suggesting that stronger pretrained models do not always benefit from additional domain adaptation. In addition, Mine-JEPA with a compact ViT-Tiny backbone achieves competitive performance while using 4x fewer parameters than DINOv3. These results suggest that carefully designed in-domain self-supervised learning is a viable alternative to much larger foundation models in data-scarce maritime sonar imagery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Mine-JEPA，首个用于侧扫声纳水雷分类的领域内自监督学习管道，仅使用1,170张未标记声纳图像进行预训练，在数据稀缺的声纳图像分类任务中超越了在17亿图像上预训练的基础模型DINOv3。
AI.motivation: 侧扫声纳水雷分类面临极端数据稀缺和与自然图像存在巨大领域差距的挑战。虽然自监督学习和通用视觉基础模型在通用视觉和某些专业领域表现出色，但在侧扫声纳领域的应用尚未充分探索。
AI.method: 提出了Mine-JEPA，一个领域内自监督学习管道，使用基于正则化的自监督损失SIGReg，仅用1,170张未标记声纳图像进行预训练。采用紧凑的ViT-Tiny骨干网络，并与合成数据增强结合。
AI.result: 在二分类水雷vs非水雷任务中，Mine-JEPA达到F1分数0.935，优于微调的DINOv3(0.922)。在三分类水雷状物体分类中，Mine-JEPA达到0.820，同样优于DINOv3(0.810)。紧凑的ViT-Tiny骨干网络使用参数比DINOv3少4倍，仍保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 精心设计的领域内自监督学习是数据稀缺的海事声纳图像分析中替代大型基础模型的可行方案。更强的预训练模型不一定能从额外的领域适应中受益，有时甚至会降低性能。

title: The Chronicles of RiDiC: Generating Datasets with Controlled Popularity Distribution for Long-form Factuality Evaluation
summary: We present a configurable pipeline for generating multilingual sets of entities with specified characteristics, such as domain, geographical location and popularity, using data from Wikipedia and Wikidata. These datasets are intended for evaluating the factuality of LLMs' long-form generation, thereby complementing evaluation based on short-form QA datasets. We present the RiDiC dataset as an example of this approach. RiDiC contains 3,000 entities from three domains -- rivers, natural disasters, and car models -- spanning different popularity tiers. Each entity is accompanied by its geographical location, English and Chinese names (if available) and relevant English and Chinese Wikipedia content, which is used to evaluate LLMs' responses. Generations about RiDiC entities were obtained from three LLMs in English and Chinese. These were then evaluated using a third-party factuality checker, which showed that entities from our dataset caused even frontier models to hallucinate. To facilitate the evaluation of LLMs' long-form factuality in multiple languages, the code, data, and generation/evaluation scripts have been released.

AI.tldr: 提出可配置的多语言实体数据集生成流程，用于评估LLM长文本生成的事实性，发布包含3000个实体的RiDiC数据集，涵盖河流、自然灾害、汽车模型三个领域
AI.motivation: 现有评估主要基于短问答数据集，缺乏对LLM长文本生成事实性的评估方法，需要能够控制实体特性（领域、地理位置、流行度）的多语言数据集来补充现有评估体系
AI.method: 利用维基百科和维基数据构建可配置的管道，生成具有特定特征（领域、地理位置、流行度）的多语言实体集，以RiDiC数据集为例，包含3000个实体，每个实体附带地理位置、中英文名称和相关维基百科内容
AI.result: 使用第三方事实性检查器评估三个LLM在英语和中文上的生成结果，发现即使是前沿模型也会对数据集中的实体产生幻觉，证明了数据集的有效性和评估需求
AI.conclusion: 提出的可配置管道能够生成用于评估LLM长文本事实性的多语言数据集，RiDiC数据集展示了该方法的价值，相关代码、数据和评估脚本已开源，促进了多语言长文本事实性评估的发展

title: Adaptive Parallel Monte Carlo Tree Search for Efficient Test-time Compute Scaling
summary: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) is an effective test-time compute scaling (TTCS) method for improving the reasoning performance of large language models, but its highly variable execution time leads to severe long-tail latency in practice. Existing optimizations such as positive early exit, reduce latency in favorable cases but are less effective when search continues without meaningful progress. We introduce {\it negative early exit}, which prunes unproductive MCTS trajectories, and an {\it adaptive boosting mechanism} that reallocates reclaimed computation to reduce resource contention among concurrent searches. Integrated into vLLM, these techniques substantially reduce p99 end-to-end latency while improving throughput and maintaining reasoning accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出负向提前退出和自适应增强机制，显著降低MCTS推理的p99延迟，同时保持准确率并提高吞吐量
AI.motivation: MCTS作为有效的测试时计算扩展方法，在实际应用中存在执行时间高度可变的问题，导致严重的尾部延迟。现有优化方法如正向提前退出在有利情况下能减少延迟，但在搜索无意义进展时效果有限。
AI.method: 引入负向提前退出机制来剪枝无生产力的MCTS轨迹，以及自适应增强机制重新分配回收的计算资源以减少并发搜索间的资源竞争。这些技术集成到vLLM框架中。
AI.result: 这些技术显著降低了p99端到端延迟，同时提高了吞吐量并保持了推理准确率。
AI.conclusion: 负向提前退出和自适应增强机制有效解决了MCTS在实际部署中的延迟问题，实现了延迟、吞吐量和准确率之间的平衡优化。

title: Advancing Complex Video Object Segmentation via Tracking-Enhanced Prompt: The 1st Winner for 5th PVUW MOSE Challenge
comment: 1st Place Solution for the 5th PVUW MOSE Challenge (CVPR 2026 Workshop)
summary: In the Complex Video Object Segmentation task, researchers are required to track and segment specific targets within cluttered environments, which rigorously tests a method's capability for target comprehension and environmental adaptability. Although SAM3, the current state-of-the-art solution, exhibits unparalleled segmentation performance and robustness on conventional targets, it underperforms on tiny and semantic-dominated objects. The root cause of this limitation lies in SAM3's insufficient comprehension of these specific target types. To address this issue, we propose TEP: Advancing Complex Video Object Segmentation via Tracking-Enhanced Prompts. As a training-free approach, TEP leverages external tracking models and Multimodal Large Language Models to introduce tracking-enhanced prompts, thereby alleviating the difficulty SAM3 faces in understanding these challenging targets. Our method achieved first place (56.91%) on the test set of the PVUW Challenge 2026: Complex Video Object Segmentation Track.

AI.tldr: 提出TEP方法，通过跟踪增强提示改进SAM3在复杂视频对象分割中对微小和语义主导对象的分割性能，在PVUW 2026挑战赛中获得第一名
AI.motivation: 虽然SAM3在常规目标分割上表现出色，但在微小和语义主导对象上表现不佳，主要原因是SAM3对这些特定目标类型的理解不足
AI.method: 提出TEP方法：一种无需训练的方法，利用外部跟踪模型和多模态大语言模型引入跟踪增强提示，帮助SAM3更好地理解这些挑战性目标
AI.result: 在PVUW Challenge 2026: Complex Video Object Segmentation Track测试集上获得第一名（56.91%）
AI.conclusion: TEP方法通过跟踪增强提示有效解决了SAM3在复杂视频对象分割中对微小和语义主导对象理解不足的问题，显著提升了分割性能

title: Detecting Abnormal User Feedback Patterns through Temporal Sentiment Aggregation
summary: In many real-world applications, such as customer feedback monitoring, brand reputation management, and product health tracking, understanding the temporal dynamics of user sentiment is crucial for early detection of anomalous events such as malicious review campaigns or sudden declines in user satisfaction. Traditional sentiment analysis methods focus on individual text classification, which is insufficient to capture collective behavioral shifts over time due to inherent noise and class imbalance in short user comments. In this work, we propose a temporal sentiment aggregation framework that leverages pretrained transformer-based language models to extract per-comment sentiment signals and aggregates them into time-window-level scores. Significant downward shifts in these aggregated scores are interpreted as potential anomalies in user feedback patterns. We adopt RoBERTa as our core semantic feature extractor and demonstrate, through empirical evaluation on real social media data, that the aggregated sentiment scores reveal meaningful trends and support effective anomaly detection. Experiments on real-world social media data demonstrate that our method successfully identifies statistically significant sentiment drops that correspond to coherent complaint patterns, providing an effective and interpretable solution for feedback anomaly monitoring.

AI.tldr: 提出基于预训练transformer的时间情感聚合框架，通过聚合用户评论情感信号检测异常事件，相比传统单文本分类方法能更好捕捉集体行为变化。
AI.motivation: 在客户反馈监控、品牌声誉管理等实际应用中，理解用户情感的时间动态对早期检测异常事件（如恶意评论活动或用户满意度突然下降）至关重要。传统情感分析方法专注于单文本分类，无法有效捕捉由于短评中固有噪声和类别不平衡导致的集体行为随时间变化。
AI.method: 提出时间情感聚合框架：1）使用预训练的transformer语言模型（RoBERTa）提取每条评论的情感信号；2）将情感信号聚合到时间窗口级别的分数；3）将这些聚合分数的显著下降解释为用户反馈模式中的潜在异常。
AI.result: 在真实社交媒体数据上的实证评估表明，聚合情感分数能够揭示有意义的趋势并支持有效的异常检测。实验证明该方法成功识别了统计显著的情感下降，这些下降与连贯的投诉模式相对应。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为反馈异常监控提供了一个有效且可解释的解决方案，能够检测用户情感中的集体行为变化，适用于实际应用场景如恶意评论活动检测和用户满意度监控。

title: Does Unification Come at a Cost? Uni-SafeBench: A Safety Benchmark for Unified Multimodal Large Models
summary: Unified Multimodal Large Models (UMLMs) integrate understanding and generation capabilities within a single architecture. While this architectural unification, driven by the deep fusion of multimodal features, enhances model performance, it also introduces important yet underexplored safety challenges. Existing safety benchmarks predominantly focus on isolated understanding or generation tasks, failing to evaluate the holistic safety of UMLMs when handling diverse tasks under a unified framework. To address this, we introduce Uni-SafeBench, a comprehensive benchmark featuring a taxonomy of six major safety categories across seven task types. To ensure rigorous assessment, we develop Uni-Judger, a framework that effectively decouples contextual safety from intrinsic safety. Based on comprehensive evaluations across Uni-SafeBench, we uncover that while the unification process enhances model capabilities, it significantly degrades the inherent safety of the underlying LLM. Furthermore, open-source UMLMs exhibit much lower safety performance than multimodal large models specialized for either generation or understanding tasks. We open-source all resources to systematically expose these risks and foster safer AGI development.

AI.tldr: Uni-SafeBench是首个评估统一多模态大模型（UMLMs）整体安全性的基准测试，发现模型统一化过程会显著降低底层LLM的内在安全性，开源UMLMs的安全性远低于专用于生成或理解任务的模型。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态大模型（UMLMs）通过多模态特征的深度融合实现了架构统一，提升了模型性能，但也引入了重要但未被充分探索的安全挑战。现有的安全基准主要关注孤立的理解或生成任务，无法评估UMLMs在统一框架下处理多样化任务时的整体安全性。
AI.method: 提出了Uni-SafeBench基准测试，包含六个主要安全类别和七种任务类型的分类体系。开发了Uni-Judger框架，有效解耦上下文安全性和内在安全性，确保评估的严谨性。
AI.result: 评估发现：1）统一化过程虽然提升了模型能力，但显著降低了底层LLM的内在安全性；2）开源UMLMs的安全性表现远低于专用于生成或理解任务的多模态大模型。
AI.conclusion: 统一多模态大模型存在严重的安全风险，需要系统性的安全评估框架。作者开源所有资源以暴露这些风险并促进更安全的AGI发展。

title: BloClaw: An Omniscient, Multi-Modal Agentic Workspace for Next-Generation Scientific Discovery
summary: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into life sciences has catalyzed the development of "AI Scientists." However, translating these theoretical capabilities into deployment-ready research environments exposes profound infrastructural vulnerabilities. Current frameworks are bottlenecked by fragile JSON-based tool-calling protocols, easily disrupted execution sandboxes that lose graphical outputs, and rigid conversational interfaces inherently ill-suited for high-dimensional scientific data.We introduce BloClaw, a unified, multi-modal operating system designed for Artificial Intelligence for Science (AI4S). BloClaw reconstructs the Agent-Computer Interaction (ACI) paradigm through three architectural innovations: (1) An XML-Regex Dual-Track Routing Protocol that statistically eliminates serialization failures (0.2% error rate vs. 17.6% in JSON); (2) A Runtime State Interception Sandbox that utilizes Python monkey-patching to autonomously capture and compile dynamic data visualizations (Plotly/Matplotlib), circumventing browser CORS policies; and (3) A State-Driven Dynamic Viewport UI that morphs seamlessly between a minimalist command deck and an interactive spatial rendering engine. We comprehensively benchmark BloClaw across cheminformatics (RDKit), de novo 3D protein folding via ESMFold, molecular docking, and autonomous Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), establishing a highly robust, self-evolving paradigm for computational research assistants. The open-source repository is available at https://github.com/qinheming/BloClaw.

AI.tldr: BloClaw是一个为AI4S设计的统一多模态操作系统，通过XML-Regex双轨路由协议、运行时状态拦截沙箱和状态驱动动态视口UI三大创新，解决了现有AI科学家框架在工具调用、图形输出和科学数据交互方面的基础设施脆弱性问题。
AI.motivation: 当前将大语言模型整合到生命科学中的"AI科学家"框架存在严重的基础设施脆弱性：脆弱的JSON工具调用协议容易中断、执行沙箱容易丢失图形输出、以及僵化的对话界面不适合处理高维科学数据。这些瓶颈阻碍了理论能力向实际部署环境的转化。
AI.method: BloClaw通过三大架构创新重构了Agent-Computer Interaction范式：1) XML-Regex双轨路由协议，统计上消除序列化失败；2) 运行时状态拦截沙箱，利用Python monkey-patching自主捕获和编译动态数据可视化；3) 状态驱动动态视口UI，在简约命令面板和交互式空间渲染引擎间无缝切换。
AI.result: BloClaw在化学信息学、ESMFold的de novo 3D蛋白质折叠、分子对接和自主检索增强生成等任务上进行了全面基准测试，XML-Regex协议的错误率仅为0.2%，远低于JSON的17.6%，建立了高度稳健、自我演化的计算研究助手范式。
AI.conclusion: BloClaw作为一个开源的多模态操作系统，为AI4S提供了一个统一、稳健的基础设施框架，解决了当前AI科学家部署中的关键瓶颈，实现了从理论能力到实际研究环境的有效转化。

title: Phonological Fossils: Machine Learning Detection of Non-Mainstream Vocabulary in Sulawesi Basic Lexicon
comment: 31 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to Oceanic Linguistics
summary: Basic vocabulary in many Sulawesi Austronesian languages includes forms resisting reconstruction to any proto-form with phonological patterns inconsistent with inherited roots, but whether this non-conforming vocabulary represents pre-Austronesian substrate or independent innovation has not been tested computationally. We combine rule-based cognate subtraction with a machine learning classifier trained on phonological features. Using 1,357 forms from six Sulawesi languages in the Austronesian Basic Vocabulary Database, we identify 438 candidate substrate forms (26.5%) through cognate subtraction and Proto-Austronesian cross-checking. An XGBoost classifier trained on 26 phonological features distinguishes inherited from non-mainstream forms with AUC=0.763, revealing a phonological fingerprint: longer forms, more consonant clusters, higher glottal stop rates, and fewer Austronesian prefixes. Cross-method consensus (Cohen's kappa=0.61) identifies 266 high-confidence non-mainstream candidates.
