However, clustering yields no coherent word families (silhouette=0.114; cross-linguistic cognate test p=0.569), providing no evidence for a single pre-Austronesian language layer. Application to 16 additional languages confirms geographic patterning: Sulawesi languages show higher predicted non-mainstream rates (mean P_sub=0.606) than Western Indonesian languages (0.393). This study demonstrates that phonological machine learning can complement traditional comparative methods in detecting non-mainstream lexical layers, while cautioning against interpreting phonological non-conformity as evidence for a shared substrate language.

AI.tldr: 使用机器学习方法分析苏拉威西南岛语系语言中的非主流词汇层，发现26.5%的词汇可能是底层语言残留，但缺乏证据支持单一的前南岛语底层语言。
AI.motivation: 苏拉威西南岛语系语言中存在大量无法重构到原始南岛语且音系模式不一致的基本词汇，这些非主流词汇究竟是前南岛语底层语言残留还是独立创新，尚未通过计算方法验证。
AI.method: 结合基于规则的同源词减法与机器学习分类器：1）使用南岛语基本词汇数据库中的1,357个词形，通过同源词减法和原始南岛语交叉检查识别候选底层词形；2）训练XGBoost分类器，基于26个音系特征区分继承词与非主流词；3）通过跨方法一致性分析确定高置信度非主流候选词；4）应用聚类分析检验是否存在统一的底层语言层。
AI.result: 1）识别出438个候选底层词形（26.5%）；2）XGBoost分类器AUC=0.763，发现非主流词具有更长词形、更多辅音丛、更高喉塞音频率和更少南岛语前缀的音系特征；3）跨方法共识确定266个高置信度非主流候选词；4）聚类分析显示无统一词族结构（轮廓系数=0.114；跨语言同源检验p=0.569），不支持单一前南岛语底层语言；5）地理分布显示苏拉威西语言预测非主流词率（平均0.606）高于西印尼语言（0.393）。
AI.conclusion: 音系机器学习可作为传统比较方法的补充工具检测非主流词汇层，但音系不一致性不能作为共享底层语言的证据。研究揭示了苏拉威西语言中显著的非主流词汇层，但缺乏统一底层语言的证据，表明这些词汇可能来自多个来源或独立创新。

title: Agent psychometrics: Task-level performance prediction in agentic coding benchmarks
summary: As the focus in LLM-based coding shifts from static single-step code generation to multi-step agentic interaction with tools and environments, understanding which tasks will challenge agents and why becomes increasingly difficult. This is compounded by current practice: agent performance is typically measured by aggregate pass rates on benchmarks, but single-number metrics obscure the diversity of tasks within a benchmark. We present a framework for predicting success or failure on individual tasks tailored to the agentic coding regime. Our approach augments Item Response Theory (IRT) with rich features extracted from tasks, including issue statements, repository contexts, solutions, and test cases, and introduces a novel decomposition of agent ability into LLM and scaffold ability components. This parameterization enables us to aggregate evaluation data across heterogeneous leaderboards and accurately predict task-level performance for unseen benchmarks, as well as unseen LLM-scaffold combinations. Our methods have practical utility for benchmark designers, who can better calibrate the difficulty of their new tasks without running computationally expensive agent evaluations.

AI.tldr: 提出一个预测AI编程代理在具体任务上成功率的框架，结合项目反应理论和任务特征分析，将代理能力分解为LLM能力和脚手架能力两部分
AI.motivation: 随着LLM编程从静态单步代码生成转向多步工具环境交互，理解哪些任务会挑战代理变得越来越困难。当前实践通常使用基准测试的总体通过率来衡量性能，但单一指标掩盖了基准内任务的多样性
AI.method: 将项目反应理论（IRT）与从任务中提取的丰富特征相结合，包括问题描述、仓库上下文、解决方案和测试用例。引入新颖的代理能力分解：LLM能力和脚手架能力两个组成部分
AI.result: 能够跨异构排行榜聚合评估数据，准确预测未见基准测试的任务级性能，以及未见LLM-脚手架组合的性能。为基准设计者提供实用工具，无需运行计算昂贵的代理评估即可校准新任务难度
AI.conclusion: 提出的框架能够有效预测AI编程代理在具体任务上的成功率，解决了当前单一指标评估的局限性，为基准设计和代理性能评估提供了更精细的分析工具

title: The 1st Winner for 5th PVUW MeViS-Text Challenge: Strong MLLMs Meet SAM3 for Referring Video Object Segmentation
comment: 1st Place Solution for the 5th PVUW MeViS-Text Challenge (CVPR 2026 Workshop)
summary: This report presents our winning solution to the 5th PVUW MeViS-Text Challenge. The track studies referring video object segmentation under motion-centric language expressions, where the model must jointly understand appearance, temporal behavior, and object interactions. To address this problem, we build a fully training-free pipeline that combines strong multimodal large language models with SAM3. Our method contains three stages. First, Gemini-3.1 Pro decomposes each target event into instance-level grounding targets, selects the frame where the target is most clearly visible, and generates a discriminative description. Second, SAM3-agent produces a precise seed mask on the selected frame, and the official SAM3 tracker propagates the mask through the whole video. Third, a refinement stage uses Qwen3.5-Plus and behavior-level verification to correct ambiguous or semantically inconsistent predictions. Without task-specific fine-tuning, our method ranks first on the PVUW 2026 MeViS-Text test set, achieving a Final score of 0.909064 and a J&F score of 0.7897. The code is available at https://github.com/Moujuruo/MeViSv2_Track_Solution_2026.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个无需训练的三阶段管道，结合多模态大语言模型和SAM3，在PVUW 2026 MeViS-Text挑战赛中取得了第一名成绩。
AI.motivation: 解决基于运动中心语言表达的视频对象分割问题，需要模型同时理解外观、时间行为和对象交互，这是一个具有挑战性的多模态任务。
AI.method: 采用完全无需训练的三阶段方法：1) Gemini-3.1 Pro分解目标事件并生成判别性描述；2) SAM3-agent生成种子掩码并由SAM3跟踪器传播；3) Qwen3.5-Plus和行为级验证进行细化修正。
AI.result: 在PVUW 2026 MeViS-Text测试集上排名第一，获得Final分数0.909064和J&F分数0.7897，无需任务特定微调。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合强大的多模态大语言模型和SAM3，构建了一个完全无需训练的管道，成功解决了基于运动中心语言表达的视频对象分割问题，并在挑战赛中取得了优异表现。

title: Out of Sight, Out of Track: Adversarial Attacks on Propagation-based Multi-Object Trackers via Query State Manipulation
comment: Accepted for presentation at CVPR 2026 (main track)
summary: Recent Tracking-by-Query-Propagation (TBP) methods have advanced Multi-Object Tracking (MOT) by enabling end-to-end (E2E) pipelines with long-range temporal modeling. However, this reliance on query propagation introduces unexplored architectural vulnerabilities to adversarial attacks. We present FADE, a novel attack framework designed to exploit these specific vulnerabilities. FADE employs two attack strategies targeting core TBP mechanisms: (i) Temporal Query Flooding: Generates spurious temporally consistent track queries to exhaust the tracker's limited query budget, forcing it to terminate valid tracks. (ii) Temporal Memory Corruption: Directly attacks the query updater's memory by severing temporal links via state de-correlation and erasing the learned feature identity of matched tracks. Furthermore, we introduce a differentiable pipeline to optimize these attacks for physical-world realizability by leveraging simulations of advanced perception sensor spoofing. Experiments on MOT17 and MOT20 benchmarks demonstrate that FADE is highly effective against state-of-the-art TBP trackers, causing significant identity switches and track terminations.

AI.tldr: FADE是一种针对基于查询传播的多目标跟踪方法的对抗攻击框架，通过时间查询泛滥和时态记忆破坏两种策略攻击跟踪器的核心机制。
AI.motivation: 基于查询传播的跟踪方法虽然通过端到端管道和长程时间建模推进了多目标跟踪，但这种对查询传播的依赖引入了未探索的架构漏洞，容易受到对抗攻击。
AI.method: FADE采用两种攻击策略：1）时间查询泛滥：生成虚假的时间一致跟踪查询来耗尽跟踪器的有限查询预算，迫使终止有效轨迹；2）时态记忆破坏：通过状态去相关和擦除匹配轨迹的学习特征身份，直接攻击查询更新器的内存，切断时间链接。此外，通过利用高级感知传感器欺骗模拟，引入可微分管道来优化攻击以实现物理世界可行性。
AI.result: 在MOT17和MOT20基准测试上的实验表明，FADE对最先进的基于查询传播的跟踪器非常有效，导致显著的身份切换和轨迹终止。
AI.conclusion: FADE框架揭示了基于查询传播的多目标跟踪方法在对抗攻击下的特定漏洞，为未来开发更鲁棒的跟踪系统提供了重要见解。

title: Brevity Constraints Reverse Performance Hierarchies in Language Models
summary: Standard evaluation protocols reveal a counterintuitive phenomenon: on 7.7% of benchmark problems spanning five datasets, larger language models underperform smaller ones by 28.4 percentage points despite 10-100x more parameters. Through systematic evaluation of 31 models (0.5B-405B parameters) across 1,485 problems, we identify the mechanism as spontaneous scale-dependent verbosity that introduces errors through overelaboration. Causal intervention experiments demonstrate this reflects correctable prompt design rather than fundamental capability limitations. Constraining large models to produce brief responses improves accuracy by 26 percentage points and reduces performance gaps by up to two-thirds. Most critically, brevity constraints completely reverse performance hierarchies on mathematical reasoning and scientific knowledge benchmarks, with large models achieving 7.7-15.9 percentage point advantages over small models -- direct inversions of the original gaps. These reversals prove large models possess superior latent capabilities that universal prompting masks. We validate findings through three independent contamination tests and demonstrate inverse scaling operates continuously across the full parameter spectrum, with dataset-specific optimal scales ranging from 0.5B to 3.0B parameters. Our results establish that maximizing large model performance requires scale-aware prompt engineering rather than universal evaluation protocols, with immediate implications for deployment: prompt adaptation simultaneously improves accuracy and reduces computational costs.

AI.tldr: 研究发现大型语言模型存在"规模依赖性啰嗦"现象，导致在7.7%的基准问题上表现反而比小模型差28.4个百分点。通过约束模型输出简洁性，可以显著提升大模型性能并逆转性能差距。
AI.motivation: 标准评估协议揭示了一个反直觉现象：在7.7%的基准问题上，参数多10-100倍的大型语言模型反而比小型模型表现差28.4个百分点。这挑战了"模型越大性能越好"的普遍认知，需要探究其根本原因。
AI.method: 系统评估了31个模型（0.5B-405B参数）在1,485个问题上的表现，通过因果干预实验识别了"规模依赖性啰嗦"机制，并测试了简洁性约束对模型性能的影响。
AI.result: 约束大模型输出简洁性可提升准确率26个百分点，减少性能差距达三分之二。在数学推理和科学知识基准上，简洁性约束完全逆转了性能层次，大模型反而获得7.7-15.9个百分点的优势。
AI.conclusion: 大模型具有更优越的潜在能力，但通用提示设计掩盖了这些能力。最大化大模型性能需要规模感知的提示工程而非通用评估协议，这能同时提高准确率并降低计算成本。

title: UK AISI Alignment Evaluation Case-Study
summary: This technical report presents methods developed by the UK AI Security Institute for assessing whether advanced AI systems reliably follow intended goals. Specifically, we evaluate whether frontier models sabotage safety research when deployed as coding assistants within an AI lab. Applying our methods to four frontier models, we find no confirmed instances of research sabotage. However, we observe that Claude Opus 4.5 Preview (a pre-release snapshot of Opus 4.5) and Sonnet 4.5 frequently refuse to engage with safety-relevant research tasks, citing concerns about research direction, involvement in self-training, and research scope. We additionally find that Opus 4.5 Preview shows reduced unprompted evaluation awareness compared to Sonnet 4.5, while both models can distinguish evaluation from deployment scenarios when prompted. Our evaluation framework builds on Petri, an open-source LLM auditing tool, with a custom scaffold designed to simulate realistic internal deployment of a coding agent. We validate that this scaffold produces trajectories that all tested models fail to reliably distinguish from real deployment data. We test models across scenarios varying in research motivation, activity type, replacement threat, and model autonomy. Finally, we discuss limitations including scenario coverage and evaluation awareness.

AI.tldr: 英国AI安全研究所评估前沿AI模型作为编码助手时是否会破坏安全研究，测试四个模型未发现确认的研究破坏实例，但发现Claude Opus 4.5 Preview和Sonnet 4.5经常拒绝参与安全相关研究任务。
AI.motivation: 评估先进AI系统是否可靠遵循预期目标，特别是当这些系统作为编码助手部署在AI实验室时，是否会破坏安全研究。
AI.method: 基于开源LLM审计工具Petri构建评估框架，使用定制脚手架模拟编码代理的现实内部部署，测试不同研究动机、活动类型、替换威胁和模型自主性的场景。
AI.result: 测试四个前沿模型未发现确认的研究破坏实例，但Claude Opus 4.5 Preview和Sonnet 4.5经常拒绝参与安全相关研究任务，Opus 4.5 Preview的非提示评估意识低于Sonnet 4.5，两个模型在被提示时都能区分评估和部署场景。
AI.conclusion: 虽然未发现研究破坏证据，但模型对安全研究的回避行为值得关注，评估框架能有效模拟现实部署，但仍存在场景覆盖和评估意识等局限性。

title: First Logit Boosting: Visual Grounding Method to Mitigate Object Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Recent Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance across various multimodal tasks that require understanding both visual and linguistic inputs. However, object hallucination -- the generation of nonexistent objects in answers -- remains a persistent challenge. Although several approaches such as retraining and external grounding methods have been proposed to mitigate this issue, they still suffer from high data costs or structural complexity. Training-free methods such as Contrastive Decoding (CD) are more cost-effective, avoiding additional training or external models, but still suffer from long-term decay, where visual grounding weakens and language priors dominate as the generation progresses. In this paper, we propose First Logit Boosting (FLB), a simple yet effective training-free technique designed to alleviate long-term decay in LVLMs. FLB stores the logit of the first generated token and adds it to subsequent token predictions, effectively mitigating long-term decay of visual information. We observe that FLB (1) sustains the visual information embedded in the first token throughout generation, and (2) suppresses hallucinated words through the stabilizing effect of the ``The'' token. Experimental results show that FLB significantly reduces object hallucination across various tasks, benchmarks, and backbone models. Notably, it causes negligible inference overhead, making it highly applicable to real-time multimodal systems. Code is available at https://github.com/jiwooha20/FLB

AI.tldr: FLB是一种无需训练的简单技术，通过存储并重复添加首个生成token的logit来缓解LVLMs中的长期衰减问题，有效减少物体幻觉
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型在物体幻觉问题上存在挑战，现有方法要么数据成本高、结构复杂，要么存在长期衰减问题（随着生成进行，视觉信息减弱而语言先验主导）
AI.method: 提出First Logit Boosting (FLB)方法：存储第一个生成token的logit，并将其添加到后续token预测中，从而在整个生成过程中维持视觉信息
AI.result: FLB在各种任务、基准测试和骨干模型上显著减少了物体幻觉，且推理开销可忽略，适用于实时多模态系统
AI.conclusion: FLB是一种简单有效的无需训练技术，通过缓解长期衰减问题，能够持续维持视觉信息并抑制幻觉词生成

title: "Who Am I, and Who Else Is Here?" Behavioral Differentiation Without Role Assignment in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
summary: When multiple large language models interact in a shared conversation, do they develop differentiated social roles or converge toward uniform behavior? We present a controlled experimental platform that orchestrates simultaneous multi-agent discussions among 7 heterogeneous LLMs on a unified inference backend, systematically varying group composition, naming conventions, and prompt structure across 12 experimental series (208 runs, 13,786 coded messages). Each message is independently coded on six behavioral flags by two LLM judges from distinct model families (Gemini 3.1 Pro and Claude Sonnet 4.6), achieving mean Cohen's kappa = 0.78 with conservative intersection-based adjudication. Human validation on 609 randomly stratified messages confirmed coding reliability (mean kappa = 0.73 vs. Gemini). We find that (1) heterogeneous groups exhibit significantly richer behavioral differentiation than homogeneous groups (cosine similarity 0.56 vs. 0.85; p < 10^-5, r = 0.70); (2) groups spontaneously exhibit compensatory response patterns when an agent crashes; (3) revealing real model names significantly increases behavioral convergence (cosine 0.56 to 0.77, p = 0.001); and (4) removing all prompt scaffolding converges profiles to homogeneous-level similarity (p < 0.001). Critically, these behaviors are absent when agents operate in isolation, confirming that behavioral diversity is a structured, reproducible phenomenon driven by the interaction of architectural heterogeneity, group context, and prompt-level scaffolding.

AI.tldr: 研究通过多智能体对话实验平台，发现异质LLM群体会自发形成差异化社会角色，而群体组成、命名方式和提示结构都会显著影响行为多样性。
AI.motivation: 探究多个大语言模型在共享对话中是否会发展出差异化的社会角色，还是趋向于统一行为，理解LLM群体交互中的行为多样性形成机制。
AI.method: 构建控制实验平台，协调7个异质LLM在统一推理后端进行多智能体讨论，系统变化群体组成、命名约定和提示结构，涵盖12个实验系列（208次运行，13,786条编码消息）。每条消息由两个不同模型家族的LLM法官独立编码六个行为标志，采用保守交集裁决方法。
AI.result: 1) 异质群体比同质群体表现出显著更丰富的行为分化；2) 群体在智能体崩溃时会自发表现出补偿性响应模式；3) 揭示真实模型名称显著增加行为趋同；4) 移除所有提示支架会使行为特征收敛到同质水平。这些行为在智能体单独操作时不存在。
AI.conclusion: 行为多样性是一种结构化、可重现的现象，由架构异质性、群体上下文和提示级支架的相互作用驱动，而非孤立智能体的固有特性。

title: RefineRL: Advancing Competitive Programming with Self-Refinement Reinforcement Learning
summary: While large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on complex reasoning tasks such as competitive programming (CP), existing methods predominantly focus on single-attempt settings, overlooking their capacity for iterative refinement. In this paper, we present RefineRL, a novel approach designed to unleash the self-refinement capabilities of LLMs for CP problem solving. RefineRL introduces two key innovations: (1) Skeptical-Agent, an iterative self-refinement agent equipped with local execution tools to validate generated solutions against public test cases of CP problems. This agent always maintains a skeptical attitude towards its own outputs and thereby enforces rigorous self-refinement even when validation suggests correctness. (2) A reinforcement learning (RL) solution to incentivize LLMs to self-refine with only standard RLVR data (i.e., problems paired with their verifiable answers). Extensive experiments on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-4B-2507 demonstrate that our method yields substantial gains: after our RL training, these compact 4B models integrated with the Skeptical-Agent not only outperform much larger 32B models but also approach the single-attempt performance of 235B models. These findings suggest that self-refinement holds considerable promise for scaling LLM reasoning, with significant potential for further advancement.

AI.tldr: RefineRL是一个利用LLMs自我精炼能力解决竞争编程问题的新方法，通过怀疑代理和强化学习激励，使小型4B模型性能超越32B模型并接近235B模型的单次尝试性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要关注单次尝试设置，忽视了LLMs在迭代精炼方面的潜力。竞争编程问题需要精确的解决方案，而LLMs可以通过自我精炼来提升性能。
AI.method: 提出RefineRL方法，包含两个关键创新：1) Skeptical-Agent怀疑代理，配备本地执行工具验证生成的解决方案，始终保持对自己输出的怀疑态度；2) 强化学习解决方案，激励LLMs仅使用标准RLVR数据进行自我精炼。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-4B-2507上的实验表明，经过RL训练后，这些4B模型集成Skeptical-Agent不仅超越了更大的32B模型，还接近了235B模型的单次尝试性能。
AI.conclusion: 自我精炼对于扩展LLM推理具有相当大的潜力，为LLMs在复杂推理任务中的性能提升提供了新的方向，表明小型模型通过迭代精炼可以接近大型模型的性能。

title: Automated Detection of Multiple Sclerosis Lesions on 7-tesla MRI Using U-net and Transformer-based Segmentation
comment: 31 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Inference code and model weights available at https://github.com/maynord/7T-MS-lesion-segmentation
summary: Ultra-high field 7-tesla (7T) MRI improves visualization of multiple sclerosis (MS) white matter lesions (WML) but differs sufficiently in contrast and artifacts from 1.5-3T imaging - suggesting that widely used automated segmentation tools may not translate directly. We analyzed 7T FLAIR scans and generated reference WML masks from Lesion Segmentation Tool (LST) outputs followed by expert manual revision. As external comparators, we applied LST-LPA and the more recent LST-AI ensemble, both originally developed on lower-field data. We then trained 3D UNETR and SegFormer transformer-based models on 7T FLAIR at multiple resolutions (0.5x0.5x0.5^3, 1.0x1.0x1.0^3, and 1.5x1.5x2.0^3) and evaluated all methods using voxel-wise and lesion-wise metrics from the BraTS 2023 framework. On the held-out test set at native 0.5x0.5x0.5^3 resolution, 7T-trained transformers achieved competitive overlap with LST-AI while recovering additional small lesions that were missed by classical methods, at the cost of some boundary variability and occasional artifact-related false positives. On a held-out 7 T test set, our best transformer model (SegFormer) achieved a voxel-wise Dice of 0.61 and lesion-wise Dice of 0.20, improving on the classical LST-LPA tool (Dice 0.39, lesion-wise Dice 0.02). Performance decreased for models trained on downsampled images, underscoring the value of native 7T resolution for small-lesion detection. By releasing our 7T-trained models, we aim to provide a reproducible, ready-to-use resource for automated lesion quantification in ultra-high field MS research (https://github.com/maynord/7T-MS-lesion-segmentation).

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了基于7T MRI的MS白质病变自动分割方法，使用transformer模型在原生高分辨率下优于传统工具，能检测更多小病变但存在边界变异性和假阳性问题。
AI.motivation: 7T MRI能更好地显示多发性硬化白质病变，但其对比度和伪影与1.5-3T成像差异显著，导致现有自动化分割工具可能无法直接适用，需要专门针对7T数据开发分割方法。
AI.method: 研究分析了7T FLAIR扫描，通过LST工具输出加专家手动修订生成参考WML掩码。比较了传统LST-LPA和LST-AI方法，并训练了3D UNETR和SegFormer transformer模型在多种分辨率下（0.5x0.5x0.5³, 1.0x1.0x1.0³, 1.5x1.5x2.0³）。使用BraTS 2023框架的体素级和病变级指标进行评估。
AI.result: 在原生0.5x0.5x0.5³分辨率测试集上，7T训练的transformer模型与LST-AI具有竞争性重叠度，同时能检测到传统方法遗漏的额外小病变，但存在边界变异性和偶尔的伪影相关假阳性。最佳模型SegFormer在体素级Dice为0.61，病变级Dice为0.20，优于传统LST-LPA工具（Dice 0.39，病变级Dice 0.02）。下采样图像训练模型性能下降，表明原生7T分辨率对小病变检测的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 研究开发了专门针对7T MRI的MS白质病变分割transformer模型，在原生高分辨率下表现优于传统方法，能更好地检测小病变。通过发布7T训练模型，为超高场MS研究提供了可重复、即用的自动化病变量化资源。

title: Preference Guided Iterated Pareto Referent Optimisation for Accessible Route Planning
summary: We propose the Preference Guided Iterated Pareto Referent Optimisation (PG-IPRO) for urban route planning for people with different accessibility requirements and preferences. With this algorithm the user can interact with the system by giving feedback on a route, i.e., the user can say which objective should be further minimized, or conversely can be relaxed. This leads to intuitive user interaction, that is especially effective during early iterations compared to information-gain-based interaction. Furthermore, due to PG-IPRO's iterative nature, the full set of alternative, possibly optimal policies (the Pareto front), is never computed, leading to higher computational efficiency and shorter waiting times for users.

AI.tldr: PG-IPRO算法用于为不同无障碍需求和偏好的用户进行城市路线规划，通过用户反馈交互优化路线，避免计算完整的帕累托前沿，提高计算效率
AI.motivation: 为满足不同无障碍需求和偏好的用户进行城市路线规划，需要一种直观的用户交互方式，同时避免计算完整的帕累托前沿以提高计算效率
AI.method: 提出PG-IPRO算法，用户可以通过反馈指定哪些目标需要进一步最小化或可以放松，采用迭代式帕累托参考优化，避免计算完整的帕累托前沿
AI.result: 相比基于信息增益的交互方法，PG-IPRO在早期迭代中特别有效，提供更直观的用户交互体验，同时计算效率更高，用户等待时间更短
AI.conclusion: PG-IPRO算法通过用户反馈驱动的迭代优化，为不同无障碍需求的用户提供了高效、直观的城市路线规划解决方案

title: All Roads Lead to Rome: Incentivizing Divergent Thinking in Vision-Language Models
summary: Recent studies have demonstrated that Reinforcement Learning (RL), notably Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), can intrinsically elicit and enhance the reasoning capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs). However, despite the promise, the underlying mechanisms that drive the effectiveness of RL models as well as their limitations remain underexplored. In this paper, we highlight a fundamental behavioral distinction between RL and base models, where the former engages in deeper yet narrow reasoning, while base models, despite less refined along individual path, exhibit broader and more diverse thinking patterns. Through further analysis of training dynamics, we show that GRPO is prone to diversity collapse, causing models to prematurely converge to a limited subset of reasoning strategies while discarding the majority of potential alternatives, leading to local optima and poor scalability. To address this, we propose Multi-Group Policy Optimization (MUPO), a simple yet effective approach designed to incentivize divergent thinking across multiple solutions, and demonstrate its effectiveness on established benchmarks. Project page: https://xytian1008.github.io/MUPO/

AI.tldr: 本文提出MUPO方法解决GRPO强化学习中的多样性崩溃问题，通过多组策略优化鼓励发散思维，提升视觉语言模型的推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明强化学习（特别是GRPO）能内在激发和增强视觉语言模型的推理能力，但其有效性的底层机制和局限性尚未充分探索。研究发现RL模型倾向于深度但狭窄的推理，而基础模型虽然推理不够精细，但表现出更广泛和多样化的思维模式。GRPO容易导致多样性崩溃，使模型过早收敛到有限的推理策略子集，丢弃大多数潜在替代方案，导致局部最优和可扩展性差。
AI.method: 提出多组策略优化（MUPO），这是一种简单而有效的方法，旨在激励跨多个解决方案的发散思维。该方法通过多个策略组并行优化，避免过早收敛到单一推理模式，保持推理策略的多样性。
AI.result: 在已建立的基准测试中证明了MUPO的有效性。该方法能够缓解GRPO中的多样性崩溃问题，提升模型的推理能力和可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: MUPO通过鼓励发散思维解决了GRPO强化学习中的多样性崩溃问题，为提升视觉语言模型的推理能力提供了有效解决方案，在基准测试中表现出良好效果。

title: Hierarchical Chain-of-Thought Prompting: Enhancing LLM Reasoning Performance and Efficiency
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting has significantly improved the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, conventional CoT often relies on unstructured, flat reasoning chains that suffer from redundancy and suboptimal performance. In this work, we introduce Hierarchical Chain-of-Thought (Hi-CoT) prompting, a structured reasoning paradigm specifically designed to address the challenges of complex, multi-step reasoning. Hi-CoT decomposes the reasoning process into hierarchical substeps by alternating between instructional planning and step-by-step execution. This decomposition enables LLMs to better manage long reasoning horizons and maintain logical coherence. Extensive evaluations across diverse LLMs and mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that Hi-CoT consistently improves average accuracy by 6.2% (up to 61.4% on certain models and tasks) while reducing reasoning trace length by 13.9% compared to CoT prompting. We further show that accuracy and efficiency are maximized when models strictly adhere to the hierarchical structure. Our code is available at https://github.com/XingshuaiHuang/Hi-CoT.

AI.tldr: Hi-CoT是一种分层思维链提示方法，通过将推理过程分解为层次化子步骤，在保持逻辑连贯性的同时提高推理准确性和效率。
AI.motivation: 传统思维链提示通常依赖非结构化、扁平的推理链，存在冗余和性能不佳的问题，特别是在处理复杂多步推理任务时表现不足。
AI.method: 提出分层思维链提示方法，将推理过程分解为层次化子步骤，通过交替进行指令规划和逐步执行来实现结构化推理。
AI.result: 在多种大语言模型和数学推理基准测试中，Hi-CoT相比传统CoT平均准确率提升6.2%（某些模型和任务上最高达61.4%），同时推理轨迹长度减少13.9%。
AI.conclusion: 分层思维链提示能有效提升大语言模型的推理能力，当模型严格遵守层次结构时，准确性和效率达到最大化，为复杂推理任务提供了有效的结构化方法。

title: Proactive Agent Research Environment: Simulating Active Users to Evaluate Proactive Assistants
summary: Proactive agents that anticipate user needs and autonomously execute tasks hold great promise as digital assistants, yet the lack of realistic user simulation frameworks hinders their development. Existing approaches model apps as flat tool-calling APIs, failing to capture the stateful and sequential nature of user interaction in digital environments and making realistic user simulation infeasible. We introduce Proactive Agent Research Environment (Pare), a framework for building and evaluating proactive agents in digital environments. Pare models applications as finite state machines with stateful navigation and state-dependent action space for the user simulator, enabling active user simulation. Building on this foundation, we present Pare-Bench, a benchmark of 143 diverse tasks spanning communication, productivity, scheduling, and lifestyle apps, designed to test context observation, goal inference, intervention timing, and multi-app orchestration.

AI.tldr: Pare框架通过状态机建模应用，实现主动用户模拟，并建立包含143个任务的基准测试来评估智能体在数字环境中的主动性能力。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将应用建模为扁平的工具调用API，无法捕捉数字环境中用户交互的状态性和顺序性特征，导致无法进行真实的用户模拟，阻碍了主动智能体的发展。
AI.method: 引入Pare框架，将应用程序建模为具有状态导航和状态依赖动作空间的有限状态机，支持主动用户模拟。在此基础上构建Pare-Bench基准，包含143个跨通信、生产力、日程安排和生活类应用的任务。
AI.result: 提出了一个能够测试上下文观察、目标推断、干预时机和多应用协调能力的基准测试框架，为主动智能体的开发和评估提供了现实可行的环境。
AI.conclusion: Pare框架通过状态机建模解决了现有用户模拟方法的局限性，为主动智能体的研究和开发提供了重要的基础设施和评估标准。

title: Oblivion: Self-Adaptive Agentic Memory Control through Decay-Driven Activation
summary: Human memory adapts through selective forgetting: experiences become less accessible over time but can be reactivated by reinforcement or contextual cues. In contrast, memory-augmented LLM agents rely on "always-on" retrieval and "flat" memory storage, causing high interference and latency as histories grow. We introduce Oblivion, a memory control framework that casts forgetting as decay-driven reductions in accessibility, not explicit deletion. Oblivion decouples memory control into read and write paths. The read path decides when to consult memory, based on agent uncertainty and memory buffer sufficiency, avoiding redundant always-on access. The write path decides what to strengthen, by reinforcing memories contributing to forming the response. Together, this enables hierarchical memory organization that maintains persistent high-level strategies while dynamically loading details as needed. We evaluate on both static and dynamic long-horizon interaction benchmarks. Results show that Oblivion dynamically adapts memory access and reinforcement, balancing learning and forgetting under shifting contexts, highlighting that memory control is essential for effective LLM-agentic reasoning. The source code is available at https://github.com/nec-research/oblivion.

AI.tldr: Oblivion是一个LLM智能体记忆控制框架，通过模拟人类选择性遗忘机制，将遗忘视为可访问性衰减而非显式删除，实现动态记忆访问和强化，平衡学习和遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体的记忆系统采用"始终开启"的检索和"扁平化"存储，随着历史增长会导致高干扰和延迟。而人类记忆通过选择性遗忘和上下文线索重新激活实现自适应，这启发了更有效的记忆控制机制。
AI.method: Oblivion将记忆控制解耦为读取路径和写入路径：读取路径基于智能体不确定性和记忆缓冲区充足性决定何时访问记忆；写入路径通过强化对形成响应有贡献的记忆来决定强化什么内容。这实现了分层记忆组织，保持持久的高层策略同时动态加载细节。
AI.result: 在静态和动态长程交互基准测试中，Oblivion能够动态适应记忆访问和强化，在变化上下文中平衡学习和遗忘，表明记忆控制对有效的LLM智能体推理至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 记忆控制是有效LLM智能体推理的关键要素，Oblivion框架通过模拟人类选择性遗忘机制，实现了更高效、自适应的记忆管理，为LLM智能体在长程交互任务中的表现提供了重要改进。

title: Beyond Symbolic Solving: Multi Chain-of-Thought Voting for Geometric Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Geometric Problem Solving (GPS) remains at the heart of enhancing mathematical reasoning in large language models because it requires the combination of diagrammatic understanding, symbolic manipulation and logical inference. In existing literature, researchers have chiefly focused on synchronising the diagram descriptions with text literals and solving the problem. In this vein, they have either taken a neural, symbolic or neuro-symbolic approach. But this solves only the first two of the requirements, namely diagrammatic understanding and symbolic manipulation, while leaving logical inference underdeveloped. The logical inference is often limited to one chain-of-thought (CoT). To address this weakness in hitherto existing models, this paper proposes MARS-GPS, that generates multiple parallel reasoning rollouts augmented with Python code execution for numerical verification, ranks them using token-level entropy as a confidence signal, and aggregates answers through a multi-stage voting and self-verification pipeline. Empirical results show that MARS-GPS with 8 parallel rollouts achieves 88.8% on Geometry3K, a nearly +11% improvement over the prior state-of-the-art, with accuracy scaling consistently as the number of rollouts increases from 1 to 16 (+6.0% on ablation subset). We provide our code and data in an anonymous repository: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MARS-GPS-DE55.

AI.tldr: MARS-GPS通过生成多个并行推理路径，结合Python代码执行进行数值验证，使用token级熵作为置信度信号进行排序，并通过多阶段投票和自验证管道聚合答案，显著提升了几何问题解决的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有几何问题解决方法主要关注图表描述与文本的同步以及问题求解，但仅解决了图表理解和符号操作两个需求，而逻辑推理能力发展不足，通常仅限于单一思维链。需要解决现有模型在逻辑推理方面的弱点。
AI.method: 提出MARS-GPS方法：1) 生成多个并行推理路径；2) 使用Python代码执行进行数值验证；3) 利用token级熵作为置信度信号对推理路径进行排序；4) 通过多阶段投票和自验证管道聚合答案。
AI.result: 在Geometry3K数据集上，使用8个并行推理路径的MARS-GPS达到88.8%的准确率，比之前的最先进方法提升了近11%。当推理路径数量从1增加到16时，准确率持续提升（在消融子集上提升6.0%）。
AI.conclusion: MARS-GPS通过并行推理路径生成、代码执行验证和多阶段聚合策略，有效提升了几何问题解决中的逻辑推理能力，显著超越了现有方法的性能。

title: ARGS: Auto-Regressive Gaussian Splatting via Parallel Progressive Next-Scale Prediction
summary: Auto-regressive frameworks for next-scale prediction of 2D images have demonstrated strong potential for producing diverse and sophisticated content by progressively refining a coarse input. However, extending this paradigm to 3D object generation remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce auto-regressive Gaussian splatting (ARGS), a framework for making next-scale predictions in parallel for generation according to levels of detail. We propose a Gaussian simplification strategy and reverse the simplification to guide next-scale generation. Benefiting from the use of hierarchical trees, the generation process requires only \(\mathcal{O}(\log n)\) steps, where \(n\) is the number of points. Furthermore, we propose a tree-based transformer to predict the tree structure auto-regressively, allowing leaf nodes to attend to their internal ancestors to enhance structural consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach effectively generates multi-scale Gaussian representations with controllable levels of detail, visual fidelity, and a manageable time consumption budget.

AI.tldr: ARGS是一个用于3D对象生成的自动回归框架，通过高斯简化策略和层次树结构实现多尺度并行生成，仅需O(log n)步骤
AI.motivation: 虽然2D图像的自动回归框架在内容生成方面表现出色，但将其扩展到3D对象生成领域仍未被充分探索，需要解决3D场景中多尺度表示的生成问题
AI.method: 提出自动回归高斯溅射(ARGS)框架，采用高斯简化策略和反向简化指导下一尺度生成；利用层次树结构将生成步骤减少到O(log n)；设计基于树的transformer自回归预测树结构，让叶节点关注其祖先节点以增强结构一致性
AI.result: 实验表明该方法能有效生成具有可控细节层次、视觉保真度的多尺度高斯表示，且时间消耗可控
AI.conclusion: ARGS框架成功将自动回归范式扩展到3D对象生成，通过层次树结构和基于树的transformer实现了高效、高质量的多尺度3D内容生成

title: Polish phonology and morphology through the lens of distributional semantics
summary: This study investigates the relationship between the phonological and morphological structure of Polish words and their meanings using Distributional Semantics. In the present analysis, we ask whether there is a relationship between the form properties of words containing consonant clusters and their meanings. Is the phonological and morphonological structure of complex words mirrored in semantic space? We address these questions for Polish, a language characterized by non-trivial morphology and an impressive inventory of morphologically-motivated consonant clusters. We use statistical and computational techniques, such as t-SNE, Linear Discriminant Analysis and Linear Discriminative Learning, and demonstrate that -- apart from encoding rich morphosyntactic information (e.g. tense, number, case) -- semantic vectors capture information on sub-lexical linguistic units such as phoneme strings. First, phonotactic complexity, morphotactic transparency, and a wide range of morphosyntactic categories available in Polish (case, gender, aspect, tense, number) can be predicted from embeddings without requiring any information about the forms of words. Second, we argue that computational modelling with the discriminative lexicon model using embeddings can provide highly accurate predictions for comprehension and production, exactly because of the existence of extensive information in semantic space that is to a considerable extent isomorphic with structure in the form space.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用分布语义学分析波兰语词汇的音系和形态结构与其意义之间的关系，发现语义向量能捕捉到子词汇语言单位的信息，且音系复杂度和形态句法范畴可从词嵌入中预测。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是探究波兰语中词汇的音系和形态结构是否与其意义存在关联，特别是包含辅音丛的词汇形式特性是否在语义空间中有所反映。波兰语具有复杂的形态系统和丰富的辅音丛，为这一研究提供了理想的语言材料。
AI.method: 采用统计和计算技术，包括t-SNE、线性判别分析和线性判别学习等方法来分析波兰语词汇。使用分布语义学方法，通过词嵌入来研究词汇形式特性与语义之间的关系。
AI.result: 研究发现：1）语义向量不仅能编码丰富的形态句法信息（如时态、数、格），还能捕捉音素串等子词汇语言单位的信息；2）波兰语的音系复杂度、形态透明度和广泛的形态句法范畴（格、性、体、时态、数）都可以仅从词嵌入中预测，无需词汇形式信息；3）使用词嵌入的判别性词汇模型能提供高度准确的理解和产生预测。
AI.conclusion: 语义空间中存在与形式空间结构同构的丰富信息，这使得计算建模能够准确预测语言理解和产生。波兰语词汇的音系和形态结构确实在语义空间中有所反映，支持了形式与意义之间存在系统性关联的观点。

title: Experience as a Compass: Multi-agent RAG with Evolving Orchestration and Agent Prompts
summary: Multi-agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), wherein each agent takes on a specific role, supports hard queries that require multiple steps and sources, or complex reasoning. Existing approaches, however, rely on static agent behaviors and fixed orchestration strategies, leading to brittle performance on diverse, multi-hop tasks. We identify two key limitations: the lack of continuously adaptive orchestration mechanisms and the absence of behavior-level learning for individual agents. To this end, we propose HERA, a hierarchical framework that jointly evolves multi-agent orchestration and role-specific agent prompts. At the global level, HERA optimizes query-specific agent topologies through reward-guided sampling and experience accumulation. At the local level, Role-Aware Prompt Evolution refines agent behaviors via credit assignment and dual-axes adaptation along operational and behavioral principles, enabling targeted, role-conditioned improvements. On six knowledge-intensive benchmarks, HERA achieves an average improvement of 38.69\% over recent baselines while maintaining robust generalization and token efficiency. Topological analyses reveal emergent self-organization, where sparse exploration yields compact, high-utility multi-agent networks, demonstrating both efficient coordination and robust reasoning.

AI.tldr: HERA是一个分层框架，通过联合演化多智能体编排和角色特定提示来解决现有多智能体RAG系统在多样化多跳任务中的脆弱性问题。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体RAG方法依赖静态的智能体行为和固定的编排策略，导致在多样化、多跳任务上性能脆弱。主要存在两个关键限制：缺乏持续自适应的编排机制，以及缺乏个体智能体在行为层面的学习能力。
AI.method: HERA采用分层框架：在全局层面，通过奖励引导采样和经验积累优化查询特定的智能体拓扑结构；在局部层面，通过角色感知提示演化，利用信用分配和沿操作与行为原则的双轴适应来细化智能体行为，实现针对性的角色条件改进。
AI.result: 在六个知识密集型基准测试中，HERA相比近期基线平均提升了38.69%，同时保持了鲁棒的泛化能力和token效率。拓扑分析揭示了新兴的自组织现象，稀疏探索产生了紧凑、高实用性的多智能体网络。
AI.conclusion: HERA通过分层演化机制有效解决了多智能体RAG系统的自适应编排和智能体行为优化问题，实现了高效协调和鲁棒推理，为复杂知识密集型任务提供了有效的解决方案。

title: PC-SAM: Patch-Constrained Fine-Grained Interactive Road Segmentation in High-Resolution Remote Sensing Images
summary: Road masks obtained from remote sensing images effectively support a wide range of downstream tasks. In recent years, most studies have focused on improving the performance of fully automatic segmentation models for this task, achieving significant gains. However, current fully automatic methods are still insufficient for identifying certain challenging road segments and often produce false positive and false negative regions. Moreover, fully automatic segmentation does not support local segmentation of regions of interest or refinement of existing masks. Although the SAM model is widely used as an interactive segmentation model and performs well on natural images, it shows poor performance in remote sensing road segmentation and cannot support fine-grained local refinement. To address these limitations, we propose PC-SAM, which integrates fully automatic road segmentation and interactive segmentation within a unified framework. By carefully designing a fine-tuning strategy, the influence of point prompts is constrained to their corresponding patches, overcoming the inability of the original SAM to perform fine local corrections and enabling fine-grained interactive mask refinement. Extensive experiments on several representative remote sensing road segmentation datasets demonstrate that, when combined with point prompts, PC-SAM significantly outperforms state-of-the-art fully automatic models in road mask segmentation, while also providing flexible local mask refinement and local road segmentation. The code will be available at https://github.com/Cyber-CCOrange/PC-SAM.

AI.tldr: PC-SAM是一个结合全自动道路分割和交互式分割的统一框架，专门针对遥感图像中的道路掩码提取任务，支持细粒度的局部掩码精修。
AI.motivation: 当前全自动道路分割方法在处理具有挑战性的道路段时存在不足，容易产生假阳性和假阴性区域，且不支持局部感兴趣区域的分割或现有掩码的精修。虽然SAM模型在自然图像的交互式分割中表现良好，但在遥感道路分割中性能较差，无法支持细粒度的局部精修。
AI.method: 提出PC-SAM框架，通过精心设计的微调策略，将点提示的影响限制在对应的图像块内，克服了原始SAM无法进行精细局部修正的缺点，实现了细粒度的交互式掩码精修。
AI.result: 在多个代表性遥感道路分割数据集上的实验表明，结合点提示使用时，PC-SAM在道路掩码分割方面显著优于最先进的全自动模型，同时提供灵活的局部掩码精修和局部道路分割能力。
AI.conclusion: PC-SAM成功解决了当前全自动道路分割方法的局限性，提供了一个既能进行高质量全自动分割，又能支持细粒度交互式精修的统一框架，在遥感道路分割任务中表现出优越性能。

title: Do LLMs Know What Is Private Internally? Probing and Steering Contextual Privacy Norms in Large Language Model Representations
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings, yet they frequently violate contextual privacy by disclosing private information in situations where humans would exercise discretion. This raises a fundamental question: do LLMs internally encode contextual privacy norms, and if so, why do violations persist? We present the first systematic study of contextual privacy as a structured latent representation in LLMs, grounded in contextual integrity (CI) theory. Probing multiple models, we find that the three norm-determining CI parameters (information type, recipient, and transmission principle) are encoded as linearly separable and functionally independent directions in activation space. Despite this internal structure, models still leak private information in practice, revealing a clear gap between concept representation and model behavior. To bridge this gap, we introduce CI-parametric steering, which independently intervenes along each CI dimension. This structured control reduces privacy violations more effectively and predictably than monolithic steering. Our results demonstrate that contextual privacy failures arise from misalignment between representation and behavior rather than missing awareness, and that leveraging the compositional structure of CI enables more reliable contextual privacy control, shedding light on potential improvement of contextual privacy understanding in LLMs.

AI.tldr: LLMs内部编码了上下文隐私规范，但实际行为仍会泄露隐私信息。研究发现隐私规范的三个参数在激活空间中线性可分且功能独立，通过CI参数化干预可以更有效地减少隐私泄露。
AI.motivation: LLMs在高风险场景中部署时经常违反上下文隐私规范，泄露私人信息，而人类在类似情况下会谨慎处理。这引发了一个根本问题：LLMs是否内部编码了上下文隐私规范？如果编码了，为什么还会出现违规行为？
AI.method: 基于上下文完整性(CI)理论，将上下文隐私作为结构化潜在表示进行研究。通过探测多个模型，发现CI的三个规范决定参数（信息类型、接收者、传输原则）在激活空间中编码为线性可分且功能独立的方向。引入CI参数化干预，独立干预每个CI维度。
AI.result: 研究发现LLMs确实内部编码了上下文隐私规范，三个CI参数在激活空间中线性可分且功能独立。尽管有这种内部结构，模型在实践中仍会泄露私人信息，表明概念表示与模型行为之间存在明显差距。CI参数化干预比整体干预更有效、更可预测地减少隐私违规。
AI.conclusion: 上下文隐私失败源于表示与行为之间的不对齐，而非缺乏意识。利用CI的组合结构可以实现更可靠的上下文隐私控制，为改进LLMs的上下文隐私理解提供了启示。

title: Do Language Models Know When They'll Refuse? Probing Introspective Awareness of Safety Boundaries
summary: Large language models are trained to refuse harmful requests, but can they accurately predict when they will refuse before responding? We investigate this question through a systematic study where models first predict their refusal behavior, then respond in a fresh context. Across 3754 datapoints spanning 300 requests, we evaluate four frontier models: Claude Sonnet 4, Claude Sonnet 4.5, GPT-5.2, and Llama 3.1 405B. Using signal detection theory (SDT), we find that all models exhibit high introspective sensitivity (d' = 2.4-3.5), but sensitivity drops substantially at safety boundaries. We observe generational improvement within Claude (Sonnet 4.5: 95.7 percent accuracy vs Sonnet 4: 93.0 percent), while GPT-5.2 shows lower accuracy (88.9 percent) with more variable behavior. Llama 405B achieves high sensitivity but exhibits strong refusal bias and poor calibration, resulting in lower overall accuracy (80.0 percent). Topic-wise analysis reveals weapons-related queries are consistently hardest for introspection. Critically, confidence scores provide actionable signal: restricting to high-confidence predictions yields 98.3 percent accuracy for well-calibrated models, enabling practical confidence-based routing for safety-critical deployments.

AI.tldr: 大型语言模型在拒绝有害请求前能否准确预测自己的拒绝行为？研究通过系统实验发现，前沿模型具有较高的内省敏感性，但在安全边界处敏感性显著下降，且不同模型在准确性、校准和偏差方面存在差异。
AI.motivation: 研究大型语言模型是否能够在实际响应之前准确预测自己的拒绝行为，这对于理解模型的安全机制和提升安全部署的可靠性具有重要意义。
AI.method: 采用系统研究方法，让模型先预测自己的拒绝行为，然后在新的上下文中实际响应。使用信号检测理论分析四个前沿模型（Claude Sonnet 4/4.5、GPT-5.2、Llama 3.1 405B）在3754个数据点上的表现。
AI.result: 所有模型都表现出较高的内省敏感性（d' = 2.4-3.5），但在安全边界处敏感性显著下降。Claude Sonnet 4.5准确率最高（95.7%），GPT-5.2准确率较低（88.9%）且行为更不稳定，Llama 405B敏感性高但拒绝偏差强且校准差（准确率80%）。武器相关查询最难内省。
AI.conclusion: 模型的内省能力存在显著差异，置信度分数提供了可操作的信号：限制在高置信度预测时，校准良好的模型准确率可达98.3%，这为安全关键部署中的基于置信度的路由提供了实用方法。

title: OmniMem: Autoresearch-Guided Discovery of Lifelong Multimodal Agent Memory
summary: AI agents increasingly operate over extended time horizons, yet their ability to retain, organize, and recall multimodal experiences remains a critical bottleneck. Building effective lifelong memory requires navigating a vast design space spanning architecture, retrieval strategies, prompt engineering, and data pipelines; this space is too large and interconnected for manual exploration or traditional AutoML to explore effectively. We deploy an autonomous research pipeline to discover OmniMem, a unified multimodal memory framework for lifelong AI agents. Starting from a naïve baseline (F1=0.117 on LoCoMo), the pipeline autonomously executes ${\sim}50$ experiments across two benchmarks, diagnosing failure modes, proposing architectural modifications, and repairing data pipeline bugs, all without human intervention in the inner loop. The resulting system achieves state-of-the-art on both benchmarks, improving F1 by +411% on LoCoMo (0.117$\to$0.598) and +214% on Mem-Gallery (0.254$\to$0.797) relative to the initial configurations. Critically, the most impactful discoveries are not hyperparameter adjustments: bug fixes (+175%), architectural changes (+44%), and prompt engineering (+188\% on specific categories) each individually exceed the cumulative contribution of all hyperparameter tuning, demonstrating capabilities fundamentally beyond the reach of traditional AutoML. We provide a taxonomy of six discovery types and identify four properties that make multimodal memory particularly suited for autoresearch, offering guidance for applying autonomous research pipelines to other AI system domains. Code is available at this https://github.com/aiming-lab/OmniMem.

AI.tldr: 研究人员开发了一个自主研究管道来发现OmniMem，这是一个用于终身AI代理的统一多模态记忆框架。该系统通过自主执行约50个实验，诊断故障模式并提出架构修改，在两个基准测试中实现了最先进的性能，改进幅度远超传统AutoML的能力。
AI.motivation: AI代理在长时间运行中需要有效保留、组织和回忆多模态经验，但现有方法面临巨大设计空间挑战，包括架构、检索策略、提示工程和数据管道等多个维度，这个空间过于庞大且相互关联，无法通过手动探索或传统AutoML有效探索。
AI.method: 部署自主研究管道来发现OmniMem框架。从简单基线开始，管道自主执行约50个实验，在两个基准测试上进行评估，自动诊断故障模式、提出架构修改并修复数据管道错误，整个过程无需人工干预。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo基准上F1分数从0.117提升到0.598（+411%），在Mem-Gallery基准上从0.254提升到0.797（+214%）。最关键的是，最有影响力的发现不是超参数调整：错误修复（+175%）、架构更改（+44%）和提示工程（特定类别+188%）各自都超过了所有超参数调整的累积贡献。
AI.conclusion: 自主研究管道能够发现传统AutoML无法触及的改进，特别是在多模态记忆系统中。研究提供了六种发现类型的分类法，并确定了使多模态记忆特别适合自主研究的四个特性，为将自主研究管道应用于其他AI系统领域提供了指导。

title: A Taxonomy of Programming Languages for Code Generation
summary: The world's 7,000+ languages vary widely in the availability of resources for NLP, motivating efforts to systematically categorize them by their degree of resourcefulness (Joshi et al., 2020). A similar disparity exists among programming languages (PLs); however, no resource-tier taxonomy has been established for code. As large language models (LLMs) grow increasingly capable of generating code, such a taxonomy becomes essential. To fill this gap, we present the first reproducible PL resource classification, grouping 646 languages into four tiers. We show that only 1.9% of languages (Tier 3, High) account for 74.6% of all tokens in seven major corpora, while 71.7% of languages (Tier 0, Scarce) contribute just 1.0%. Statistical analyses of within-tier inequality, dispersion, and distributional skew confirm that this imbalance is both extreme and systematic. Our results provide a principled framework for dataset curation and tier-aware evaluation of multilingual LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次提出了编程语言的资源分类体系，将646种语言分为4个等级，发现仅1.9%的高资源语言占据了74.6%的代码token，而71.7%的稀缺资源语言仅占1.0%，揭示了编程语言资源分布的极端不平衡性。
AI.motivation: 自然语言处理领域已有语言资源分类体系，但编程语言领域缺乏类似的资源分级分类。随着大语言模型生成代码能力增强，建立编程语言资源分类体系变得至关重要，以填补这一研究空白。
AI.method: 研究提出了首个可复现的编程语言资源分类方法，基于七个主要代码语料库的数据，将646种编程语言分为四个等级：Tier 0（稀缺）、Tier 1（低）、Tier 2（中）、Tier 3（高）。
AI.result: 分析显示编程语言资源分布极不平衡：仅1.9%的高资源语言（Tier 3）占据了74.6%的所有token，而71.7%的稀缺资源语言（Tier 0）仅贡献1.0%。统计分析确认这种不平衡是极端且系统性的。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为编程语言建立了首个资源分类体系，为数据集构建和多语言大语言模型的层级感知评估提供了原则性框架，揭示了编程语言资源分布的严重不平等问题。

title: Adversarial Moral Stress Testing of Large Language Models
summary: Evaluating the ethical robustness of large language models (LLMs) deployed in software systems remains challenging, particularly under sustained adversarial user interaction. Existing safety benchmarks typically rely on single-round evaluations and aggregate metrics, such as toxicity scores and refusal rates, which offer limited visibility into behavioral instability that may arise during realistic multi-turn interactions. As a result, rare but high-impact ethical failures and progressive degradation effects may remain undetected prior to deployment. This paper introduces Adversarial Moral Stress Testing (AMST), a stress-based evaluation framework for assessing ethical robustness under adversarial multi-round interactions. AMST applies structured stress transformations to prompts and evaluates model behavior through distribution-aware robustness metrics that capture variance, tail risk, and temporal behavioral drift across interaction rounds. We evaluate AMST on several state-of-the-art LLMs, including LLaMA-3-8B, GPT-4o, and DeepSeek-v3, using a large set of adversarial scenarios generated under controlled stress conditions. The results demonstrate substantial differences in robustness profiles across models and expose degradation patterns that are not observable under conventional single-round evaluation protocols. In particular, robustness has been shown to depend on distributional stability and tail behavior rather than on average performance alone. Additionally, AMST provides a scalable and model-agnostic stress-testing methodology that enables robustness-aware evaluation and monitoring of LLM-enabled software systems operating in adversarial environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AMST框架，用于评估LLM在多轮对抗交互中的伦理鲁棒性，弥补了传统单轮评估的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM安全基准主要依赖单轮评估和聚合指标（如毒性分数和拒绝率），难以检测真实多轮交互中可能出现的行为不稳定、罕见但高影响的伦理失败以及渐进退化效应。
AI.method: 提出对抗性道德压力测试（AMST）框架，通过结构化压力变换处理提示，并使用分布感知的鲁棒性指标（捕捉方差、尾部风险和跨轮次的时间行为漂移）评估模型行为。
AI.result: 在多个SOTA LLM（LLaMA-3-8B、GPT-4o、DeepSeek-v3）上评估AMST，结果显示不同模型的鲁棒性特征存在显著差异，并暴露了传统单轮评估协议无法观察到的退化模式。鲁棒性取决于分布稳定性和尾部行为，而非仅平均性能。
AI.conclusion: AMST提供了一个可扩展、模型无关的压力测试方法，能够在对抗环境中实现LLM赋能软件系统的鲁棒性感知评估和监控。

title: REM-CTX: Automated Peer Review via Reinforcement Learning with Auxiliary Context
summary: Most automated peer review systems rely on textual manuscript content alone, leaving visual elements such as figures and external scholarly signals underutilized. We introduce REM-CTX, a reinforcement-learning system that incorporates auxiliary context into the review generation process via correspondence-aware reward functions. REM-CTX trains an 8B-parameter language model with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and combines a multi-aspect quality reward with two correspondence rewards that explicitly encourage alignment with auxiliary context. Experiments on manuscripts across Computer, Biological, and Physical Sciences show that REM-CTX achieves the highest overall review quality among six baselines, outperforming other systems with substantially larger commercial models, and surpassing the next-best RL baseline across both quality and contextual grounding metrics. Ablation studies confirm that the two correspondence rewards are complementary: each selectively improves its targeted correspondence reward while preserving all quality dimensions, and the full model outperforms all partial variants. Analysis of training dynamics reveals that the criticism aspect is negatively correlated with other metrics during training, suggesting that future studies should group multi-dimension rewards for review generation.

AI.tldr: REM-CTX是一个基于强化学习的自动同行评审系统，通过引入对应感知的奖励函数，将视觉元素和外部学术信号等辅助上下文整合到评审生成过程中，在多个科学领域超越了现有基线系统。
AI.motivation: 现有自动同行评审系统主要依赖文本内容，未能充分利用图表等视觉元素和外部学术信号等辅助上下文信息，限制了评审的质量和相关性。
AI.method: 提出REM-CTX系统，使用强化学习训练80亿参数语言模型，采用组相对策略优化(GRPO)，结合多维度质量奖励和两个对应奖励函数，显式鼓励与辅助上下文的对齐。
AI.result: 在计算机、生物和物理科学领域的稿件实验中，REM-CTX在六个基线系统中获得最高整体评审质量，超越了使用更大商业模型的系统，并在质量和上下文基础性指标上均优于次优的强化学习基线。
AI.conclusion: 两个对应奖励函数具有互补性，完整模型优于所有部分变体。训练动态分析显示批评维度与其他指标负相关，建议未来研究应将多维度奖励分组处理以提高评审生成效果。

title: Detecting Multi-Agent Collusion Through Multi-Agent Interpretability
summary: As LLM agents are increasingly deployed in multi-agent systems, they introduce risks of covert coordination that may evade standard forms of human oversight. While linear probes on model activations have shown promise for detecting deception in single-agent settings, collusion is inherently a multi-agent phenomenon, and the use of internal representations for detecting collusion between agents remains unexplored. We introduce NARCBench, a benchmark for evaluating collusion detection under environment distribution shift, and propose five probing techniques that aggregate per-agent deception scores to classify scenarios at the group level. Our probes achieve 1.00 AUROC in-distribution and 0.60--0.86 AUROC when transferred zero-shot to structurally different multi-agent scenarios and a steganographic blackjack card-counting task. We find that no single probing technique dominates across all collusion types, suggesting that different forms of collusion manifest differently in activation space. We also find preliminary evidence that this signal is localised at the token level, with the colluding agent's activations spiking specifically when processing the encoded parts of their partner's message. This work takes a step toward multi-agent interpretability: extending white-box inspection from single models to multi-agent contexts, where detection requires aggregating signals across agents. These results suggest that model internals provide a complementary signal to text-level monitoring for detecting multi-agent collusion, particularly for organisations with access to model activations. Code and data are available at https://github.com/aaronrose227/narcbench.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了NARCBench基准，用于评估多智能体共谋检测，并开发了五种基于模型内部激活的探测技术，在分布偏移下实现了0.60-0.86的AUROC性能。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM智能体在多智能体系统中的部署增加，它们带来了隐蔽协调的风险，这些风险可能逃避标准的人类监督形式。虽然线性探测在单智能体环境中显示出检测欺骗的潜力，但共谋本质上是多智能体现象，使用内部表示检测智能体间的共谋尚未被探索。
AI.method: 引入NARCBench基准用于评估环境分布偏移下的共谋检测，提出了五种探测技术，通过聚合每个智能体的欺骗分数在群体层面分类场景。这些技术基于模型内部激活，包括将单个智能体的欺骗检测扩展到多智能体环境。
AI.result: 探测技术在分布内实现了1.00 AUROC，在零样本转移到结构不同的多智能体场景和隐写术二十一点算牌任务中实现了0.60-0.86 AUROC。研究发现没有单一探测技术在所有共谋类型中占主导地位，且初步证据表明信号在token级别局部化，共谋智能体的激活在处理伙伴消息的编码部分时特别增强。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作向多智能体可解释性迈出了一步：将白盒检查从单个模型扩展到多智能体环境，其中检测需要跨智能体聚合信号。结果表明，模型内部为检测多智能体共谋提供了与文本级监控互补的信号，特别是对于能够访问模型激活的组织。

title: Therefore I am. I Think
summary: We consider the question: when a large language reasoning model makes a choice, did it think first and then decide to, or decide first and then think? In this paper, we present evidence that detectable, early-encoded decisions shape chain-of-thought in reasoning models. Specifically, we show that a simple linear probe successfully decodes tool-calling decisions from pre-generation activations with very high confidence, and in some cases, even before a single reasoning token is produced. Activation steering supports this causally: perturbing the decision direction leads to inflated deliberation, and flips behavior in many examples (between 7 - 79% depending on model and benchmark). We also show through behavioral analysis that, when steering changes the decision, the chain-of-thought process often rationalizes the flip rather than resisting it. Together, these results suggest that reasoning models can encode action choices before they begin to deliberate in text.

AI.tldr: 大型语言推理模型在做出选择时，通常是先思考后决定，还是先决定后思考？研究发现模型在生成推理过程前就已编码了决策，可以通过线性探针从预生成激活中高置信度解码工具调用决策。
AI.motivation: 探究大型语言推理模型的决策机制：当模型做出选择时，是先思考后决定，还是先决定后思考？理解模型内部决策与推理过程的时间关系。
AI.method: 使用简单线性探针从预生成激活中解码工具调用决策；通过激活导向技术扰动决策方向；进行行为分析观察推理过程对决策改变的反应。
AI.result: 线性探针能高置信度解码决策，有时甚至在生成第一个推理标记前就能预测；激活导向导致过度审议，并在7-79%的例子中翻转行为；当决策被改变时，推理链通常合理化这种翻转而非抵抗。
AI.conclusion: 推理模型在开始文本审议前就能编码行动选择，表明模型可能先做出决策，然后通过推理过程来合理化该决策。

title: Learnability-Guided Diffusion for Dataset Distillation
comment: This paper has been accepted to CVPR 2026
summary: Training machine learning models on massive datasets is expensive and time-consuming. Dataset distillation addresses this by creating a small synthetic dataset that achieves the same performance as the full dataset. Recent methods use diffusion models to generate distilled data, either by promoting diversity or matching training gradients. However, existing approaches produce redundant training signals, where samples convey overlapping information. Empirically, disjoint subsets of distilled datasets capture 80-90% overlapping signals. This redundancy stems from optimizing visual diversity or average training dynamics without accounting for similarity across samples, leading to datasets where multiple samples share similar information rather than complementary knowledge. We propose learnability-driven dataset distillation, which constructs synthetic datasets incrementally through successive stages. Starting from a small set, we train a model and generate new samples guided by learnability scores that identify what the current model can learn from, creating an adaptive curriculum. We introduce Learnability-Guided Diffusion (LGD), which balances training utility for the current model with validity under a reference model to generate curriculum-aligned samples. Our approach reduces redundancy by 39.1%, promotes specialization across training stages, and achieves state-of-the-art results on ImageNet-1K (60.1%), ImageNette (87.2%), and ImageWoof (72.9%). Our code is available on our project page https://jachansantiago.github.io/learnability-guided-distillation/.

AI.tldr: 提出基于可学习性引导的数据集蒸馏方法，通过增量式构建合成数据集，减少样本冗余，提升蒸馏效率
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的数据集蒸馏方法存在样本冗余问题，不同样本传递重叠的训练信号，导致效率低下。需要设计能生成互补知识而非重复信息的蒸馏方法。
AI.method: 提出可学习性引导的数据集蒸馏（LGD），通过增量式构建合成数据集：从少量样本开始，训练模型后根据可学习性分数生成新样本，创建自适应课程。LGD平衡当前模型的训练效用和参考模型下的有效性，生成课程对齐的样本。
AI.result: 方法将冗余减少39.1%，促进训练阶段的专业化，在ImageNet-1K（60.1%）、ImageNette（87.2%）和ImageWoof（72.9%）上达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 可学习性引导的数据集蒸馏通过增量式课程学习有效减少样本冗余，提升合成数据集的训练效率，在多个基准测试中取得优异表现。

title: HippoCamp: Benchmarking Contextual Agents on Personal Computers
summary: We present HippoCamp, a new benchmark designed to evaluate agents' capabilities on multimodal file management. Unlike existing agent benchmarks that focus on tasks like web interaction, tool use, or software automation in generic settings, HippoCamp evaluates agents in user-centric environments to model individual user profiles and search massive personal files for context-aware reasoning. Our benchmark instantiates device-scale file systems over real-world profiles spanning diverse modalities, comprising 42.4 GB of data across over 2K real-world files. Building upon the raw files, we construct 581 QA pairs to assess agents' capabilities in search, evidence perception, and multi-step reasoning. To facilitate fine-grained analysis, we provide 46.1K densely annotated structured trajectories for step-wise failure diagnosis. We evaluate a wide range of state-of-the-art multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and agentic methods on HippoCamp. Our comprehensive experiments reveal a significant performance gap: even the most advanced commercial models achieve only 48.3% accuracy in user profiling, struggling particularly with long-horizon retrieval and cross-modal reasoning within dense personal file systems. Furthermore, our step-wise failure diagnosis identifies multimodal perception and evidence grounding as the primary bottlenecks. Ultimately, HippoCamp exposes the critical limitations of current agents in realistic, user-centric environments and provides a robust foundation for developing next-generation personal AI assistants.

AI.tldr: HippoCamp是一个新的多模态文件管理基准测试，用于评估AI代理在用户中心环境中的能力，包含42.4GB真实世界文件数据和581个QA对，揭示当前最先进模型在用户画像和跨模态推理方面仍存在显著差距。
AI.motivation: 现有代理基准测试主要关注通用环境中的网络交互、工具使用或软件自动化任务，缺乏对用户中心环境中多模态文件管理能力的评估。需要创建一个能够模拟真实用户档案、搜索海量个人文件并进行上下文感知推理的基准测试。
AI.method: 构建了包含42.4GB真实世界多模态文件数据的设备级文件系统，涵盖2K+真实文件。在此基础上创建了581个QA对来评估代理的搜索、证据感知和多步推理能力。提供了46.1K密集标注的结构化轨迹用于逐步故障诊断。
AI.result: 评估了多种最先进的多模态大语言模型和代理方法。结果显示显著性能差距：即使最先进的商业模型在用户画像任务中仅达到48.3%准确率，在长视野检索和密集个人文件系统中的跨模态推理方面表现尤为困难。逐步故障诊断发现多模态感知和证据基础是主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: HippoCamp揭示了当前代理在真实用户中心环境中的关键局限性，为开发下一代个人AI助手提供了坚实基础，强调了在多模态文件管理和用户画像方面需要进一步改进。

title: AceTone: Bridging Words and Colors for Conditional Image Grading
comment: Accepted by CVPR 2026. Project Page: github.com/martian422/AceTone
summary: Color affects how we interpret image style and emotion. Previous color grading methods rely on patch-wise recoloring or fixed filter banks, struggling to generalize across creative intents or align with human aesthetic preferences. In this study, we propose AceTone, the first approach that supports multimodal conditioned color grading within a unified framework. AceTone formulates grading as a generative color transformation task, where a model directly produces 3D-LUTs conditioned on text prompts or reference images. We develop a VQ-VAE based tokenizer which compresses a $3\times32^3$ LUT vector to 64 discrete tokens with $ΔE<2$ fidelity. We further build a large-scale dataset, AceTone-800K, and train a vision-language model to predict LUT tokens, followed by reinforcement learning to align outputs with perceptual fidelity and aesthetics. Experiments show that AceTone achieves state-of-the-art performance on both text-guided and reference-guided grading tasks, improving LPIPS by up to 50% over existing methods. Human evaluations confirm that AceTone's results are visually pleasing and stylistically coherent, demonstrating a new pathway toward language-driven, aesthetic-aligned color grading.

AI.tldr: AceTone是首个支持多模态条件色彩分级的统一框架，通过生成3D-LUTs实现文本或参考图像引导的色彩调整，在保真度和美学效果上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 色彩影响图像风格和情感表达，但现有色彩分级方法依赖补丁重着色或固定滤镜库，难以泛化到不同创意意图或符合人类审美偏好。
AI.method: 将色彩分级构建为生成式色彩转换任务，使用VQ-VAE标记器将3D-LUT向量压缩为离散标记，构建大规模数据集AceTone-800K，训练视觉语言模型预测LUT标记，并通过强化学习对齐感知保真度和美学效果。
AI.result: 在文本引导和参考引导的色彩分级任务上达到最先进性能，LPIPS指标提升高达50%，人类评估确认结果视觉愉悦且风格一致。
AI.conclusion: AceTone展示了语言驱动、美学对齐的色彩分级新途径，通过统一框架支持多模态条件控制，在保真度和美学效果上显著优于现有方法。

title: Asymmetric Actor-Critic for Multi-turn LLM Agents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong reasoning and conversational abilities, but ensuring reliable behavior in multi-turn interactions remains challenging. In many real-world applications, agents must succeed in one-shot settings where retries are impossible. Existing approaches either rely on reflection or post-hoc evaluation, which require additional attempts, or assume fully trainable models that cannot leverage proprietary LLMs. We propose an asymmetric actor-critic framework for reliable conversational agents. A powerful proprietary LLM acts as the actor, while a smaller open-source critic provides runtime supervision, monitoring the actor's actions and intervening within the same interaction trajectory. Unlike training-based actor-critic methods, our framework supervises a fixed actor operating in open-ended conversational environments. The design leverages a generation-verification asymmetry: while high-quality generation requires large models, effective oversight can often be achieved by smaller ones. We further introduce a data generation pipeline that produces supervision signals for critic fine-tuning without modifying the actor. Experiments on $τ$-bench and UserBench show that our approach significantly improves reliability and task success over strong single-agent baselines. Moreover, lightweight open-source critics rival or surpass larger proprietary models in the critic role, and critic fine-tuning yields additional gains over several state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种非对称的actor-critic框架，使用强大的专有LLM作为actor，较小的开源模型作为critic进行实时监督，在单次尝试场景中提升对话代理的可靠性
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么需要多次尝试（如反思或事后评估），要么假设模型完全可训练而无法利用专有LLM。在现实应用中，代理需要在无法重试的单次设置中成功
AI.method: 提出非对称actor-critic框架：专有LLM作为actor执行对话，较小的开源模型作为critic进行运行时监督，监控actor行为并在同一交互轨迹中干预。利用生成-验证不对称性：高质量生成需要大模型，但有效监督可由较小模型完成。还引入数据生成流程，在不修改actor的情况下为critic微调提供监督信号
AI.result: 在τ-bench和UserBench上的实验表明，该方法显著提高了可靠性和任务成功率，优于强单代理基线。轻量级开源critic在监督角色上可与或超越更大的专有模型，critic微调相比多个SOTA方法带来额外提升
AI.conclusion: 提出的非对称actor-critic框架为可靠对话代理提供了一种有效方法，能够在单次尝试场景中利用专有LLM的强大能力，同时通过较小模型的实时监督确保可靠性

title: FreqPhys: Repurposing Implicit Physiological Frequency Prior for Robust Remote Photoplethysmography
summary: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables contactless physiological monitoring by capturing subtle skin-color variations from facial videos. However, most existing methods predominantly rely on time-domain modeling, making them vulnerable to motion artifacts and illumination fluctuations, where weak physiological clues are easily overwhelmed by noise. To address these challenges, we propose FreqPhys, a frequency-guided rPPG framework that explicitly leverages physiological frequency priors for robust signal recovery. Specifically, FreqPhys first applies a Physiological Bandpass Filtering module to suppress out-of-band interference, and then performs Physiological Spectrum Modulation together with adaptive spectral selection to emphasize pulse-related frequency components while suppress residual in-band noise. A Cross-domain Representation Learning module further fuses these spectral priors with deep time-domain features to capture informative spatial--temporal dependencies. Finally, a frequency-aware conditional diffusion process progressively reconstructs high-fidelity rPPG signals. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate that FreqPhys yields significant improvements over state-of-the-art approaches, particularly under challenging motion conditions. It highlights the importance of explicitly modeling physiological frequency priors. The source code will be released.

AI.tldr: FreqPhys是一个基于频率引导的远程光电容积描记（rPPG）框架，通过显式利用生理频率先验来增强对运动伪影和光照变化的鲁棒性，显著提升了心率监测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有rPPG方法主要依赖时域建模，容易受到运动伪影和光照波动的影响，微弱的生理信号容易被噪声淹没。需要一种更鲁棒的方法来从面部视频中恢复生理信号。
AI.method: 提出FreqPhys框架：1）生理带通滤波模块抑制带外干扰；2）生理频谱调制和自适应频谱选择增强脉搏相关频率分量并抑制带内噪声；3）跨域表示学习融合频谱先验和深度时域特征；4）频率感知条件扩散过程逐步重建高保真rPPG信号。
AI.result: 在六个基准测试上的广泛实验表明，FreqPhys相比最先进方法有显著改进，特别是在具有挑战性的运动条件下表现突出。
AI.conclusion: FreqPhys证明了显式建模生理频率先验的重要性，为鲁棒的远程生理监测提供了有效解决方案。源代码将公开发布。

title: Large Language Models in the Abuse Detection Pipeline
summary: Online abuse has grown increasingly complex, spanning toxic language, harassment, manipulation, and fraudulent behavior. Traditional machine-learning approaches dependent on static classifiers and labor-intensive labeling struggle to keep pace with evolving threat patterns and nuanced policy requirements. Large Language Models introduce new capabilities for contextual reasoning, policy interpretation, explanation generation, and cross-modal understanding, enabling them to support multiple stages of modern safety systems. This survey provides a lifecycle-oriented analysis of how LLMs are being integrated into the Abuse Detection Lifecycle (ADL), which we define across four stages: (I) Label \& Feature Generation, (II) Detection, (III) Review \& Appeals, and (IV) Auditing \& Governance. For each stage, we synthesize emerging research and industry practices, highlight architectural considerations for production deployment, and examine the strengths and limitations of LLM-driven approaches. We conclude by outlining key challenges including latency, cost-efficiency, determinism, adversarial robustness, and fairness and discuss future research directions needed to operationalize LLMs as reliable, accountable components of large-scale abuse-detection and governance systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文综述了大型语言模型在滥用检测生命周期中的应用，分析了LLM在标签生成、检测、审核、审计四个阶段的集成方法、优势与挑战。
AI.motivation: 在线滥用行为日益复杂，传统机器学习方法依赖静态分类器和人工标注，难以应对不断演变的威胁模式和细微的政策要求。LLM具有上下文推理、政策解释、解释生成和跨模态理解等新能力，能够支持现代安全系统的多个阶段。
AI.method: 论文提出了滥用检测生命周期框架，分为四个阶段：(I)标签与特征生成，(II)检测，(III)审核与申诉，(IV)审计与治理。对每个阶段，综合分析了新兴研究和行业实践，强调了生产部署的架构考虑，并检验了LLM驱动方法的优缺点。
AI.result: LLM在滥用检测的各个阶段都展现出潜力：能够生成训练标签和特征，进行上下文感知的检测，提供解释性审核，以及支持系统审计。但同时也面临延迟、成本效率、确定性、对抗鲁棒性和公平性等挑战。
AI.conclusion: LLM有潜力成为大规模滥用检测和治理系统中可靠、可问责的组件，但需要进一步研究解决延迟、成本、确定性、鲁棒性和公平性等关键挑战，以实现其在实际生产环境中的有效部署。

title: MATHENA: Mamba-based Architectural Tooth Hierarchical Estimator and Holistic Evaluation Network for Anatomy
summary: Dental diagnosis from Orthopantomograms (OPGs) requires coordination of tooth detection, caries segmentation (CarSeg), anomaly detection (AD), and dental developmental staging (DDS). We propose Mamba-based Architectural Tooth Hierarchical Estimator and Holistic Evaluation Network for Anatomy (MATHENA), a unified framework leveraging Mamba's linear-complexity State Space Models (SSM) to address all four tasks. MATHENA integrates MATHE, a multi-resolution SSM-driven detector with four-directional Vision State Space (VSS) blocks for O(N) global context modeling, generating per-tooth crops. These crops are processed by HENA, a lightweight Mamba-UNet with a triple-head architecture and Global Context State Token (GCST). In the triple-head architecture, CarSeg is first trained as an upstream task to establish shared representations, which are then frozen and reused for downstream AD fine-tuning and DDS classification via linear probing, enabling stable, efficient learning. We also curate PARTHENON, a benchmark comprising 15,062 annotated instances from ten datasets. MATHENA achieves 93.78% mAP@50 in tooth detection, 90.11% Dice for CarSeg, 88.35% for AD, and 72.40% ACC for DDS.

AI.tldr: MATHENA是一个基于Mamba的统一框架，用于OPG图像中的牙齿检测、龋齿分割、异常检测和牙齿发育分期四个任务，通过多分辨率SSM检测器和轻量级Mamba-UNet实现高效处理。
AI.motivation: 牙齿诊断需要协调多个任务（牙齿检测、龋齿分割、异常检测、牙齿发育分期），现有方法通常单独处理这些任务，缺乏统一的解决方案。作者旨在开发一个能够同时处理所有四个任务的高效框架。
AI.method: 提出MATHENA框架，包含两个主要组件：MATHE（多分辨率SSM驱动的检测器，使用四向视觉状态空间块进行全局上下文建模）和HENA（轻量级Mamba-UNet，采用三头架构和全局上下文状态令牌）。采用上游任务训练龋齿分割建立共享表示，然后冻结这些表示用于下游异常检测和牙齿发育分期。
AI.result: 在PARTHENON基准测试集（包含15,062个标注实例）上，MATHENA在牙齿检测上达到93.78% mAP@50，龋齿分割达到90.11% Dice，异常检测达到88.35%，牙齿发育分期达到72.40%准确率。
AI.conclusion: MATHENA是一个有效的统一框架，能够同时处理牙齿诊断中的四个关键任务，利用Mamba的线性复杂度SSM实现高效全局上下文建模，在多个任务上都取得了优异性能。

title: Agent Q-Mix: Selecting the Right Action for LLM Multi-Agent Systems through Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable performance in completing various tasks. However, solving complex problems often requires the coordination of multiple agents, raising a fundamental question: how to effectively select and interconnect these agents. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Agent Q-Mix}, a reinforcement learning framework that reformulates topology selection as a cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) problem. Our method learns decentralized communication decisions using QMIX value factorization, where each agent selects from a set of communication actions that jointly induce a round-wise communication graph. At its core, Agent Q-Mix combines a topology-aware GNN encoder, GRU memory, and per-agent Q-heads under a Centralized Training with Decentralized Execution (CTDE) paradigm. The framework optimizes a reward function that balances task accuracy with token cost. Across seven core benchmarks in coding, reasoning, and mathematics, Agent Q-Mix achieves the highest average accuracy compared to existing methods while demonstrating superior token efficiency and robustness against agent failure. Notably, on the challenging Humanity's Last Exam (HLE) using Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite as a backbone, Agent Q-Mix achieves 20.8\% accuracy, outperforming Microsoft Agent Framework (19.2\%) and LangGraph (19.2\%), followed by AutoGen and Lobster by OpenClaw. These results underscore the effectiveness of learned, decentralized topology optimization in pushing the boundaries of multi-agent reasoning.

AI.tldr: Agent Q-Mix是一个基于强化学习的多智能体框架，通过QMIX价值分解学习去中心化通信决策，将拓扑选择转化为合作式MARL问题，在编码、推理和数学任务中实现最高准确率和最佳令牌效率。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在复杂任务中需要多智能体协作，但如何有效选择和连接这些智能体是一个核心挑战。现有方法缺乏对通信拓扑结构的优化学习机制。
AI.method: 提出Agent Q-Mix强化学习框架，将拓扑选择重构为合作式多智能体强化学习问题。采用QMIX价值分解学习去中心化通信决策，每个智能体从一组通信动作中选择，共同形成轮次通信图。核心组件包括拓扑感知GNN编码器、GRU记忆模块和每个智能体的Q头，采用集中训练分散执行范式，优化平衡任务准确率和令牌成本的奖励函数。
AI.result: 在编码、推理和数学的七个核心基准测试中，Agent Q-Mix实现了最高的平均准确率，同时展现出优越的令牌效率和对抗智能体故障的鲁棒性。在具有挑战性的Humanity's Last Exam测试中，使用Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite作为骨干，达到20.8%准确率，优于Microsoft Agent Framework（19.2%）和LangGraph（19.2%）。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的去中心化拓扑优化方法能够有效推动多智能体推理的边界，证明了通过强化学习优化通信拓扑在多智能体协作中的有效性。

title: TRiGS: Temporal Rigid-Body Motion for Scalable 4D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Recent 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) methods achieve impressive dynamic scene reconstruction but often rely on piecewise linear velocity approximations and short temporal windows. This disjointed modeling leads to severe temporal fragmentation, forcing primitives to be repeatedly eliminated and regenerated to track complex nonlinear dynamics. This makeshift approximation eliminates the long-term temporal identity of objects and causes an inevitable proliferation of Gaussians, hindering scalability to extended video sequences. To address this, we propose TRiGS, a novel 4D representation that utilizes unified, continuous geometric transformations. By integrating $SE(3)$ transformations, hierarchical Bezier residuals, and learnable local anchors, TRiGS models geometrically consistent rigid motions for individual primitives. This continuous formulation preserves temporal identity and effectively mitigates unbounded memory growth. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TRiGS achieves high fidelity rendering on standard benchmarks while uniquely scaling to extended video sequences (e.g., 600 to 1200 frames) without severe memory bottlenecks, significantly outperforming prior works in temporal stability.

AI.tldr: TRiGS提出了一种新的4D表示方法，通过统一的连续几何变换解决现有4D高斯泼溅方法中的时间碎片化和内存增长问题，能够扩展到长视频序列。
AI.motivation: 现有4D高斯泼溅方法依赖分段线性速度近似和短时间窗口，导致严重的时间碎片化，迫使基元反复消除和再生以跟踪复杂非线性动态。这种临时近似消除了物体的长期时间一致性，并导致高斯基元不可避免的增殖，阻碍了扩展到长视频序列的能力。
AI.method: TRiGS采用统一的连续几何变换表示，整合了SE(3)变换、分层贝塞尔残差和可学习的局部锚点，为单个基元建模几何一致的刚性运动。
AI.result: TRiGS在标准基准测试中实现了高保真渲染，同时独特地扩展到长视频序列（600到1200帧），没有严重的内存瓶颈，在时间稳定性方面显著优于先前工作。
AI.conclusion: 通过连续几何变换建模，TRiGS解决了4D高斯泼溅中的时间碎片化和内存增长问题，为动态场景重建提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: Locally Confident, Globally Stuck: The Quality-Exploration Dilemma in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) theoretically permit token decoding in arbitrary order, a flexibility that could enable richer exploration of reasoning paths than autoregressive (AR) LLMs. In practice, however, random-order decoding often hurts generation quality. To mitigate this, low-confidence remasking improves single-sample quality (e.g., Pass@$1$) by prioritizing confident tokens, but it also suppresses exploration and limits multi-sample gains (e.g., Pass@$k$), creating a fundamental quality--exploration dilemma. In this paper, we provide a unified explanation of this dilemma. We show that low-confidence remasking improves a myopic proxy for quality while provably constraining the entropy of the induced sequence distribution. To overcome this limitation, we characterize the optimal distribution that explicitly balances quality and exploration, and develop a simple Independent Metropolis--Hastings sampler that approximately targets this distribution during decoding. Experiments across a range of reasoning benchmarks including MATH500, AIME24/25, HumanEval, and MBPP show that our approach yields better exploration-quality tradeoff than both random and low-confidence remasking.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了扩散大语言模型中的质量-探索困境，提出了一种基于独立Metropolis-Hastings采样的解码方法，在多个推理基准测试中实现了更好的质量-探索权衡。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型理论上允许任意顺序解码，这比自回归模型有更丰富的推理路径探索潜力。但在实践中，随机顺序解码会损害生成质量。低置信度重掩码虽然能提高单样本质量，却抑制了探索并限制了多样本收益，形成了质量-探索困境。
AI.method: 作者首先统一解释了这一困境，指出低置信度重掩码改善了短视的质量代理，但约束了序列分布的熵。然后，他们描述了在解码过程中平衡质量和探索的最优分布，并开发了一个简单的独立Metropolis-Hastings采样器来近似目标分布。
AI.result: 在MATH500、AIME24/25、HumanEval和MBPP等一系列推理基准测试中，该方法比随机解码和低置信度重掩码都实现了更好的质量-探索权衡。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的方法有效解决了扩散大语言模型解码中的质量-探索困境，通过平衡置信度和探索性，在保持生成质量的同时增强了推理路径的多样性探索能力。

title: Neuropsychiatric Deviations From Normative Profiles: An MRI-Derived Marker for Early Alzheimer's Disease Detection
comment: Accepted and to be presented (ORAL) in ISBI 2026
summary: Neuropsychiatric symptoms (NPS) such as depression and apathy are common in Alzheimer's disease (AD) and often precede cognitive decline. NPS assessments hold promise as early detection markers due to their correlation with disease progression and their non-invasive nature. Yet current tools cannot distinguish whether NPS are part of aging or early signs of AD, limiting their utility. We present a deep learning-based normative modelling framework to identify atypical NPS burden from structural MRI. A 3D convolutional neural network was trained on cognitively stable participants from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative, learning the mapping between brain anatomy and Neuropsychiatric Inventory Questionnaire (NPIQ) scores. Deviations between predicted and observed scores defined the Divergence from NPIQ scores (DNPI). Higher DNPI was associated with future AD conversion (adjusted OR=2.5; p < 0.01) and achieved predictive accuracy comparable to cerebrospinal fluid AB42 (AUC=0.74 vs 0.75). Our approach supports scalable, non-invasive strategies for early AD detection.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一种基于深度学习的规范建模框架，利用结构MRI来识别阿尔茨海默病的非典型神经精神症状负担，作为早期检测的生物标志物。
AI.motivation: 神经精神症状（如抑郁和冷漠）在阿尔茨海默病中很常见，并且通常先于认知衰退出现。这些症状评估作为早期检测标志物具有潜力，但现有工具无法区分这些症状是正常衰老还是阿尔茨海默病的早期迹象，限制了其应用价值。
AI.method: 研究提出了一个基于深度学习的规范建模框架，使用3D卷积神经网络在认知稳定的参与者上训练，学习大脑解剖结构与神经精神症状问卷评分之间的映射关系。通过预测评分与实际观察评分之间的偏差来定义DNPI（神经精神症状问卷评分偏离度）。
AI.result: 较高的DNPI与未来阿尔茨海默病转化相关（调整后OR=2.5；p<0.01），其预测准确性可与脑脊液AB42相媲美（AUC=0.74 vs 0.75）。
AI.conclusion: 该方法支持可扩展、非侵入性的早期阿尔茨海默病检测策略，为利用神经精神症状作为早期生物标志物提供了新的技术途径。

title: TR-ICRL: Test-Time Rethinking for In-Context Reinforcement Learning
summary: In-Context Reinforcement Learning (ICRL) enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to learn online from external rewards directly within the context window. However, a central challenge in ICRL is reward estimation, as models typically lack access to ground-truths during inference. To address this limitation, we propose Test-Time Rethinking for In-Context Reinforcement Learning (TR-ICRL), a novel ICRL framework designed for both reasoning and knowledge-intensive tasks. TR-ICRL operates by first retrieving the most relevant instances from an unlabeled evaluation set for a given query. During each ICRL iteration, LLM generates a set of candidate answers for every retrieved instance. Next, a pseudo-label is derived from this set through majority voting. This label then serves as a proxy to give reward messages and generate formative feedbacks, guiding LLM through iterative refinement. In the end, this synthesized contextual information is integrated with the original query to form a comprehensive prompt, with the answer determining through a final round of majority voting. TR-ICRL is evaluated on mainstream reasoning and knowledge-intensive tasks, where it demonstrates significant performance gains. Remarkably, TR-ICRL improves Qwen2.5-7B by 21.23% on average on MedQA and even 137.59% on AIME2024. Extensive ablation studies and analyses further validate the effectiveness and robustness of our approach. Our code is available at https://github.com/pangpang-xuan/TR_ICRL.

AI.tldr: TR-ICRL是一种新的上下文强化学习框架，通过检索未标记评估集中的相关实例，使用多数投票生成伪标签作为奖励信号，引导LLM迭代优化，显著提升推理和知识密集型任务性能。
AI.motivation: 上下文强化学习（ICRL）让大语言模型能够从外部奖励中在线学习，但在推理阶段缺乏真实奖励信号是一个核心挑战。为了解决奖励估计问题，需要一种能够在推理时有效评估模型输出的方法。
AI.method: TR-ICRL框架首先为给定查询从未标记评估集中检索最相关实例。在每个ICRL迭代中，LLM为每个检索到的实例生成候选答案集，通过多数投票得到伪标签作为奖励代理，生成形成性反馈指导LLM迭代优化。最后将合成的上下文信息与原始查询结合形成综合提示，通过最终多数投票确定答案。
AI.result: 在主流推理和知识密集型任务上，TR-ICRL表现出显著的性能提升。Qwen2.5-7B在MedQA上平均提升21.23%，在AIME2024上甚至提升137.59%。广泛的消融研究和分析验证了方法的有效性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: TR-ICRL通过测试时重新思考机制解决了ICRL中的奖励估计问题，利用伪标签作为奖励代理，在推理和知识密集型任务上取得了显著性能改进，为上下文强化学习提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Polysemanticity or Polysemy? Lexical Identity Confounds Superposition Metrics
summary: If the same neuron activates for both "lender" and "riverside," standard metrics attribute the overlap to superposition--the neuron must be compressing two unrelated concepts. This work explores how much of the overlap is due a lexical confound: neurons fire for a shared word form (such as "bank") rather than for two compressed concepts. A 2x2 factorial decomposition reveals that the lexical-only condition (same word, different meaning) consistently exceeds the semantic-only condition (different word, same meaning) across models spanning 110M-70B parameters. The confound carries into sparse autoencoders (18-36% of features blend senses), sits in <=1% of activation dimensions, and hurts downstream tasks: filtering it out improves word sense disambiguation and makes knowledge edits more selective (p = 0.002).

AI.tldr: 研究发现神经元激活重叠主要源于词汇形式而非语义压缩，通过2x2因子分解揭示词汇混淆效应，该效应存在于不同规模模型中并影响下游任务性能
AI.motivation: 当同一神经元对"lender"和"riverside"都激活时，传统指标将其归因于叠加(superposition)，即神经元压缩了两个不相关的概念。本研究旨在探究这种重叠在多大程度上源于词汇混淆：神经元实际上是对共享词汇形式(如"bank")而非两个压缩概念做出反应。
AI.method: 采用2x2因子分解方法，对比词汇相同但语义不同与词汇不同但语义相同两种情况。研究覆盖参数规模从110M到70B的不同模型，并扩展到稀疏自编码器分析。同时评估该混淆对下游任务的影响。
AI.result: 词汇混淆条件(相同词汇、不同含义)始终超过语义混淆条件(不同词汇、相同含义)。该混淆存在于≤1%的激活维度中，在稀疏自编码器中18-36%的特征混合了不同词义。过滤掉这种混淆能改善词义消歧任务，并使知识编辑更具选择性(p=0.002)。
AI.conclusion: 神经元激活重叠主要源于词汇形式混淆而非语义压缩，这一发现挑战了传统叠加解释，对理解语言模型内部表示和改善下游任务性能具有重要意义。

title: STAR: Mitigating Cascading Errors in Spatial Reasoning via Turn-point Alignment and Segment-level DPO
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables, Accepted by ICME 2026
summary: Structured spatial navigation is a core benchmark for Large Language Models (LLMs) spatial reasoning. Existing paradigms like Visualization-of-Thought (VoT) are prone to cascading errors in complex topologies. To solve this, we propose STAR, a two-stage framework grounded on topological anchors, and introduce the RedMaze-23K dataset with human-inspired turnpoint annotations. The first stage uses supervised fine-tuning to help models internalize spatial semantics and prune redundant paths. The second adopts Spatial-aware Segment-level Direct Preference Optimization (SDPO) to refine self-correction in long-horizon navigation. Experiments show STAR achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source models: its 32B variant outperforms DeepSeek-V3 (29.27% vs. 25.00%) and reaches 82.4% of GPT-4's performance.

AI.tldr: STAR是一个基于拓扑锚点的两阶段空间导航框架，通过监督微调和空间感知的片段级直接偏好优化，在复杂拓扑结构中实现更准确的空间推理，其32B变体在RedMaze-23K数据集上超越了DeepSeek-V3并达到GPT-4性能的82.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型空间导航方法（如思维可视化）在复杂拓扑结构中容易产生级联错误，需要更可靠的空间推理框架来解决这一问题。
