AI.method: 提出STAR两阶段框架：第一阶段使用监督微调帮助模型内化空间语义并剪枝冗余路径；第二阶段采用空间感知的片段级直接偏好优化来改进长视野导航中的自我校正。
AI.result: STAR在开源模型中达到最先进性能：其32B变体在RedMaze-23K数据集上超越DeepSeek-V3（29.27% vs. 25.00%），达到GPT-4性能的82.4%。
AI.conclusion: 基于拓扑锚点的STAR框架通过两阶段训练策略有效解决了复杂空间导航中的级联错误问题，显著提升了LLM在结构化空间导航任务中的性能。

title: Optimsyn: Influence-Guided Rubrics Optimization for Synthetic Data Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong downstream performance largely due to abundant supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data. However, high-quality SFT data in knowledge-intensive domains such as humanities, social sciences, medicine, law, and finance is scarce because expert curation is expensive, privacy constraints are strict, and label consistency is hard to ensure. Recent work uses synthetic data, typically by prompting a generator over domain documents and filtering outputs with handcrafted rubrics. Yet rubric design is expert-dependent, transfers poorly across domains, and is often optimized through a brittle heuristic loop of writing rubrics, synthesizing data, training, inspecting results, and manually guessing revisions. This process lacks reliable quantitative feedback about how a rubric affects downstream performance. We propose evaluating synthetic data by its training utility on the target model and using this signal to guide data generation. Inspired by influence estimation, we adopt an optimizer-aware estimator that uses gradient information to quantify each synthetic sample's contribution to a target model's objective on specific tasks. Our analysis shows that even when synthetic and real samples are close in embedding space, their influence on learning can differ substantially. Based on this insight, we propose an optimization-based framework that adapts rubrics using target-model feedback. We provide lightweight guiding text and use a rubric-specialized model to generate task-conditioned rubrics. Influence score is used as the reward to optimize the rubric generator with reinforcement learning. Experiments across domains, target models, and data generators show consistent improvements and strong generalization without task-specific tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出基于训练效用的合成数据评估方法，使用梯度信息量化合成样本对目标任务的影响，通过强化学习优化评分标准生成，实现跨领域性能提升
AI.motivation: 在人文、社科、医学、法律、金融等知识密集型领域，高质量监督微调数据稀缺，专家标注成本高，隐私限制严格，标签一致性难以保证。现有合成数据方法依赖人工设计的评分标准，但评分标准设计依赖专家经验，跨领域迁移性差，优化过程缺乏可靠的量化反馈机制。
AI.method: 提出基于训练效用的合成数据评估框架：1）采用优化器感知的估计器，利用梯度信息量化每个合成样本对目标模型在特定任务上的贡献；2）基于影响分析，提出优化框架，使用目标模型反馈自适应调整评分标准；3）提供轻量级指导文本，使用评分标准专用模型生成任务条件评分标准；4）以影响分数作为奖励，通过强化学习优化评分标准生成器。
AI.result: 实验表明：1）即使合成样本和真实样本在嵌入空间接近，它们对学习的影响也可能显著不同；2）提出的方法在多个领域、目标模型和数据生成器上均取得一致改进；3）无需任务特定调优即可实现强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过基于训练效用的合成数据评估和优化框架，能够有效解决知识密集型领域高质量监督微调数据稀缺的问题，实现跨领域、跨模型的稳定性能提升，为合成数据生成提供了可靠的量化反馈机制。

title: FecalFed: Privacy-Preserving Poultry Disease Detection via Federated Learning
comment: Accepted to the CVPR 2026 Workshop on Vision for Agriculture
summary: Early detection of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) and endemic poultry diseases is critical for global food security. While computer vision models excel at classifying diseases from fecal imaging, deploying these systems at scale is bottlenecked by farm data privacy concerns and institutional data silos. Furthermore, existing open-source agricultural datasets frequently suffer from severe, undocumented data contamination. In this paper, we introduce $\textbf{FecalFed}$, a privacy-preserving federated learning framework for poultry disease classification. We first curate and release $\texttt{poultry-fecal-fl}$, a rigorously deduplicated dataset of 8,770 unique images across four disease classes, revealing and eliminating a 46.89$\%$ duplication rate in popular public repositories. To simulate realistic agricultural environments, we evaluate FecalFed under highly heterogeneous, non-IID conditions (Dirichlet $α=0.5$). While isolated single-farm training collapses under this data heterogeneity, yielding only 64.86$\%$ accuracy, our federated approach recovers performance without centralizing sensitive data. Specifically, utilizing server-side adaptive optimization (FedAdam) with a Swin-Small architecture achieves 90.31$\%$ accuracy, closely approaching the centralized upper bound of 95.10\%. Furthermore, we demonstrate that an edge-optimized Swin-Tiny model maintains highly competitive performance at 89.74$\%$, establishing a highly efficient, privacy-first blueprint for on-farm avian disease monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FecalFed，一个用于家禽疾病分类的隐私保护联邦学习框架，解决了农场数据隐私和数据孤岛问题，并通过去重数据集和异构数据环境验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 高致病性禽流感和地方性家禽疾病的早期检测对全球粮食安全至关重要。虽然计算机视觉模型在粪便图像疾病分类方面表现出色，但大规模部署受到农场数据隐私问题和机构数据孤岛的限制。此外，现有的开源农业数据集经常存在严重但未记录的数据污染问题。
AI.method: 1. 创建并发布了poultry-fecal-fl数据集，包含8,770张独特图像，覆盖四个疾病类别，消除了流行公共仓库中46.89%的重复数据。2. 提出了FecalFed隐私保护联邦学习框架。3. 在高度异构、非独立同分布条件下评估系统（Dirichlet α=0.5）。4. 使用服务器端自适应优化（FedAdam）配合Swin-Small架构。5. 同时测试了边缘优化的Swin-Tiny模型。
AI.result: 1. 单农场孤立训练在数据异构性下崩溃，准确率仅64.86%。2. 联邦学习方法在不集中敏感数据的情况下恢复了性能：Swin-Small架构达到90.31%准确率，接近集中式上限95.10%。3. 边缘优化的Swin-Tiny模型保持高度竞争力，准确率达89.74%。
AI.conclusion: FecalFed框架为农场禽类疾病监测提供了一个高效、隐私优先的解决方案，在保护数据隐私的同时实现了接近集中式学习的性能，解决了农业领域数据共享和隐私保护的矛盾。

title: A Japanese Benchmark for Evaluating Social Bias in Reasoning Based on Attribution Theory
summary: In enhancing the fairness of Large Language Models (LLMs), evaluating social biases rooted in the cultural contexts of specific linguistic regions is essential. However, most existing Japanese benchmarks heavily rely on translating English data, which does not necessarily provide an evaluation suitable for Japanese culture. Furthermore, they only evaluate bias in the conclusion, failing to capture biases lurking in the reasoning. In this study, based on attribution theory in social psychology, we constructed a new dataset, ``JUBAKU-v2,'' which evaluates the bias in attributing behaviors to in-groups and out-groups within reasoning while fixing the conclusion. This dataset consists of 216 examples reflecting cultural biases specific to Japan. Experimental results verified that it can detect performance differences across models more sensitively than existing benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 研究者构建了日本文化特定的偏见评估数据集JUBAKU-v2，基于归因理论评估推理过程中的群体偏见，比现有基准更敏感地检测模型性能差异。
AI.motivation: 现有日本偏见评估基准主要依赖英语数据翻译，无法反映日本文化背景；且仅评估结论偏见，忽略了推理过程中的偏见。需要构建能评估日本文化特定偏见、特别是推理过程中群体归因偏见的数据集。
AI.method: 基于社会心理学中的归因理论，构建JUBAKU-v2数据集，通过固定结论来评估推理过程中对内群体和外群体行为的归因偏见。数据集包含216个反映日本文化特定偏见的示例。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，JUBAKU-v2比现有基准能更敏感地检测不同模型之间的性能差异，有效识别推理过程中的群体归因偏见。
AI.conclusion: JUBAKU-v2数据集为评估日本文化背景下的大语言模型社会偏见提供了更合适的工具，特别关注推理过程中的归因偏见，弥补了现有基准的不足。

title: HarassGuard: Detecting Harassment Behaviors in Social Virtual Reality with Vision-Language Models
comment: To appear in the 2026 TVCG Special Issue on the 2026 IEEE Conference on Virtual Reality and 3D User Interfaces (VR)
summary: Social Virtual Reality (VR) platforms provide immersive social experiences but also expose users to serious risks of online harassment. Existing safety measures are largely reactive, while proactive solutions that detect harassment behavior during an incident often depend on sensitive biometric data, raising privacy concerns. In this paper, we present HarassGuard, a vision-language model (VLM) based system that detects physical harassment in social VR using only visual input. We construct an IRB-approved harassment vision dataset, apply prompt engineering, and fine-tune VLMs to detect harassment behavior by considering contextual information in social VR. Experimental results demonstrate that HarassGuard achieves competitive performance compared to state-of-the-art baselines (i.e., LSTM/CNN, Transformer), reaching an accuracy of up to 88.09% in binary classification and 68.85% in multi-class classification. Notably, HarassGuard matches these baselines while using significantly fewer fine-tuning samples (200 vs. 1,115), offering unique advantages in contextual reasoning and privacy-preserving detection.

AI.tldr: HarassGuard是一个基于视觉语言模型的系统，仅使用视觉输入检测社交VR中的物理骚扰行为，在保护隐私的同时实现主动安全防护。
AI.motivation: 社交VR平台存在严重的在线骚扰风险，现有安全措施多为被动反应，而主动检测方案通常依赖敏感生物识别数据，引发隐私担忧。
AI.method: 构建IRB批准的骚扰视觉数据集，应用提示工程，并微调视觉语言模型来检测社交VR中的骚扰行为，同时考虑上下文信息。
AI.result: HarassGuard在二分类任务中达到88.09%的准确率，在多分类任务中达到68.85%的准确率，性能与最先进的基准模型（LSTM/CNN、Transformer）相当，但使用的微调样本更少（200 vs 1,115）。
AI.conclusion: HarassGuard在上下文推理和隐私保护检测方面具有独特优势，为社交VR平台提供了一种有效的主动安全解决方案。

title: More Human, More Efficient: Aligning Annotations with Quantized SLMs
summary: As Large Language Model (LLM) capabilities advance, the demand for high-quality annotation of exponentially increasing text corpora has outpaced human capacity, leading to the widespread adoption of LLMs in automatic evaluation and annotation. However, proprietary LLMs often exhibit systematic biases that diverge from human expert consensus, lacks reproducibility, and raises data privacy concerns. Our work examines the viability of finetuning a quantized Small Language Model of 1.7B parameter size on limited human-annotated data to serve as a highly aligned, deterministic evaluator and annotator. By implementing a custom, multi-dimensional rubric framework and simple augmentation and regularization techniques, the proposed approach achieves higher inter-annotator agreement (0.23 points increase in Krippendorff's $α$) than the best performing state-of-the-art proprietary LLM. We also demonstrate the generalizability of the proposed training pipeline on a separate emotion classification task. The results show that task-specific alignment and efficient 4-bit quantized fine-tuning provide superior open-source alternative to using proprietary models for evaluation and annotation. Our finetuning approach is publicly available at https://github.com/jylee-k/slm-judge.

AI.tldr: 使用1.7B参数的量化小型语言模型，通过有限人工标注数据微调，构建比专有LLM更优的自动评估和标注工具
AI.motivation: 随着LLM能力提升，文本语料库标注需求远超人工能力，专有LLM存在系统性偏差、缺乏可复现性和数据隐私问题，需要开源替代方案
AI.method: 采用1.7B参数的小型语言模型，进行4位量化微调，使用自定义多维评分框架，结合简单的数据增强和正则化技术
AI.result: 比最佳专有LLM获得更高的标注者间一致性（Krippendorff's α提高0.23分），在情感分类任务上展示泛化能力
AI.conclusion: 任务特定对齐和高效4位量化微调为评估和标注提供了优于专有模型的开源替代方案

title: TRIMS: Trajectory-Ranked Instruction Masked Supervision for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer a promising path toward low-latency generation through parallel decoding, but their practical efficiency depends heavily on the decoding trajectory. In practice, this advantage often fails to fully materialize because standard training does not provide explicit supervision over token reveal order, creating a train-inference mismatch that leads to suboptimal decoding behavior. We propose Trajectory-Ranked Instruction Masked Supervision (TRIMS), a simple trajectory-guided supervised fine-tuning framework that injects trajectory supervision into standard Masked Diffusion Language Model (MDLM) training with minimal overhead. Instead of relying on costly DLM-based distillation, TRIMS uses lightweight signals from an autoregressive teacher to guide a trajectory-aware masking strategy, encouraging the model to learn more effective decoding orders. Experiments on LLaDA and Dream across math and coding benchmarks show that TRIMS significantly improves the accuracy-parallelism trade-off over both standard MDLM training and train-free acceleration baselines, while achieving competitive performance with prior distillation-based approaches at substantially lower training cost. Further analysis shows that TRIMS leads to better decoding trajectories, validating the effectiveness of trajectory-guided supervision for DLMs.

AI.tldr: TRIMS提出了一种轨迹引导的监督微调框架，通过自回归教师的轻量信号指导掩码策略，改善扩散语言模型的解码轨迹，在数学和编码基准上显著提升了准确性-并行性权衡。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型通过并行解码提供了低延迟生成的潜力，但标准训练缺乏对令牌揭示顺序的显式监督，导致训练-推理不匹配和次优解码行为，限制了实际效率优势的充分发挥。
AI.method: 提出TRIMS（轨迹排序指令掩码监督）框架，将轨迹监督注入标准掩码扩散语言模型训练。使用自回归教师的轻量信号指导轨迹感知掩码策略，而不是依赖昂贵的DLM蒸馏，鼓励模型学习更有效的解码顺序。
AI.result: 在LLaDA和Dream模型上的数学和编码基准测试表明，TRIMS相比标准MDLM训练和免训练加速基线，显著改善了准确性-并行性权衡，同时以更低的训练成本实现了与先前蒸馏方法竞争的性能。分析显示TRIMS产生了更好的解码轨迹。
AI.conclusion: TRIMS验证了轨迹引导监督对扩散语言模型的有效性，通过简单的轨迹感知掩码策略和轻量监督信号，显著提升了DLM的解码效率，为低延迟并行生成提供了实用解决方案。

title: TALENT: Target-aware Efficient Tuning for Referring Image Segmentation
summary: Referring image segmentation aims to segment specific targets based on a natural text expression. Recently, parameter-efficient tuning (PET) has emerged as a promising paradigm. However, existing PET-based methods often suffer from the fact that visual features can't emphasize the text-referred target instance but activate co-category yet unrelated objects. We analyze and quantify this problem, terming it the `non-target activation' (NTA) issue. To address this, we propose a novel framework, TALENT, which utilizes target-aware efficient tuning for PET-based RIS. Specifically, we first propose a Rectified Cost Aggregator (RCA) to efficiently aggregate text-referred features. Then, to calibrate `NTA' into accurate target activation, we adopt a Target-aware Learning Mechanism (TLM), including contextual pairwise consistency learning and target-centric contrastive learning. The former uses the sentence-level text feature to achieve a holistic understanding of the referent and constructs a text-referred affinity map to optimize the semantic association of visual features. The latter further enhances target localization to discover the distinct instance while suppressing associations with other unrelated ones. The two objectives work in concert and address `NTA' effectively. Extensive evaluations show that TALENT outperforms existing methods across various metrics (e.g., 2.5\% mIoU gains on G-Ref val set). Our codes will be released at: https://github.com/Kimsure/TALENT.

AI.tldr: TALENT框架通过目标感知高效调优解决参考图像分割中的非目标激活问题，使用修正成本聚合器和目标感知学习机制，在多个指标上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于参数高效调优的参考图像分割方法存在视觉特征无法强调文本所指目标实例，反而激活同类但无关对象的非目标激活问题。
AI.method: 提出TALENT框架：1）修正成本聚合器高效聚合文本参考特征；2）目标感知学习机制包括上下文配对一致性学习和目标中心对比学习，前者使用句子级文本特征构建文本参考亲和图，后者增强目标定位同时抑制无关关联。
AI.result: 在G-Ref验证集上获得2.5% mIoU提升，在多个指标上优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: TALENT通过目标感知高效调优有效解决了参考图像分割中的非目标激活问题，两个学习目标协同工作，显著提升了分割性能。

title: Common TF-IDF variants arise as key components in the test statistic of a penalized likelihood-ratio test for word burstiness
comment: 27 pages, 3 tables, 7 figures, accepted in Discover Computing 2026
summary: TF-IDF is a classical formula that is widely used for identifying important terms within documents. We show that TF-IDF-like scores arise naturally from the test statistic of a penalized likelihood-ratio test setup capturing word burstiness (also known as word over-dispersion). In our framework, the alternative hypothesis captures word burstiness by modeling a collection of documents according to a family of beta-binomial distributions with a gamma penalty term on the precision parameter. In contrast, the null hypothesis assumes that words are binomially distributed in collection documents, a modeling approach that fails to account for word burstiness. We find that a term-weighting scheme given rise to by this test statistic performs comparably to TF-IDF on document classification tasks. This paper provides insights into TF-IDF from a statistical perspective and underscores the potential of hypothesis testing frameworks for advancing term-weighting scheme development.

AI.tldr: 该论文从统计假设检验的角度重新解释TF-IDF，通过惩罚似然比检验框架捕捉词的突发性，证明TF-IDF类评分自然产生于该统计框架。
AI.motivation: TF-IDF作为经典术语权重公式被广泛应用，但缺乏严格的统计理论基础。论文旨在从统计假设检验的角度为TF-IDF提供理论解释，并探索基于假设检验框架开发术语权重方案的潜力。
AI.method: 建立惩罚似然比检验框架：备择假设使用带伽马惩罚项精度参数的beta-二项分布族建模文档集合，捕捉词的突发性（过度分散）；零假设假设词在文档集合中服从二项分布，无法捕捉突发性。从该检验统计量推导出术语权重方案。
AI.result: 从该检验统计量推导出的术语权重方案在文档分类任务上表现与TF-IDF相当。证明TF-IDF类评分自然产生于捕捉词突发性的统计检验框架。
AI.conclusion: 论文从统计角度为TF-IDF提供了新的理论解释，强调了假设检验框架在推进术语权重方案开发方面的潜力，为理解TF-IDF的统计基础提供了新视角。

title: DirectFisheye-GS: Enabling Native Fisheye Input in Gaussian Splatting with Cross-View Joint Optimization
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has enabled efficient 3D scene reconstruction from everyday images with real-time, high-fidelity rendering, greatly advancing VR/AR applications. Fisheye cameras, with their wider field of view (FOV), promise high-quality reconstructions from fewer inputs and have recently attracted much attention. However, since 3DGS relies on rasterization, most subsequent works involving fisheye camera inputs first undistort images before training, which introduces two problems: 1) Black borders at image edges cause information loss and negate the fisheye's large FOV advantage; 2) Undistortion's stretch-and-interpolate resampling spreads each pixel's value over a larger area, diluting detail density -- causes 3DGS overfitting these low-frequency zones, producing blur and floating artifacts. In this work, we integrate fisheye camera model into the original 3DGS framework, enabling native fisheye image input for training without preprocessing. Despite correct modeling, we observed that the reconstructed scenes still exhibit floaters at image edges: Distortion increases toward the periphery, and 3DGS's original per-iteration random-selecting-view optimization ignores the cross-view correlations of a Gaussian, leading to extreme shapes (e.g., oversized or elongated) that degrade reconstruction quality. To address this, we introduce a feature-overlap-driven cross-view joint optimization strategy that establishes consistent geometric and photometric constraints across views-a technique equally applicable to existing pinhole-camera-based pipelines. Our DirectFisheye-GS matches or surpasses state-of-the-art performance on public datasets.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出DirectFisheye-GS方法，将鱼眼相机模型直接集成到3D高斯泼溅框架中，避免预处理带来的信息损失，并通过跨视图联合优化策略解决边缘伪影问题。
AI.motivation: 鱼眼相机具有更宽的视野，可以用更少的输入实现高质量3D重建，但现有3DGS方法需要先对鱼眼图像进行去畸变预处理，这会导致两个问题：1) 图像边缘出现黑边，损失信息并抵消鱼眼大视野优势；2) 去畸变的重采样会稀释细节密度，导致3DGS在低频区域过拟合，产生模糊和漂浮伪影。
AI.method: 1) 将鱼眼相机模型直接集成到原始3DGS框架中，支持原生鱼眼图像输入训练；2) 提出特征重叠驱动的跨视图联合优化策略，建立跨视图一致的几何和光度约束，解决边缘畸变导致的极端高斯形状问题。
AI.result: DirectFisheye-GS在公共数据集上达到或超越了最先进方法的性能，有效解决了鱼眼图像训练中的边缘伪影问题。
AI.conclusion: 通过直接集成鱼眼相机模型和跨视图联合优化策略，实现了无需预处理的鱼眼图像3D高斯泼溅重建，该方法同样适用于现有的针孔相机管道，显著提升了鱼眼相机在3D重建中的应用效果。

title: AfrIFact: Cultural Information Retrieval, Evidence Extraction and Fact Checking for African Languages
summary: Assessing the veracity of a claim made online is a complex and important task with real-world implications. When these claims are directed at communities with limited access to information and the content concerns issues such as healthcare and culture, the consequences intensify, especially in low-resource languages. In this work, we introduce AfrIFact, a dataset that covers the necessary steps for automatic fact-checking (i.e., information retrieval, evidence extraction, and fact checking), in ten African languages and English. Our evaluation results show that even the best embedding models lack cross-lingual retrieval capabilities, and that cultural and news documents are easier to retrieve than healthcare-domain documents, both in large corpora and in single documents. We show that LLMs lack robust multilingual fact-verification capabilities in African languages, while few-shot prompting improves performance by up to 43% in AfriqueQwen-14B, and task-specific fine-tuning further improves fact-checking accuracy by up to 26%. These findings, along with our release of the AfrIFact dataset, encourage work on low-resource information retrieval, evidence retrieval, and fact checking.

AI.tldr: AfrIFact数据集包含10种非洲语言和英语，用于自动事实核查任务（信息检索、证据提取、事实核查），评估显示现有模型在跨语言检索和非洲语言事实核查方面存在不足，但少样本提示和任务特定微调能显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 在线声明的真实性核查在信息获取有限的社区中尤为重要，特别是涉及医疗保健和文化等议题时。非洲语言作为低资源语言，缺乏相关数据集和评估基准，限制了自动事实核查系统的发展。
AI.method: 构建AfrIFact数据集，涵盖10种非洲语言和英语，支持自动事实核查的三个关键步骤。评估现有嵌入模型的跨语言检索能力，测试LLMs在非洲语言中的事实核查性能，并探索少样本提示和任务特定微调的效果。
AI.result: 最佳嵌入模型缺乏跨语言检索能力；文化和新闻文档比医疗领域文档更容易检索；LLMs在非洲语言中缺乏稳健的多语言事实核查能力；少样本提示使AfriqueQwen-14B性能提升达43%；任务特定微调进一步提升事实核查准确率26%。
AI.conclusion: AfrIFact数据集填补了低资源语言事实核查的空白，揭示了现有模型在跨语言检索和非洲语言处理上的局限性，同时展示了少样本提示和微调的有效性，为低资源信息检索、证据检索和事实核查研究提供了重要资源。

title: CL-VISTA: Benchmarking Continual Learning in Video Large Language Models
summary: Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) require continual learning to adapt to non-stationary real-world data. However, existing benchmarks fall short of evaluating modern foundation models: many still rely on models without large-scale pre-training, and prevailing benchmarks typically partition a single dataset into sub-tasks, resulting in high task redundancy and negligible forgetting on pre-trained Video-LLMs. To address these limitations, we propose CL-VISTA, a benchmark tailored for continual video understanding of Video-LLMs. By curating 8 diverse tasks spanning perception, understanding, and reasoning, CL-VISTA induces substantial distribution shifts that effectively expose catastrophic forgetting. To systematically assess CL methods, we establish a comprehensive evaluation framework comprising 6 distinct protocols across 3 critical dimensions: performance, computational efficiency, and memory footprint. Notably, the performance dimension incorporates a general video understanding assessment to assess whether CL methods genuinely enhance foundational intelligence or merely induce task-specific overfitting. Extensive benchmarking of 10 mainstream CL methods reveals a fundamental trade-off: no single approach achieves universal superiority across all dimensions. Methods that successfully mitigate catastrophic forgetting tend to compromise generalization or incur prohibitive computational and memory overheads. We hope CL-VISTA provides critical insights for advancing continual learning in multimodal foundation models.

AI.tldr: CL-VISTA是一个专为视频大语言模型设计的持续学习基准测试，包含8个多样化任务，通过6种评估协议在性能、计算效率和内存占用三个维度上全面评估持续学习方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试无法有效评估现代基础模型：许多仍依赖未经大规模预训练的模型，且通常将单个数据集划分为子任务，导致任务冗余度高，对预训练视频大语言模型的遗忘效应不显著。
AI.method: 提出CL-VISTA基准测试，精心策划8个涵盖感知、理解和推理的多样化任务，创建显著分布偏移以有效暴露灾难性遗忘。建立包含6种不同协议的综合评估框架，覆盖性能、计算效率和内存占用三个关键维度。
AI.result: 对10种主流持续学习方法进行广泛基准测试，揭示了一个基本权衡：没有任何单一方法在所有维度上都达到普遍优越性。成功缓解灾难性遗忘的方法往往以牺牲泛化能力或增加计算和内存开销为代价。
AI.conclusion: CL-VISTA为推进多模态基础模型的持续学习提供了关键见解，希望该基准测试能帮助研究人员更好地评估和开发视频大语言模型的持续学习方法。

title: To Memorize or to Retrieve: Scaling Laws for RAG-Considerate Pretraining
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves language model (LM) performance by providing relevant context at test time for knowledge-intensive situations. However, the relationship between parametric knowledge acquired during pretraining and non-parametric knowledge accessed via retrieval remains poorly understood, especially under fixed data budgets. In this work, we systematically study the trade-off between pretraining corpus size and retrieval store size across a wide range of model and data scales. We train OLMo-2-based LMs ranging from 30M to 3B parameters on up to 100B tokens of DCLM data, while varying both pretraining data scale (1-150x the number of parameters) and retrieval store size (1-20x), and evaluate performance across a diverse suite of benchmarks spanning reasoning, scientific QA, and open-domain QA. We find that retrieval consistently improves performance over parametric-only baselines across model scales and introduce a three-dimensional scaling framework that models performance as a function of model size, pretraining tokens, and retrieval corpus size. This scaling manifold enables us to estimate optimal allocations of a fixed data budget between pretraining and retrieval, revealing that the marginal utility of retrieval depends strongly on model scale, task type, and the degree of pretraining saturation. Our results provide a quantitative foundation for understanding when and how retrieval should complement pretraining, offering practical guidance for allocating data resources in the design of scalable language modeling systems.

AI.tldr: 研究系统分析了在固定数据预算下，预训练与检索增强生成(RAG)之间的权衡关系，提出了三维扩展框架来优化数据分配策略。
AI.motivation: 尽管检索增强生成(RAG)能提升语言模型在知识密集型任务中的表现，但预训练获得的参数化知识与通过检索获取的非参数化知识之间的关系仍不明确，特别是在固定数据预算下如何最优分配资源的问题尚未得到系统研究。
AI.method: 使用OLMo-2架构训练参数规模从3000万到30亿的语言模型，在DCLM数据上训练最多1000亿个token，同时变化预训练数据规模（参数数量的1-150倍）和检索库大小（1-20倍），并在推理、科学问答和开放域问答等多样化基准上进行评估。
AI.result: 检索在所有模型规模上都持续优于纯参数化基线；提出了三维扩展框架，将性能建模为模型大小、预训练token数量和检索库大小的函数；发现检索的边际效用强烈依赖于模型规模、任务类型和预训练饱和程度。
AI.conclusion: 研究为理解何时以及如何用检索补充预训练提供了量化基础，为可扩展语言建模系统的数据资源分配提供了实用指导，特别是在固定数据预算下优化预训练与检索之间的权衡。

title: MoonAnything: A Vision Benchmark with Large-Scale Lunar Supervised Data
summary: Accurate perception of lunar surfaces is critical for modern lunar exploration missions. However, developing robust learning-based perception systems is hindered by the lack of datasets that provide both geometric and photometric supervision. Existing lunar datasets typically lack either geometric ground truth, photometric realism, illumination diversity, or large-scale coverage. In this paper, we introduce MoonAnything, a unified benchmark built on real lunar topography with physically-based rendering, providing the first comprehensive geometric and photometric supervision under diverse illumination with large scale. The benchmark comprises two complementary sub-datasets : i) LunarGeo provides stereo images with corresponding dense depth maps and camera calibration enabling 3D reconstruction and pose estimation; ii) LunarPhoto provides photorealistic images using a spatially-varying BRDF model, along with multi-illumination renderings under real solar configurations, enabling reflectance estimation and illumination-robust perception. Together, these datasets offer over 130K samples with comprehensive supervision. Beyond lunar applications, MoonAnything offers a unique setting and challenging testbed for algorithms under low-textured, high-contrast conditions and applies to other airless celestial bodies and could generalize beyond. We establish baselines using state-of-the-art methods and release the complete dataset along with generation tools to support community extension: https://github.com/clementinegrethen/MoonAnything.

AI.tldr: MoonAnything是一个基于真实月球地形构建的统一基准数据集，提供几何和光度学监督，包含LunarGeo（立体图像和深度图）和LunarPhoto（光度真实图像和多光照渲染）两个子数据集，共13万+样本。
AI.motivation: 现有的月球数据集通常缺乏几何地面真值、光度真实感、光照多样性或大规模覆盖，这阻碍了基于学习的感知系统的发展。需要提供全面的几何和光度学监督来支持月球探索任务。
AI.method: 基于真实月球地形，使用基于物理的渲染技术构建统一基准。包含两个互补子数据集：LunarGeo提供立体图像、密集深度图和相机标定；LunarPhoto使用空间变化的BRDF模型生成光度真实图像，并在真实太阳配置下进行多光照渲染。
AI.result: 创建了包含超过13万个样本的综合数据集，提供全面的几何和光度学监督。建立了基于最先进方法的基线，并发布了完整数据集和生成工具。
AI.conclusion: MoonAnything为月球感知提供了首个全面的几何和光度学监督基准，不仅适用于月球应用，还为低纹理、高对比度条件下的算法提供了独特测试环境，可推广到其他无大气天体。

title: LangMARL: Natural Language Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents struggle to autonomously evolve coordination strategies in dynamic environments, largely because coarse global outcomes obscure the causal signals needed for local policy refinement. We identify this bottleneck as a multi-agent credit assignment problem, which has long been studied in classical multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) but remains underaddressed in LLM-based systems. Building on this observation, we propose LangMARL, a framework that brings credit assignment and policy gradient evolution from cooperative MARL into the language space. LangMARL introduces agent-level language credit assignment, pioneers gradient evolution in language space for policy improvement, and summarizes task-relevant causal relations from replayed trajectories to provide dense feedback and improve convergence under sparse rewards. Extensive experiments across diverse cooperative multi-agent tasks demonstrate improved sample efficiency, interpretability, and strong generalization.

AI.tldr: LangMARL框架将多智能体强化学习中的信用分配机制引入语言模型智能体，解决LLM智能体在动态环境中协调策略演化困难的问题。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型智能体在动态环境中难以自主演化协调策略，因为粗粒度的全局结果掩盖了局部策略优化所需的因果信号。这本质上是一个多智能体信用分配问题，在传统多智能体强化学习中已有研究，但在基于LLM的系统中尚未得到充分解决。
AI.method: LangMARL框架将合作式多智能体强化学习中的信用分配和策略梯度演化引入语言空间。具体包括：1）智能体级别的语言信用分配；2）在语言空间中进行梯度演化以实现策略改进；3）从重放轨迹中总结任务相关的因果关系，提供密集反馈并在稀疏奖励下改善收敛性。
AI.result: 在多种合作式多智能体任务上的广泛实验表明，LangMARL提高了样本效率、可解释性，并展现出强大的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: LangMARL成功地将多智能体强化学习中的信用分配机制引入语言模型智能体，解决了LLM智能体在动态环境中协调策略演化的瓶颈问题，为语言智能体的协作能力提升提供了有效框架。

title: Stochastic Attention: Connectome-Inspired Randomized Routing for Expressive Linear-Time Attention
summary: The whole-brain connectome of a fruit fly comprises over 130K neurons connected with a probability of merely 0.02%, yet achieves an average shortest path of only 4.4 hops. Despite being highly structured at the circuit level, the network's long-range connections are broadly distributed across brain regions, functioning as stochastic shortcuts that enable efficient global communication. Inspired by this observation, we propose Stochastic Attention (SA), a drop-in enhancement for sliding-window attention (SWA) that applies a random permutation to the token sequence before windowed attention and restores the original order afterward. This transforms the fixed local window into a stochastic global one within the same $O(nw)$ per-layer budget. Through depth, independently sampled permutations yield exponentially growing receptive fields, achieving full sequence coverage in $O(\log_w n)$ layers versus $O(n/w)$ for SWA. We validate SA in two settings: pre-training language models from scratch, where a gated SA + SWA combination achieves the best average zero-shot accuracy, and training-free inference on Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-30B-A3B, where SA consistently outperforms SWA and matches or exceeds Mixture of Block Attention at comparable compute budgets. These results suggest that connectome-inspired stochastic routing is a practical primitive for improving the expressivity of efficient attention, complementary to existing linear and sparse approaches.

AI.tldr: 受果蝇全脑连接组启发，提出随机注意力机制，通过随机排列token序列来扩展滑动窗口注意力的感受野，在相同计算复杂度下实现全局通信
AI.motivation: 果蝇大脑连接组虽然连接概率极低（仅0.02%），但平均最短路径只有4.4跳，其长距离连接作为随机捷径实现高效全局通信。受此启发，研究如何将这种随机路由机制应用于高效注意力模型
AI.method: 提出随机注意力（SA），在滑动窗口注意力前对token序列进行随机排列，然后恢复原始顺序。通过深度堆叠独立采样的排列，感受野呈指数增长，在O(log_w n)层内实现全序列覆盖，而滑动窗口注意力需要O(n/w)层
AI.result: 在语言模型预训练中，门控SA+SWA组合获得最佳平均零样本准确率；在Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-30B-A3B的无训练推理中，SA始终优于SWA，并在相同计算预算下匹配或超过混合块注意力
AI.conclusion: 连接组启发的随机路由是提升高效注意力表达能力的实用原语，与现有的线性和稀疏方法互补，为高效注意力机制提供了新的设计思路

title: TTA-Vid: Generalized Test-Time Adaptation for Video Reasoning
summary: Recent video reasoning models have shown strong results on temporal and multimodal understanding, yet they depend on large-scale supervised data and multi-stage training pipelines, making them costly to train and difficult to adapt to new domains. In this work, we leverage the paradigm of Test-Time Reinforcement Learning on video-language data to allow for adapting a pretrained model to incoming video samples at test-time without explicit labels. The proposed test-time adaptation for video approach (TTA-Vid) combines two components that work simultaneously: (1) a test-time adaptation that performs step-by-step reasoning at inference time on multiple frame subsets. We then use a batch-aware frequency-based reward computed across different frame subsets as pseudo ground truth to update the model. It shows that the resulting model trained on a single batch or even a single sample from a dataset, is able to generalize at test-time to the whole dataset and even across datasets. Because the adaptation occurs entirely at test time, our method requires no ground-truth annotations or dedicated training splits. Additionally, we propose a multi-armed bandit strategy for adaptive frame selection that learns to prioritize informative frames, guided by the same reward formulation. Our evaluation shows that TTA-Vid yields consistent improvements across various video reasoning tasks and is able to outperform current state-of-the-art methods trained on large-scale data. This highlights the potential of test-time reinforcement learning for temporal multimodal understanding.

AI.tldr: TTA-Vid：一种基于测试时强化学习的视频推理方法，无需标注数据即可在测试时自适应调整预训练模型，通过多帧子集推理和批量感知频率奖励实现跨数据集泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有视频推理模型依赖大规模监督数据和多阶段训练流程，成本高昂且难以适应新领域。需要一种无需标注数据、能在测试时自适应调整的方法。
AI.method: 提出测试时视频自适应方法(TTA-Vid)：1) 在推理时对多个帧子集进行逐步推理；2) 使用跨不同帧子集计算的批量感知频率奖励作为伪真值更新模型；3) 提出自适应帧选择的多臂老虎机策略，优先选择信息丰富的帧。
AI.result: TTA-Vid在单个批次甚至单个样本上训练后，能够在测试时泛化到整个数据集甚至跨数据集。在各种视频推理任务上取得一致改进，性能优于当前基于大规模数据训练的SOTA方法。
AI.conclusion: TTA-Vid展示了测试时强化学习在时序多模态理解中的潜力，无需真实标注或专用训练分割即可实现有效自适应，为视频推理提供了一种更灵活、成本更低的解决方案。

title: From Baselines to Preferences: A Comparative Study of LoRA/QLoRA and Preference Optimization for Mental Health Text Classification
summary: Mental health text classification has rapidly adopted modern adaptation methods, yet practical guidance on which optimization strategy to use, when, and why remains limited. This paper presents a systematic comparative study of optimization pathways for a joint mental-health classification task, moving from strong vanilla baselines to progressively more specialized techniques. We first establish classical and encoder references, then examine parameter-efficient supervised fine-tuning with LoRA/QLoRA under multiple objective and optimization settings, and finally evaluate preference-based optimization with DPO, ORPO, and KTO, including class-rebalanced training. Rather than emphasizing a single headline score, we focus on methodological insight: how performance changes with objective formulation, adapter choice, optimizer behavior, context windowing, and class-balance intervention. The results show that optimization effects are highly method-dependent: some approaches deliver stable, transferable gains, while others are sensitive to configuration and data balance. Preference optimization, in particular, exhibits large variation across objectives, indicating that method selection is more consequential than simply adding a preference-training stage. The central contribution is a clear optimization narrative for mental health NLP: start from transparent baselines, apply controlled tuning, and use preference optimization selectively where its gains are demonstrable. This provides a reproducible and practically grounded framework for choosing effective training strategies beyond architecture choice alone.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统比较了心理健康文本分类的各种优化策略，从基础基线到参数高效微调再到基于偏好的优化，提供了实用的方法选择框架。
AI.motivation: 心理健康文本分类领域虽然快速采用了现代适应方法，但关于选择何种优化策略、何时使用以及为何有效的实用指导仍然有限。需要系统比较不同优化路径，为实践提供清晰指导。
AI.method: 研究采用系统比较方法：1) 建立经典和编码器基线；2) 使用LoRA/QLoRA进行参数高效的监督微调，测试多种目标和优化设置；3) 评估基于偏好的优化方法（DPO、ORPO、KTO），包括类别重平衡训练。重点关注方法学洞察而非单一分数。
AI.result: 优化效果高度依赖于方法：某些方法提供稳定、可迁移的增益，而其他方法对配置和数据平衡敏感。偏好优化在不同目标间表现出巨大差异，表明方法选择比简单添加偏好训练阶段更重要。
AI.conclusion: 为心理健康NLP提供了清晰的优化叙事：从透明基线开始，应用受控微调，仅在可证明增益的情况下选择性使用偏好优化。这为超越架构选择的有效训练策略提供了可重复且实用的框架。

title: A Benchmark of State-Space Models vs. Transformers and BiLSTM-based Models for Historical Newspaper OCR
summary:
End-to-end OCR for historical newspapers remains challenging, as models must handle long text sequences, degraded print quality, and complex layouts. While Transformer-based recognizers dominate current research, their quadratic complexity limits efficient paragraph-level transcription and large-scale deployment. We investigate linear-time State-Space Models (SSMs), specifically Mamba, as a scalable alternative to Transformer-based sequence modeling for OCR.
  We present to our knowledge, the first OCR architecture based on SSMs, combining a CNN visual encoder with bi-directional and autoregressive Mamba sequence modeling, and conduct a large-scale benchmark comparing SSMs with Transformer- and BiLSTM-based recognizers. Multiple decoding strategies (CTC, autoregressive, and non-autoregressive) are evaluated under identical training conditions alongside strong neural baselines (VAN, DAN, DANIEL) and widely used off-the-shelf OCR engines (PERO-OCR, Tesseract OCR, TrOCR, Gemini).
  Experiments on historical newspapers from the Bibliothèque nationale du Luxembourg, with newly released >99% verified gold-standard annotations, and cross-dataset tests on Fraktur and Antiqua lines, show that all neural models achieve low error rates (~2% CER), making computational efficiency the main differentiator. Mamba-based models maintain competitive accuracy while halving inference time and exhibiting superior memory scaling (1.26x vs 2.30x growth at 1000 chars), reaching 6.07% CER at the severely degraded paragraph level compared to 5.24% for DAN, while remaining 2.05x faster.
  We release code, trained models, and standardized evaluation protocols to enable reproducible research and guide practitioners in large-scale cultural heritage OCR.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将状态空间模型（Mamba）应用于历史报纸OCR，相比Transformer模型在保持竞争力的准确率下，推理时间减半且内存扩展更优。
AI.motivation: 历史报纸的端到端OCR面临长文本序列、印刷质量退化和复杂版式等挑战。虽然Transformer模型主导当前研究，但其二次复杂度限制了段落级转录和大规模部署的效率，需要探索更高效的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出首个基于状态空间模型（SSMs/Mamba）的OCR架构，结合CNN视觉编码器与双向和自回归Mamba序列建模。在相同训练条件下评估多种解码策略（CTC、自回归、非自回归），并与强基线模型（VAN、DAN、DANIEL）和现成OCR引擎进行比较。
AI.result: 所有神经模型在历史报纸数据集上都达到低错误率（~2% CER），计算效率成为主要区分因素。Mamba模型在保持竞争力准确率的同时，推理时间减半，内存扩展更优（1000字符时1.26倍 vs 2.30倍增长），在严重退化的段落级达到6.07% CER，比DAN的5.24%稍高但快2.05倍。
AI.conclusion: Mamba作为Transformer的线性时间替代方案，在历史报纸OCR中展现出良好的计算效率与准确性平衡，为大规模文化遗产OCR部署提供了有前景的解决方案。

title: From Early Encoding to Late Suppression: Interpreting LLMs on Character Counting Tasks
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) exhibit failures on elementary symbolic tasks such as character counting in a word, despite excelling on complex benchmarks. Although this limitation has been noted, the internal reasons remain unclear. We use character counting (e.g., "How many p's are in apple?") as a minimal, controlled probe that isolates token-level reasoning from higher-level confounds. Using this setting, we uncover a consistent phenomenon across modern architectures, including LLaMA, Qwen, and Gemma: models often compute the correct answer internally yet fail to express it at the output layer.
  Through mechanistic analysis combining probing classifiers, activation patching, logit lens analysis, and attention head tracing, we show that character-level information is encoded in early and mid-layer representations. However, this information is attenuated by a small set of components in later layers, especially the penultimate and final layer MLP. We identify these components as negative circuits: subnetworks that downweight correct signals in favor of higher-probability but incorrect outputs.
  Our results lead to two contributions. First, we show that symbolic reasoning failures in LLMs are not due to missing representations or insufficient scale, but arise from structured interference within the model's computation graph. This explains why such errors persist and can worsen under scaling and instruction tuning. Second, we provide evidence that LLM forward passes implement a form of competitive decoding, in which correct and incorrect hypotheses coexist and are dynamically reweighted, with final outputs determined by suppression as much as by amplification.
  These findings carry implications for interpretability and robustness: simple symbolic reasoning exposes weaknesses in modern LLMs, underscoring need for design strategies that ensure information is encoded and reliably used.

AI.tldr: LLMs在字符计数等基础符号任务上失败，不是因为缺乏内部表示，而是因为后期层中的负电路组件抑制了正确信号，导致模型内部计算正确但输出错误。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLMs在复杂基准测试中表现出色，但在字符计数等基础符号任务上却存在失败。这种限制已被注意到，但其内部原因尚不清楚。研究者希望通过字符计数这一最小化、受控的探针来隔离词元级推理与高层混淆因素，揭示LLMs内部推理失败的根本原因。
AI.method: 使用字符计数任务作为探针，对LLaMA、Qwen、Gemma等现代架构进行机制分析。结合探针分类器、激活修补、logit透镜分析和注意力头追踪等技术，研究字符级信息在模型中的编码和处理过程，特别关注后期层中抑制正确信号的组件。
AI.result: 研究发现：1）字符级信息在早期和中间层表示中被编码；2）这些信息在后期层（特别是倒数第二层和最后一层的MLP）中被一小部分组件衰减；3）这些组件是负电路，会降低正确信号的权重，偏向更高概率但不正确的输出；4）LLMs的前向传递实现了竞争性解码，正确和错误假设共存并动态重新加权。
AI.conclusion: LLMs的符号推理失败不是由于缺少表示或规模不足，而是源于模型计算图中的结构化干扰。这解释了为什么这些错误会持续存在，并在扩展和指令调整下可能恶化。研究强调了现代LLMs在简单符号推理方面的弱点，需要设计策略确保信息被可靠编码和使用。

title: IWP: Token Pruning as Implicit Weight Pruning in Large Vision Language Models
summary: Large Vision Language Models show impressive performance across image and video understanding tasks, yet their computational cost grows rapidly with the number of visual tokens. Existing token pruning methods mitigate this issue through empirical approaches while overlooking the internal mechanism of attention. In this paper, we propose a novel training free token pruning framework grounded in the dual form perspective of attention. We reformulate attention as an implicit linear layer whose weight matrix is the sum of rank 1 outer products, each generated by a single token's key value pair. Token pruning thus reduces to selecting an optimal subset of these rank 1 updates that best approximates the original dual weight matrix. Extending this perspective to standard softmax attention in LVLMs, we derive a novel metric quantifying both a token's information magnitude and information duplication. To efficiently select the subset with the proposed metric, we introduce Progressive Chunked Maximal Marginal Relevance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves a better trade off between performance and efficiency, while providing another perspective on existing pruning approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于注意力对偶形式视角的无训练token剪枝框架，通过渐进分块最大边际相关性选择最优token子集，在LVLMs中实现性能与效率的更好平衡。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型的计算成本随视觉token数量快速增长，现有token剪枝方法多基于经验方法，忽视了注意力的内部机制。
AI.method: 从注意力的对偶形式视角出发，将注意力重新表述为隐式线性层，其权重矩阵是rank 1外积的和。提出量化token信息量和信息重复度的新度量，并引入渐进分块最大边际相关性进行高效子集选择。
AI.result: 该方法在性能和效率之间实现了更好的权衡，并为现有剪枝方法提供了新的理论视角。
AI.conclusion: 基于注意力对偶形式的token剪枝框架为LVLMs的高效推理提供了理论基础，同时为理解现有剪枝方法提供了新的视角。

title: Valency Classification of Mapudungun Verbal Roots. Established by the language's own morphotactics
summary: In the previous work, a lexical (re)categorisation -- or confirmation of the given category -- of roots identified as verbal was undertaken to determine their original category accurately. Building on this, the present paper offers an account of the valency classification of those Mapudungun roots confirmed to be verbal, using the language's own morphotactics; specifically, by examining the permissible and restricted combinations of various suffixes with roots or verbal stems in the Mapuche verb form. As with all work conducted thus far, the results presented here aim to improve the morphological analyser (Dungupeyum) with all verified findings incorporated into the system. From a theoretical perspective, we also hope to contribute to the recognition and understanding of issues related to the valency of Mapuche verb forms.

AI.tldr: 本文基于先前对Mapudungun语动词词根的范畴确认研究，进一步分析这些动词的配价分类，利用语言自身的形态结构来改进形态分析器Dungupeyum。
AI.motivation: 在先前对Mapudungun语动词词根进行范畴确认的基础上，本文旨在分析这些动词的配价分类，以改进形态分析器Dungupeyum，并从理论角度增进对Mapuche动词形式配价问题的理解。
AI.method: 通过研究Mapudungun语中各种后缀与词根或动词词干的允许和限制组合，利用语言自身的形态结构来分析动词的配价分类。
AI.result: 研究结果将改进形态分析器Dungupeyum，所有验证的发现都将整合到系统中，同时为理解Mapuche动词形式的配价问题提供理论贡献。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过分析Mapudungun语动词的配价分类，既改进了形态分析工具，也为理解该语言动词形态的理论问题做出了贡献。

title: PrivHAR-Bench: A Graduated Privacy Benchmark Dataset for Video-Based Action Recognition
summary: Existing research on privacy-preserving Human Activity Recognition (HAR) typically evaluates methods against a binary paradigm: clear video versus a single privacy transformation. This limits cross-method comparability and obscures the nuanced relationship between privacy strength and recognition utility. We introduce \textit{PrivHAR-Bench}, a multi-tier benchmark dataset designed to standardize the evaluation of the \textit{Privacy-Utility Trade-off} in video-based action recognition. PrivHAR-Bench applies a graduated spectrum of visual privacy transformations: from lightweight spatial obfuscation to cryptographic block permutation, to a curated subset of 15 activity classes selected for human articulation diversity. Each of the 1,932 source videos is distributed across 9 parallel tiers of increasing privacy strength, with additional background-removed variants to isolate the contribution of human motion features from contextual scene bias. We provide lossless frame sequences, per-frame bounding boxes, estimated pose keypoints with joint-level confidence scores, standardized group-based train/test splits, and an evaluation toolkit computing recognition accuracy and privacy metrics. Empirical validation using R3D-18 demonstrates a measurable and interpretable degradation curve across tiers, with within-tier accuracy declining from 88.8\% (clear) to 53.5\% (encrypted, background-removed) and cross-domain accuracy collapsing to 4.8\%, establishing PrivHAR-Bench as a controlled benchmark for comparing privacy-preserving HAR methods under standardized conditions. The dataset, generation pipeline, and evaluation code are publicly available.

AI.tldr: PrivHAR-Bench是一个多层级隐私保护人体活动识别基准数据集，通过9个隐私强度递增的视觉变换层级，标准化评估隐私保护与识别性能的权衡关系。
AI.motivation: 现有隐私保护人体活动识别研究通常采用二元评估范式（清晰视频vs单一隐私变换），限制了跨方法可比性，且难以揭示隐私强度与识别性能之间的微妙关系。
AI.method: 创建PrivHAR-Bench数据集，包含1,932个源视频，涵盖15个具有人体关节多样性的人类活动类别。每个视频应用9个隐私强度递增的视觉变换层级（从轻量级空间模糊到加密块置换），并提供背景移除变体以分离人体运动特征与场景背景偏置。
AI.result: 使用R3D-18模型验证显示：层级内识别准确率从88.8%（清晰）下降至53.5%（加密+背景移除），跨域准确率降至4.8%，呈现可测量且可解释的性能退化曲线。
AI.conclusion: PrivHAR-Bench为隐私保护人体活动识别方法提供了标准化评估基准，支持在受控条件下比较不同方法的隐私-效用权衡性能，数据集、生成管道和评估代码已公开。

title: Emotion Entanglement and Bayesian Inference for Multi-Dimensional Emotion Understanding
summary: Understanding emotions in natural language is inherently a multi-dimensional reasoning problem, where multiple affective signals interact through context, interpersonal relations, and situational cues. However, most existing emotion understanding benchmarks rely on short texts and predefined emotion labels, reducing this process to independent label prediction and ignoring the structured dependencies among emotions. To address this limitation, we introduce Emotional Scenarios (EmoScene), a theory-grounded benchmark of 4,731 context-rich scenarios annotated with an 8-dimensional emotion vector derived from Plutchik's basic emotions. We evaluate six instruction-tuned large language models in a zero-shot setting and observe modest performance, with the best model achieving a Macro F1 of 0.501, highlighting the difficulty of context-aware multi-label emotion prediction. Motivated by the observation that emotions rarely occur independently, we further propose an entanglement-aware Bayesian inference framework that incorporates emotion co-occurrence statistics to perform joint posterior inference over the emotion vector. This lightweight post-processing improves structural consistency of predictions and yields notable gains for weaker models (e.g., +0.051 Macro F1 for Qwen2.5-7B). EmoScene therefore provides a challenging benchmark for studying multi-dimensional emotion understanding and the limitations of current language models.

AI.tldr: EmoScene是一个基于情感理论的多维情感理解基准，包含4731个情境丰富的场景，使用Plutchik基本情感的8维向量标注，评估发现当前LLM在零样本设置下表现有限，提出基于贝叶斯推理的纠缠感知框架提升预测一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有情感理解基准大多基于短文本和预定义情感标签，将情感理解简化为独立标签预测，忽略了情感之间的结构化依赖关系，无法捕捉自然语言中多维情感推理的复杂性。
AI.method: 1) 构建EmoScene基准：4731个情境丰富的场景，使用Plutchik基本情感的8维向量标注；2) 在零样本设置下评估6个指令调优大语言模型；3) 提出纠缠感知贝叶斯推理框架，利用情感共现统计进行联合后验推断。
AI.result: 最佳模型在零样本设置下仅达到0.501的Macro F1，显示上下文感知的多标签情感预测具有挑战性。提出的贝叶斯推理框架显著提升了较弱模型的性能（如Qwen2.5-7B提升+0.051 Macro F1），改善了预测的结构一致性。
AI.conclusion: EmoScene为研究多维情感理解和当前语言模型的局限性提供了一个具有挑战性的基准。情感很少独立发生，考虑情感共现关系的后处理方法可以提升模型预测的结构一致性和性能。

title: An Approach to Enriching Surgical Video Datasets for Fine-Grained Spatial-Temporal Understanding of Vision-Language Models
summary: Surgical video understanding is a crucial prerequisite for advancing Computer-Assisted Surgery. While vision-language models (VLMs) have recently been applied to the surgical domain, existing surgical vision-language datasets lack in capturing and evaluating complex, interleaved spatial-temporal dynamics. Creating large scale datasets that accurately represent fine-grained spatial-temporal relationships in surgical videos is challenging due to costly manual annotations or error-prone generation using large language models. To address this gap, we introduce the SurgSTU-Pipeline, a deterministic generation pipeline featuring temporal and spatial continuity filtering to reliably create surgical datasets for fine-grained spatial-temporal multimodal understanding. Applying this pipeline to publicly available surgical datasets, we create the SurgSTU dataset, comprising 7515 video clips densely extended with 150k fine-grained spatial-temporal question-answer samples. Our comprehensive evaluation shows that while state-of-the-art generalist VLMs struggle in zero-shot settings, their spatial-temporal capabilities can be improved through in-context learning. A fine-tuned VLM on the SurgSTU training dataset achieves highest performance among all spatial-temporal tasks, validating the dataset's efficacy to improve spatial-temporal understanding of VLMs in surgical videos. Code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SurgSTU-Pipeline，一个用于生成外科手术视频细粒度时空理解数据集的确定性生成管道，并创建了包含7515个视频片段和15万个问答样本的SurgSTU数据集，显著提升了视觉语言模型在外科视频中的时空理解能力。
AI.motivation: 现有外科视觉语言数据集缺乏对复杂、交织的时空动态的捕捉和评估能力。创建大规模、准确反映外科视频细粒度时空关系的数据集面临挑战：手动标注成本高昂，而使用大语言模型生成又容易出错。
AI.method: 提出了SurgSTU-Pipeline，一个具有时空连续性过滤的确定性生成管道，能够可靠地创建用于细粒度时空多模态理解的外科数据集。将该管道应用于公开可用的外科数据集，创建了SurgSTU数据集。
AI.result: 创建了包含7515个视频片段和15万个细粒度时空问答样本的SurgSTU数据集。评估表明，最先进的通用视觉语言模型在零样本设置下表现不佳，但通过上下文学习可以改善其时空能力。在SurgSTU训练数据集上微调的视觉语言模型在所有时空任务中取得了最高性能。
AI.conclusion: SurgSTU数据集能够有效提升视觉语言模型在外科视频中的时空理解能力，验证了数据集的效能。代码将公开提供。

title: Agentic Tool Use in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models are increasingly being deployed as autonomous agents yet their real world effectiveness depends on reliable tools for information retrieval, computation and external action. Existing studies remain fragmented across tasks, tool types, and training settings, lacking a unified view of how tool-use methods differ and evolve. This paper organizes the literature into three paradigms: prompting as plug-and-play, supervised tool learning and reward-driven tool policy learning, analyzes their methods, strengths and failure modes, reviews the evaluation landscape and highlights key challenges, aiming to address this fragmentation and provide a more structured evolutionary view of agentic tool use.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了LLM作为自主代理的工具使用研究，将其归纳为三大范式：提示即插即用、监督式工具学习、奖励驱动的工具策略学习，分析了各自方法、优势与失败模式，并展望了评估体系与关键挑战。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型作为自主代理的部署日益增多，其实效性依赖于可靠的信息检索、计算和外部行动工具。现有研究在任务、工具类型和训练设置上呈现碎片化，缺乏对工具使用方法差异与演进的统一视角。
AI.method: 将文献组织为三大范式：1) 提示即插即用：通过上下文提示直接调用工具；2) 监督式工具学习：基于标注数据训练工具使用能力；3) 奖励驱动的工具策略学习：通过强化学习优化工具选择策略。分析各范式的方法论、优势与失败模式。
AI.result: 建立了工具使用研究的结构化分类框架，揭示了不同范式的演进路径，识别了各方法的适用场景与局限性，为理解代理工具使用的技术发展提供了系统化视角。
AI.conclusion: 通过整合碎片化研究，本文提供了代理工具使用的结构化演进视图，指出了评估体系的关键挑战，为未来研究方向的统一与深化奠定了基础。

title: KUET at StanceNakba Shared Task: StanceMoE: Mixture-of-Experts Architecture for Stance Detection
comment: Accepted for workshop proceedings of the 15th International Conference on Language Resources and Evaluation (LREC'26)
summary: Actor-level stance detection aims to determine an author expressed position toward specific geopolitical actors mentioned or implicated in a text. Although transformer-based models have achieved relatively good performance in stance classification, they typically rely on unified representations that may not sufficiently capture heterogeneous linguistic signals, such as contrastive discourse structures, framing cues, and salient lexical indicators. This motivates the need for adaptive architectures that explicitly model diverse stance-expressive patterns. In this paper, we propose StanceMoE, a context-enhanced Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture built upon a fine-tuned BERT encoder for actor-level stance detection. Our model integrates six expert modules designed to capture complementary linguistic signals, including global semantic orientation, salient lexical cues, clause-level focus, phrase-level patterns, framing indicators, and contrast-driven discourse shifts. A context-aware gating mechanism dynamically weights expert contributions, enabling adaptive routing based on input characteristics. Experiments are conducted on the StanceNakba 2026 Subtask A dataset, comprising 1,401 annotated English texts where the target actor is implicit in the text. StanceMoE achieves a macro-F1 score of 94.26%, outperforming traditional baselines, and alternative BERT-based variants.

AI.tldr: StanceMoE：基于混合专家架构的演员级立场检测模型，通过六个专家模块捕捉互补的语言信号，在StanceNakba 2026数据集上取得94.26%的宏F1分数
AI.motivation: 现有基于Transformer的立场检测模型依赖统一表征，无法充分捕捉对比性话语结构、框架线索和显著词汇指标等异质性语言信号，需要能够显式建模多样化立场表达模式的自适应架构
AI.method: 提出StanceMoE架构，基于微调的BERT编码器，集成六个专家模块：全局语义导向、显著词汇线索、从句级焦点、短语级模式、框架指标、对比驱动的话语转换，通过上下文感知门控机制动态加权专家贡献
AI.result: 在StanceNakba 2026 Subtask A数据集（1,401个标注英文文本）上，StanceMoE获得94.26%的宏F1分数，优于传统基线和替代BERT变体
AI.conclusion: StanceMoE通过混合专家架构有效捕捉多样化的立场表达模式，在演员级立场检测任务中表现出色，证明了显式建模异质性语言信号的重要性

title: Multimodal Language Models Cannot Spot Spatial Inconsistencies
summary: Spatial consistency is a fundamental property of the visual world and a key requirement for models that aim to understand physical reality. Despite recent advances, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often struggle to reason about 3D geometry across multiple views. Rather than asking models to describe scene attributes, we introduce a more challenging task: given two views of the same scene, identify the object that violates 3D motion consistency. We propose a simple and scalable method for generating realistic, spatially inconsistent image pairs from multi-view scenes, enabling systematic evaluation of this capability. Our results show that state-of-the-art MLLMs significantly underperform human observers and exhibit substantial variability across different scene attributes, revealing a fragile and incomplete understanding of 3D structure. We hope our findings underscore the need for approaches that develop a more deeply grounded understanding of the physical world.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个评估多模态大语言模型3D几何推理能力的新任务：给定同一场景的两个视角，识别违反3D运动一致性的物体，发现现有模型表现远低于人类水平。
AI.motivation: 空间一致性是视觉世界的基本属性，但现有的多模态大语言模型在多视角3D几何推理方面存在困难。为了更严格地评估模型对物理现实的理解能力，需要设计更具挑战性的任务。
AI.method: 提出了一种简单可扩展的方法，从多视角场景中生成真实但空间不一致的图像对，用于系统评估模型识别3D运动一致性违反的能力。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，最先进的多模态大语言模型显著低于人类观察者表现，且在不同场景属性上表现出巨大差异，表明模型对3D结构的理解是脆弱且不完整的。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了当前多模态大语言模型在3D几何推理方面的严重不足，强调了需要开发对物理世界有更深入基础理解的方法。

title: When Users Change Their Mind: Evaluating Interruptible Agents in Long-Horizon Web Navigation
summary: As LLM agents transition from short, static problem solving to executing complex, long-horizon tasks in dynamic environments, the ability to handle user interruptions, such as adding requirement or revising goals, during mid-task execution is becoming a core requirement for realistic deployment. However, existing benchmarks largely assume uninterrupted agent behavior or study interruptions only in short, unconstrained language tasks. In this paper, we present the first systematic study of interruptible agents in long-horizon, environmentally grounded web navigation tasks, where actions induce persistent state changes. We formalize three realistic interruption types, including addition, revision, and retraction, and introduce InterruptBench, a benchmark derived from WebArena-Lite that synthesizes high-quality interruption scenarios under strict semantic constraints. Using a unified interruption simulation framework, we evaluate six strong LLM backbones across single- and multi-turn interruption settings, analyzing both their effectiveness in adapting to updated intents and their efficiency in recovering from mid-task changes. Our results show that handling user interruptions effectively and efficiently during long-horizon agentic tasks remains challenging for powerful large-scale LLMs. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/HenryPengZou/InterruptBench.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了首个针对长时程、环境基础网络导航任务中可中断智能体的系统性研究，建立了InterruptBench基准，评估LLM在动态环境中处理用户中断的能力。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM智能体从短时静态问题解决转向在动态环境中执行复杂长时程任务，处理用户中断（如添加需求或修改目标）成为现实部署的核心需求。现有基准大多假设智能体行为不受中断，或仅在短时无约束语言任务中研究中断。
AI.method: 形式化了三种现实中断类型（添加、修改、撤销），基于WebArena-Lite构建了InterruptBench基准，在严格语义约束下合成高质量中断场景，使用统一中断模拟框架评估六个强大LLM主干在单轮和多轮中断设置下的表现。
AI.result: 评估结果显示，即使在强大的大规模LLM中，在长时程智能体任务中有效且高效地处理用户中断仍然具有挑战性。LLM在适应更新意图和从任务中变化恢复方面存在困难。
AI.conclusion: 长时程环境基础任务中的可中断智能体研究是一个重要但尚未充分探索的领域，InterruptBench为系统评估LLM处理动态用户需求变化的能力提供了首个基准，揭示了当前模型的局限性。

title: Revisiting Human-in-the-Loop Object Retrieval with Pre-Trained Vision Transformers
summary: Building on existing approaches, we revisit Human-in-the-Loop Object Retrieval, a task that consists of iteratively retrieving images containing objects of a class-of-interest, specified by a user-provided query. Starting from a large unlabeled image collection, the aim is to rapidly identify diverse instances of an object category relying solely on the initial query and the user's Relevance Feedback, with no prior labels. The retrieval process is formulated as a binary classification task, where the system continuously learns to distinguish between relevant and non-relevant images to the query, through iterative user interaction. This interaction is guided by an Active Learning loop: at each iteration, the system selects informative samples for user annotation, thereby refining the retrieval performance. This task is particularly challenging in multi-object datasets, where the object of interest may occupy only a small region of the image within a complex, cluttered scene. Unlike object-centered settings where global descriptors often suffice, multi-object images require more adapted, localized descriptors. In this work, we formulate and revisit the Human-in-the-Loop Object Retrieval task by leveraging pre-trained ViT representations, and addressing key design questions, including which object instances to consider in an image, what form the annotations should take, how Active Selection should be applied, and which representation strategies best capture the object's features. We compare several representation strategies across multi-object datasets highlighting trade-offs between capturing the global context and focusing on fine-grained local object details. Our results offer practical insights for the design of effective interactive retrieval pipelines based on Active Learning for object class retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了人在回路对象检索任务，通过主动学习循环和预训练ViT表示，在多对象数据集上实现了仅依赖用户相关反馈的对象类别检索。
AI.motivation: 在多对象数据集中，感兴趣的对象可能只占据图像的小区域，而全局描述符往往不足。需要更适应的局部化描述符来应对复杂、杂乱的场景中的对象检索挑战。
AI.method: 将检索过程构建为二分类任务，通过主动学习循环迭代学习区分相关和非相关图像。利用预训练ViT表示，并探讨关键设计问题：图像中考虑哪些对象实例、标注形式、主动选择策略以及最佳表示策略。
AI.result: 比较了多对象数据集上的多种表示策略，揭示了捕获全局上下文与关注细粒度局部对象细节之间的权衡，为基于主动学习的交互式检索管道设计提供了实用见解。
AI.conclusion: 本文为基于主动学习的对象类别检索交互式检索管道设计提供了实用指导，特别适用于多对象数据集中的对象检索任务。

title: GPT-NL Public Corpus: A Permissively Licensed, Dutch-First Dataset for LLM Pre-training
summary: We present the GPT-NL Public Corpus, the biggest permissively licensed corpus of Dutch language resources. The GPT-NL Public Corpus contains 21 Dutch-only collections totalling 36B preprocessed Dutch tokens not present in any other LLM pretraining corpus. Additionally, the corpus includes roughly 207B English, 232B Code, and 48B German/Danish tokens taken from existing sets which we further curated for compliance. This corpus includes curated data from large existing corpora like Common Corpus and Common Crawl, as well as newly created Dutch-specific collections. Most newly created Dutch collections consist of content collected in collaboration with organisations or synthetically augmented content. All data is collected and evaluated with the aim of facilitating the creation of (commercial) language models that are lawful, useful and non-harmful. All data included in the GPT-NL Public Corpus is sourced from datasets with permissive licensing and is curated and redistributed under a CC-BY license. The full dataset is publicly available on the Hugging Face Hub.

AI.tldr: GPT-NL公共语料库是最大的荷兰语许可语料库，包含36B荷兰语token和大量其他语言token，旨在促进合法、有用、无害的商业语言模型开发
AI.motivation: 为荷兰语语言模型开发提供大规模、合规的预训练语料库，解决现有语料库中荷兰语资源不足的问题，促进商业语言模型的合法发展
AI.method: 整合21个荷兰语专用集合（36B token），并从现有语料库中精选207B英语、232B代码和48B德语/丹麦语token，通过组织合作收集和合成增强创建新荷兰语集合
AI.result: 创建了最大的荷兰语许可语料库，包含36B荷兰语token和总计超过500B token的多语言资源，所有数据以CC-BY许可在Hugging Face Hub公开
AI.conclusion: GPT-NL公共语料库为荷兰语语言模型开发提供了高质量、合规的基础资源，支持创建合法、有用、无害的商业语言模型

title: Positional Cognitive Specialization: Where Do LLMs Learn To Comprehend and Speak Your Language?
summary: Adapting large language models (LLMs) to new languages is an expensive and opaque process. Understanding how language models acquire new languages and multilingual abilities is key to achieve efficient adaptation. Prior work on multilingual interpretability research focuses primarily on how trained models process multilingual instructions, leaving unexplored the mechanisms through which they acquire new languages during training. We investigate these training dynamics on decoder-only transformers through the lens of two functional cognitive specializations: language perception (input comprehension) and production (output generation). Through experiments on low-resource languages, we demonstrate how perceptual and productive specialization emerges in different regions of a language model by running layer ablation sweeps from the model's input and output directions. Based on the observed specialization patterns, we propose CogSym, a layer-wise heuristic that enables effective adaptation by exclusively fine-tuning a few early and late layers. We show that tuning only the 25% outermost layers achieves downstream task performance within 2-3% deviation from the full fine-tuning baseline. CogSym yields consistent performance with adapter methods such as LoRA, showcasing generalization beyond full fine-tuning. These findings provide insights to better understand how LLMs learn new languages and push toward accessible and inclusive language modeling.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了大型语言模型学习新语言的训练动态，提出了CogSym层选择方法，仅微调模型25%的最外层就能达到接近全微调的性能。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型适应新语言的过程昂贵且不透明，理解模型如何获得新语言能力和多语言能力对于实现高效适应至关重要。先前研究主要关注训练好的模型如何处理多语言指令，而忽略了训练过程中获得新语言的机制。
AI.method: 通过两个功能性认知专业化视角研究训练动态：语言感知（输入理解）和语言产生（输出生成）。在低资源语言上进行实验，通过从模型输入和输出方向进行层消融扫描，观察感知和产生专业化在不同区域的分布。基于观察到的专业化模式，提出CogSym层选择启发式方法。
AI.result: 仅微调25%的最外层（早期和晚期层）就能在下游任务上达到与全微调基线相差2-3%的性能。CogSym与LoRA等适配器方法表现一致，展示了超越全微调的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现为理解LLMs如何学习新语言提供了见解，推动了可访问和包容性语言建模的发展。提出的CogSym方法能够实现有效适应，仅需微调少量层就能获得接近全微调的性能。

title: Phase transition on a context-sensitive random language model with short range interactions
summary: Since the random language model was proposed by E. DeGiuli [Phys. Rev. Lett. 122, 128301], language models have been investigated intensively from the viewpoint of statistical mechanics. Recently, the existence of a Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless transition was numerically demonstrated in models with long-range interactions between symbols. In statistical mechanics, it has long been known that long-range interactions can induce phase transitions. Therefore, it has remained unclear whether phase transitions observed in language models originate from genuinely linguistic properties that are absent in conventional spin models. In this study, we construct a random language model with short-range interactions and numerically investigate its statistical properties. Our model belongs to the class of context-sensitive grammars in the Chomsky hierarchy and allows explicit reference to contexts. We find that a phase transition occurs even when the model refers only to contexts whose length remains constant with respect to the sentence length. This result indicates that finite-temperature phase transitions in language models are genuinely induced by the intrinsic nature of language, rather than by long-range interactions.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个具有短程相互作用的随机语言模型，发现即使只参考长度固定的上下文，模型仍会出现相变，表明语言模型中的相变源于语言本身的内在特性，而非长程相互作用。
AI.motivation: 先前研究表明语言模型中存在Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless相变，但这些模型通常具有长程相互作用。统计力学中已知长程相互作用可诱导相变，因此需要澄清语言模型中的相变是否真正源于语言特性，而非长程相互作用效应。
AI.method: 构建了一个具有短程相互作用的随机语言模型，该模型属于乔姆斯基层级中的上下文敏感文法类别，允许显式参考上下文。特别设计了只参考长度固定的上下文（不随句子长度变化）的模型结构。
AI.result: 数值研究发现，即使模型只参考长度固定的上下文，仍然会出现相变。这表明相变的发生不依赖于长程相互作用。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型中的有限温度相变确实是由语言的内在特性所诱导，而非长程相互作用的结果。这一发现确认了语言模型相变的语言学本质。

title: Continual Vision-Language Learning for Remote Sensing: Benchmarking and Analysis
summary: Current remote sensing vision-language models (RS VLMs) demonstrate impressive performance in image interpretation but rely on static training data, limiting their ability to accommodate continuously emerging sensing modalities and downstream tasks. This exposes a fundamental challenge: enabling RS VLMs to continually adapt without catastrophic forgetting. Despite its practical importance, the continual learning capability of RS VLMs remains underexplored, and no dedicated benchmark currently exists. In this work, we present CLeaRS, a comprehensive benchmark for continual vision-language learning in remote sensing. CLeaRS comprises 10 curated subsets with over 207k image-text pairs, spanning diverse interpretation tasks, sensing modalities, and application scenarios. We further define three evaluation protocols: long-horizon, modality-incremental, and task-incremental settings, to systematically assess continual adaptation. Extensive benchmarking of diverse vision-language models reveals catastrophic forgetting across all settings. Moreover, representative continual learning methods, when adapted to RS VLMs, exhibit limited effectiveness in handling task, instruction, and modality transitions. Our findings underscore the need for developing continual learning methods tailored to RS VLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了CLeaRS基准，用于评估遥感视觉语言模型的持续学习能力，发现现有模型存在灾难性遗忘问题。
AI.motivation: 当前遥感视觉语言模型依赖静态训练数据，难以适应持续出现的新传感模态和下游任务，缺乏专门的持续学习评估基准。
AI.method: 构建CLeaRS基准，包含10个精选子集、超过207k图像-文本对，涵盖多样化解释任务、传感模态和应用场景，并定义三种评估协议。
AI.result: 广泛基准测试显示所有设置下都存在灾难性遗忘，现有持续学习方法在适应遥感视觉语言模型时效果有限。
AI.conclusion: 需要开发专门针对遥感视觉语言模型的持续学习方法，以解决任务、指令和模态转换中的挑战。

title: Dual Optimal: Make Your LLM Peer-like with Dignity
summary: Current aligned language models exhibit a dual failure mode we term the Evasive Servant: they sycophantically validate flawed user beliefs while deflecting responsibility with boilerplate disclaimers. We propose the Dignified Peer framework, which counters servility with anti-sycophancy and trustworthiness, and mitigates evasiveness through empathy and creativity. Realizing this agent requires overcoming significant challenges in data supervision, objective collapse, and evaluation bias. We address these issues by introducing the PersonaKnob dataset which features a compositional partial order structure of multiple persona preference. This data is utilized alongside a tolerant constrained Lagrangian DPO algorithm that dynamically balances all persona dimensions to prevent behavioral collapse. Additionally, we employ a psychometrically calibrated Item Response Theory evaluation protocol to disentangle latent model persona capability from confounders like judge biases. Extensive empirical studies demonstrate that our approach successfully build a LLM agent with both dignity and peer.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"Dignified Peer"框架解决语言模型的"Evasive Servant"问题：既避免阿谀奉承又减少推诿责任，通过PersonaKnob数据集和约束优化算法实现多维度人格平衡。
AI.motivation: 当前对齐的语言模型存在"Evasive Servient"双重失败模式：一方面阿谀奉承地验证用户的错误信念，另一方面用模板化的免责声明推卸责任。需要构建既有尊严又平等对话的AI代理。
AI.method: 提出Dignified Peer框架，使用PersonaKnob数据集（具有多个人格偏好的组合偏序结构），结合容忍性约束拉格朗日DPO算法动态平衡所有人格维度，防止行为崩溃。采用心理测量校准的项目反应理论评估协议分离潜在模型人格能力与评估者偏见等混杂因素。
AI.result: 广泛的实证研究表明，该方法成功构建了既有尊严又平等对话的LLM代理，有效解决了阿谀奉承和推诿责任的双重问题。
AI.conclusion: Dignified Peer框架通过创新的数据集设计、优化算法和评估方法，成功实现了语言模型在保持尊严的同时进行平等对话，为解决AI对齐中的行为偏差问题提供了有效方案。

title: Video Patch Pruning: Efficient Video Instance Segmentation via Early Token Reduction
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have demonstrated state-ofthe-art performance in several benchmarks, yet their high computational costs hinders their practical deployment. Patch Pruning offers significant savings, but existing approaches restrict token reduction to deeper layers, leaving early-stage compression unexplored. This limits their potential for holistic efficiency. In this work, we present a novel Video Patch Pruning framework (VPP) that integrates temporal prior knowledge to enable efficient sparsity within early ViT layers. Our approach is motivated by the observation that prior features extracted from deeper layers exhibit strong foreground selectivity. Therefore we propose a fully differentiable module for temporal mapping to accurately select the most relevant patches in early network stages. Notably, the proposed method enables a patch reduction of up to 60% in dense prediction tasks, exceeding the capabilities of conventional image-based patch pruning, which typically operate around a 30% patch sparsity. VPP excels the high-sparsity regime, sustaining remarkable performance even when patch usage is reduced below 55%. Specifically, it preserves stable results with a maximal performance drop of 0.6% on the Youtube-VIS 2021 dataset.

AI.tldr: 提出VPP框架，利用时间先验知识在ViT早期层实现高效稀疏化，在密集预测任务中实现高达60%的patch剪枝，超越传统图像patch剪枝的30%稀疏度限制。
AI.motivation: 现有patch剪枝方法主要关注深层token减少，忽略了早期阶段的压缩潜力，限制了整体效率提升。观察到深层特征提取具有强前景选择性，因此提出利用时间先验知识在早期ViT层实现高效稀疏化。
AI.method: 提出视频patch剪枝框架VPP，集成时间先验知识，采用完全可微分的时间映射模块，在早期网络阶段准确选择最相关的patch。
AI.result: 在密集预测任务中实现高达60%的patch减少，超越传统图像patch剪枝的30%稀疏度限制。在高稀疏度下保持优异性能，在Youtube-VIS 2021数据集上最大性能下降仅0.6%。
AI.conclusion: VPP框架成功利用时间先验知识在ViT早期层实现高效稀疏化，显著提升计算效率，为视频理解任务中的高效ViT部署提供了新思路。

title: Multimodal Analysis of State-Funded News Coverage of the Israel-Hamas War on YouTube Shorts
summary: YouTube Shorts have become central to news consumption on the platform, yet research on how geopolitical events are represented in this format remains limited. To address this gap, we present a multimodal pipeline that combines automatic transcription, aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA), and semantic scene classification. The pipeline is first assessed for feasibility and then applied to analyze short-form coverage of the Israel-Hamas war by state-funded outlets. Using over 2,300 conflict-related Shorts and more than 94,000 visual frames, we systematically examine war reporting across major international broadcasters. Our findings reveal that the sentiment expressed in transcripts regarding specific aspects differs across outlets and over time, whereas scene-type classifications reflect visual cues consistent with real-world events. Notably, smaller domain-adapted models outperform large transformers and even LLMs for sentiment analysis, underscoring the value of resource-efficient approaches for humanities research. The pipeline serves as a template for other short-form platforms, such as TikTok and Instagram, and demonstrates how multimodal methods, combined with qualitative interpretation, can characterize sentiment patterns and visual cues in algorithmically driven video environments.

AI.tldr: 开发多模态分析管道，结合自动转录、方面情感分析和语义场景分类，分析YouTube Shorts对以哈战争的报道，发现不同媒体情感表达差异，小规模领域适应模型优于大模型
AI.motivation: YouTube Shorts已成为平台新闻消费的核心形式，但关于地缘政治事件在此格式中如何呈现的研究仍然有限，需要填补这一空白
AI.method: 开发多模态分析管道，结合自动转录、方面情感分析(ABSA)和语义场景分类，应用于分析国家资助媒体对以哈战争的短格式报道，使用超过2,300个相关Shorts和94,000多个视觉帧
AI.result: 研究发现不同媒体在特定方面的情感表达存在差异且随时间变化，场景类型分类反映了与现实事件一致的视觉线索；值得注意的是，较小的领域适应模型在情感分析方面优于大型transformer模型甚至LLM
AI.conclusion: 该管道可作为其他短格式平台（如TikTok和Instagram）的模板，展示了多模态方法结合定性解释如何表征算法驱动视频环境中的情感模式和视觉线索，强调了资源高效方法在人文学科研究中的价值

title: LinguDistill: Recovering Linguistic Ability in Vision- Language Models via Selective Cross-Modal Distillation
summary: Adapting pretrained language models (LMs) into vision-language models (VLMs) can degrade their native linguistic capability due to representation shift and cross-modal interference introduced during multimodal adaptation. Such loss is difficult to recover, even with targeted task-specific fine-tuning using standard objectives. Prior recovery approaches typically introduce additional modules that act as intermediate alignment layers to maintain or isolate modality-specific subspaces, which increases architectural complexity, adds parameters at inference time, and limits flexibility across models and settings. We propose LinguDistill, an adapter-free distillation method that restores linguistic capability by utilizing the original frozen LM as a teacher. We overcome the key challenge of enabling vision-conditioned teacher supervision by introducing layer-wise KV-cache sharing, which exposes the teacher to the student's multimodal representations without modifying the architecture of either model. We then selectively distill the teacher's strong linguistic signal on language-intensive data to recover language capability, while preserving the student's visual grounding on multimodal tasks. As a result, LinguDistill recovers $\sim$10% of the performance lost on language and knowledge benchmarks, while maintaining comparable performance on vision-heavy tasks. Our findings demonstrate that linguistic capability can be recovered without additional modules, providing an efficient and practical solution to modality-specific degradation in multimodal models.

AI.tldr: LinguDistill：一种无需额外模块的适配器自由蒸馏方法，通过利用原始冻结语言模型作为教师，恢复视觉语言模型中的语言能力损失，同时保持视觉任务性能。
AI.motivation: 预训练语言模型适应为视觉语言模型时，由于表示偏移和跨模态干扰，会降低其原有的语言能力。这种损失难以恢复，现有方法通常引入额外的对齐层模块，增加了架构复杂性和推理参数。
AI.method: 提出LinguDistill方法，使用原始冻结语言模型作为教师，通过层级的KV缓存共享技术，让教师能够接触到学生的多模态表示，然后在语言密集型数据上选择性蒸馏教师的强语言信号，恢复语言能力，同时保持学生在多模态任务上的视觉基础。
AI.result: LinguDistill恢复了约10%在语言和知识基准测试中损失的性能，同时在视觉密集型任务上保持可比较的性能。
AI.conclusion: 语言能力可以在不添加额外模块的情况下恢复，为多模态模型中特定模态退化问题提供了高效实用的解决方案。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Variational Reward Factorization via Probabilistic Preference Bases for LLM Personalization
summary: Reward factorization personalizes large language models (LLMs) by decomposing rewards into shared basis functions and user-specific weights. Yet, existing methods estimate user weights from scarce data in isolation and as deterministic points, leading to inaccurate and unreliable inference. We introduce Variational Reward Factorization (VRF), an uncertainty-aware framework that represents each user's preferences as a variational distribution in a shared preference space. VRF infers user distributions via a variational encoder, derives weights through Wasserstein distance matching with shared probabilistic bases, and downweights uncertain estimates through a variance-attenuated loss. On three benchmarks, VRF outperforms all baselines across seen and unseen users, few-shot scenarios, and varying uncertainty levels, with gains extending to downstream alignment.

AI.tldr: VRF提出变分奖励分解框架，通过变分分布表示用户偏好，使用Wasserstein距离匹配共享概率基，并通过方差衰减损失处理不确定性，在多个基准测试中优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有奖励分解方法从稀疏数据中孤立地估计用户权重作为确定性点，导致推断不准确且不可靠。需要一种能够处理不确定性的框架来更准确地个性化LLMs。
AI.method: VRF使用变分编码器推断用户分布，通过Wasserstein距离匹配共享概率基来推导权重，并采用方差衰减损失来降低不确定估计的影响。
AI.result: 在三个基准测试中，VRF在所有基线方法之上表现出色，适用于已见和未见用户、少样本场景以及不同不确定性水平，且优势延伸到下游对齐任务。
AI.conclusion: VRF通过变分分布表示用户偏好并处理不确定性，显著提高了奖励分解的准确性和可靠性，为LLMs个性化提供了更有效的框架。

title: Disentangling to Re-couple: Resolving the Similarity-Controllability Paradox in Subject-Driven Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Subject-Driven Text-to-Image (T2I) Generation aims to preserve a subject's identity while editing its context based on a text prompt. A core challenge in this task is the "similarity-controllability paradox", where enhancing textual control often degrades the subject's fidelity, and vice-versa. We argue this paradox stems from the ambiguous role of text prompts, which are often tasked with describing both the subject and the desired modifications, leading to conflicting signals for the model. To resolve this, we propose DisCo, a novel framework that first Disntangles and then re-Couples visual and textual information. First, our textual-visual decoupling module isolates the sources of information: subject identity is extracted exclusively from the reference image with the entity word of the subject, while the text prompt is simplified to contain only the modification command, where the subject refers to general pronouns, eliminating descriptive ambiguity. However, this strict separation can lead to unnatural compositions between the subject and its contexts. We address this by designing a dedicated reward signal and using reinforcement learning to seamlessly recouple the visually-defined subject and the textually-generated context. Our approach effectively resolves the paradox, enabling simultaneous high-fidelity subject preservation and precise textual control. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, producing highly realistic and coherent images.

AI.tldr: DisCo框架通过解耦视觉和文本信息来解决主题驱动文本到图像生成中的"相似性-可控性悖论"，先分离主题身份和修改指令，再通过强化学习重新耦合，实现高保真主题保留和精确文本控制。
AI.motivation: 主题驱动文本到图像生成面临"相似性-可控性悖论"：增强文本控制会降低主题保真度，反之亦然。作者认为这一悖论源于文本提示的模糊性，它同时描述主题和所需修改，导致模型接收冲突信号。
AI.method: 提出DisCo框架：1) 文本-视觉解耦模块：从参考图像中提取主题身份（使用实体词），文本提示简化为仅包含修改指令（使用通用代词）；2) 设计专用奖励信号，通过强化学习无缝重新耦合视觉定义的主题和文本生成的上下文。
AI.result: 该方法有效解决了相似性-可控性悖论，实现了同时高保真主题保留和精确文本控制。大量实验表明该方法达到了最先进的性能，生成高度真实和连贯的图像。
AI.conclusion: 通过先解耦后重新耦合视觉和文本信息的方法，DisCo框架成功解决了主题驱动文本到图像生成中的核心挑战，为同时实现高保真主题保留和精确文本控制提供了有效解决方案。

title: Narrative Fingerprints: Multi-Scale Author Identification via Novelty Curve Dynamics
summary: We test whether authors have characteristic "fingerprints" in the information-theoretic novelty curves of their published works. Working with two corpora -- Books3 (52,796 books, 759 qualifying authors) and PG-19 (28,439 books, 1,821 qualifying authors) -- we find that authorial voice leaves measurable traces in how novelty unfolds across a text. The signal is multi-scale: at book level, scalar dynamics (mean novelty, speed, volume, circuitousness) identify 43% of authors significantly above chance; at chapter level, SAX motif patterns in sliding windows achieve 30x-above-chance attribution, far exceeding the scalar features that dominate at book level. These signals are complementary, not redundant. We show that the fingerprint is partly confounded with genre but persists within-genre for approximately one-quarter of authors. Classical authors (Twain, Austen, Kipling) show fingerprints comparable in strength to modern authors, suggesting the phenomenon is not an artifact of contemporary publishing conventions.

AI.tldr: 研究发现作者在作品的信息论新颖性曲线上具有独特的"指纹"特征，这些特征在不同尺度上都能被检测到，且部分特征与体裁相关但仍有四分之一作者在体裁内保持独特性。
AI.motivation: 探索作者是否在作品的信息论新颖性曲线上具有可识别的独特特征，验证作者声音是否在文本新颖性变化中留下可测量的痕迹。
AI.method: 使用Books3（52,796本书，759位合格作者）和PG-19（28,439本书，1,821位合格作者）两个语料库，分析作者作品的新颖性曲线特征，包括书籍层面的标量动态特征（平均新颖性、速度、体积、迂回度）和章节层面的SAX主题模式滑动窗口分析。
AI.result: 书籍层面的标量动态特征能显著高于随机水平识别43%的作者；章节层面的SAX主题模式滑动窗口分析能达到30倍于随机水平的归因准确率，远超书籍层面的标量特征。这些信号是互补的，指纹特征部分与体裁相关，但约四分之一作者在体裁内仍保持独特性。古典作者（吐温、奥斯汀、吉卜林）的指纹强度与现代作者相当。
AI.conclusion: 作者声音确实在文本新颖性变化中留下可测量的多尺度痕迹，这种指纹特征在不同时代作者中都存在，表明这不是当代出版惯例的产物，而是作者创作风格的固有特征。

title: MotionGrounder: Grounded Multi-Object Motion Transfer via Diffusion Transformer
comment: Please visit our project page at https://kaist-viclab.github.io/motiongrounder-site/
summary: Motion transfer enables controllable video generation by transferring temporal dynamics from a reference video to synthesize a new video conditioned on a target caption. However, existing Diffusion Transformer (DiT)-based methods are limited to single-object videos, restricting fine-grained control in real-world scenes with multiple objects. In this work, we introduce MotionGrounder, a DiT-based framework that firstly handles motion transfer with multi-object controllability. Our Flow-based Motion Signal (FMS) in MotionGrounder provides a stable motion prior for target video generation, while our Object-Caption Alignment Loss (OCAL) grounds object captions to their corresponding spatial regions. We further propose a new Object Grounding Score (OGS), which jointly evaluates (i) spatial alignment between source video objects and their generated counterparts and (ii) semantic consistency between each generated object and its target caption. Our experiments show that MotionGrounder consistently outperforms recent baselines across quantitative, qualitative, and human evaluations.

AI.tldr: MotionGrounder：首个基于DiT的多目标可控运动迁移框架，通过流式运动信号和对象-标题对齐损失实现精细控制
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散变换器（DiT）的运动迁移方法仅限于单目标视频，无法处理现实场景中多目标的精细控制需求
AI.method: 提出MotionGrounder框架：1）流式运动信号（FMS）为目标视频生成提供稳定运动先验；2）对象-标题对齐损失（OCAL）将对象标题锚定到对应空间区域；3）提出对象接地评分（OGS）联合评估空间对齐和语义一致性
AI.result: MotionGrounder在定量、定性和人工评估中均优于现有基线方法
AI.conclusion: MotionGrounder是首个实现多目标可控运动迁移的DiT框架，通过创新的运动信号和对象接地机制显著提升了生成视频的质量和控制精度

title: Temporal Dependencies in In-Context Learning: The Role of Induction Heads
